examples.en: Sue has the ability to succeed in business.
examples.zh: 苏有能力在商业上取得成功。

derivations.zh: 丧失能力的；有残疾的；无能力的

phrases: have the ability to do sth. 具备做某事的能力

examples.en: Leave the reference books behind, or you won’t be able to think by yourself.
examples.zh: 把参考书放一边，否则你将无法独立思考。

phrases: sb. be able to do sth. 某人能够做某事

examples.en: It takes about half an hour to ride from this park to Shanghai Museum.
examples.zh: 从这个公园骑车到上海博物馆大约需要半个小时。

examples.en: Mr. Johnson is always kind to his students and he really cares about them.
examples.zh: 约翰逊先生对他的学生总是很好，他真的很关心他们。

examples.en: You'd better not ask too many personal questions about someone's age and salary.
examples.zh: 你最好不要问太多关于某人年龄和薪水的私人问题。

phrases: how about doing sth. = what about doing sth. 做某事如何

examples.en: Keep your head above the water.
examples.zh: 保持头部在水面以上。

examples.en: This job requires a bachelor's degree or above.
examples.zh: 这份工作需要本科及以上学历。

phrases: above all 首先，尤其是；最重要的是
notes:
above 是常考单词，所以学生一定要知道 above, over 和 on 在表示位置时的用法区别：
above 指笼统的上方，表示位置之高；反义词为 below。
例如：The water came above our knees. 水没过了我们的膝盖。
over 指垂直的上方，比较精确，反义词为 under。
例如：The light is over my head. 灯在我头顶上方。
on 指“在……上面”，两者有表面接触，表示一件东西在另一件之上。
例如：There is a book on the desk. 桌子上有一本书。

examples.en: He had to make a choice between staying with his parents and going abroad.
examples.zh: 与父母住在一起还是出国，他不得不作出选择。

notes:
abroad 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其固定搭配：abroad 前面不能加
to 或 in，因为 abroad 是副词。
例如：go abroad 出国
My brother is living abroad. 我哥哥在国外生活。

examples.en: They accepted responsibility for the accident.
examples.zh: 他们承担了这次事故的责任。

examples.en: He was injured in a traffic accident.
examples.zh: 他在一次交通事故中受伤。

examples.en: The manager impressed on his office staff the importance of keeping accurate records.
examples.zh: 经理让办公室职员认识到做精确记录的重要性。

examples.en: She could feel an ache in her back.
examples.zh: 她能感觉到背部的疼痛。

examples.en: My head aches after studying for a long time.
examples.zh: 长时间学习后，我的头很疼。

examples.en: As an English learner, the larger vocabulary you have, the more success you may achieve.
examples.zh: 作为一名英语学习者，你的词汇量越大，你最终获得的成功也就越大。

examples.en: She ran across the field to catch up with her friends.
examples.zh: 她跑过田野赶上朋友们。

examples.en: The river measures about 30 metres across.
examples.zh: 这条河宽约 30 米。

phrases: come across (偶然) 遇见，碰见，发现

examples.en: The actor who acted in the TV series last night became famous in his thirties.
examples.zh: 昨晚电视剧中的这位演员，在他30多岁时就成名了。

examples.en: His selfless act of kindness touched everyone's heart.
examples.zh: 他无私的善举触动了每个人的心。

derivations.zh: 积极的；活跃的；充满活力的

proverbs: Think well before you act. 三思而后行。

senses.zh: 积极的；活跃的；充满活力的

examples.en: They took an active part in the singing competition yesterday.
examples.zh: 他们昨天积极参加了唱歌比赛。

phrases: live an active life 过着积极的生活
keep active and healthy 保持活跃健康
take an active part in 积极参与

examples.en: Our school club offers various activities, such as singing, gardening, and robotics.
examples.zh: 我们的学校社团提供各种各样的活动，如唱歌、园艺和机器人制作。

examples.en: Nowadays too many boys want to become actors.
examples.zh: 现在太多男孩都想成为演员。

examples.en: Emma, an actress, has become a superstar because of her hard work and talent.
examples.zh: 艾玛是一位女演员，因为她的努力和才华成为了超级明星。

senses.zh: 实际上；现实地；的确；真实地；事实上

examples.en: He seems to be doing nothing, but actually he is waiting for a chance.
examples.zh: 他看上去什么都没做，其实是在等待机会。

examples.en: Don't add too much salt to the soup, or it will be too salty.
examples.zh: 汤里不要加太多盐，否则会太咸。

examples.en: Ann will be a very useful addition to our team.
examples.zh: 安的加入对我们团队将是十分有利的。

phrases: in addition (to) (= besides = what's more) 除……以外(还)；另外；此外

examples.en: Sorry, I can't hear you clearly. Will you please repeat your email address? I'll write it down.
examples.zh: 对不起，我听不清楚你说的。请你再说一遍你的电子邮件地址，好吗？我把它写下来。

examples.en: You have spent your whole childhood in one country, and you are becoming an adult in another country.
examples.zh: 你整个童年都在一个国家生活，而在另外一个国家步入成年。

examples.en: They have an adult son.
examples.zh: 他们有一个成年的儿子。

examples.en: Rich has an advantage over you since he can speak German.
examples.zh: 里奇比你有优势，因为他会说德语。

proverbs: Every advantage has its disadvantage. 有利就有弊。

senses.zh: 冒险；冒险经历；冒险精神

examples.en: It's a new story full of action, adventure and heroic characters.
examples.zh: 这是一个充满曲折情节、冒险和英雄人物的新故事。

examples.en: This advertisement is calculated to appeal to children.
examples.zh: 这则广告的设计是为吸引儿童。

examples.en: The manager thought the old lady was right, but he didn't take her advice.
examples.zh: 经理认为这位老太太是正确的，但他没有接受她的忠告。

phrases: take one's advice 听从某人劝告
notes:
advice 是常考单词，相当于 an opinion/a suggestion，所以学生一定要掌握
其固定搭配：
ask for one's advice = ask sb. for advice 征求某人的意见
take/follow one's advice 听从某人的劝告
give sb. some advice on sth. 关于某事给某人一些建议

examples.en: He advised us to leave early.
examples.zh: 他建议我们早点动身。

examples.en: Last night's heavy rain seriously affected this morning's traffic.
examples.zh: 昨晚的暴雨严重影响了今早的交通。

examples.en: The dirty water may affect the wound.
examples.zh: 脏水可能感染伤口。

senses.zh: 负担得起；承担得起；抽得出(时间)做某事

examples.en: The smartphone is so expensive that I can't afford it.
examples.zh: 这部智能手机太贵了，我买不起。

examples.en: Can you afford the time?
examples.zh: 你抽得出时间吗？

examples.en: I am afraid of snakes.
examples.zh: 我怕蛇。

examples.en: Don't be afraid to make mistakes.
examples.zh: 别担心会犯错。

examples.en: Mr. King has gone to South Africa. He will be back next month.
examples.zh: 金先生已去南非。他下个月回来。

examples.en: Tony has made up his mind to be a soldier to serve the country after graduation.
examples.zh: 托尼决心毕业后当兵报国。

examples.en: He left on Monday and returned two days after.
examples.zh: 他星期一走的，两天后回来了。

examples.en: After discussing for a whole day, they finally reached a conclusion to solve the problem.
examples.zh: 经过一整天的讨论，他们终于得出了解决这个问题的结论。

proverbs: After a storm comes a calm. 雨过天晴。
notes:
after是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其固定搭配，及比较与in的用法区别：
表示将来时：after后接时间点；in后接时间段。
例如：He'll come back after 10 o'clock. 他将在10点钟以后回来。
I'll be ready in 10 minutes. 我将在10分钟内准备好。

examples.en: All the boys went swimming that afternoon except Bob because he had a cold.
examples.zh: 那天下午除了鲍勃，所有的男孩都去游泳了，因为他感冒了。

examples.en: A terrible earthquake hit the Pacific Ocean near Northeastern Japan on the afternoon of last Christmas.
examples.zh: 去年圣诞节的下午，在日本东北部太平洋附近海域发生了一次可怕的地震。

notes:
afternoon (evening, morning) 是常考单词，主要是考其固定搭配：
1) 表示“在下午（晚上、早上）”，要用介词in，如：in the afternoon (evening, morning)
2) 表示具体“某天的下午（晚上、早上）”，要用介词on，如：on Sunday afternoon (evening, morning), on the afternoon (evening, morning) of Jan. 2
3) 当 afternoon (evening, morning) 前面有 this, that, last, yesterday, tomorrow 这些词语时，就不能用介词，如：this/that/last/yesterday/tomorrow afternoon (evening, morning)

examples.en: It's hard training not luck that has helped him break the records again.
examples.zh: 他再次打破纪录，完全是靠刻苦训练而不是运气。

senses.zh: 对着；反对；与……对阵；与……相反

examples.en:
— We lost the basketball game against Class Two.
— What a pity!
examples.zh:
——我们和二班的篮球比赛输了。
——真可惜！

examples.en: Are you for or against it?
examples.zh: 你是赞成还是反对？

examples.en: He came to China at the age of 22.
examples.zh: 他22岁时来到中国。

examples.en: By the age of 21, he had already finished his studies. 21
examples.zh: 岁的时候，他已经完成了学业。

examples.en: Watt inaugurated the age of steam.
examples.zh: 瓦特开创了蒸汽时代。

phrases: at the age of 在……岁时
proverbs: We should learn a lesson from this incident: an idle youth, a needy age. 我们应从这次事件中吸取教训：少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲。
notes:
age是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生要掌握其固定搭配：What's the age of...=How old is...。
例如：What's the age of the boy by the riverside?
=How old is the boy by the riverside?
在河边的那个男孩有多大？

examples.en: The aged people in the community celebrated their eightieth birthday together last week.
examples.zh: 这个社区的老年人在上周一起庆祝了他们的八十大寿。

examples.en: Nobody can really tell the truth of the accident that happened a week ago.
examples.zh: 没有人能真正说出一周前发生的那起事故的真相。

examples.en: Mary's trouble weighed so heavily on her that her teacher agreed to help her after school.
examples.zh: 玛丽的问题很严重，老师同意放学后帮助她。

phrases: agree with sb. 同意某人的意见
notes:
agree是常考单词，相当于have the same opinion as sb.，所以学生一定要掌握其固定搭配：
agree with 赞成，同意(表示同意某人或某人的意见、想法、分析、解释等)；后接sb., this idea, what one says, one's opinion。
agree to 接受，认可(表示一方提出一项建议、安排、计划等，另一方同意协作)；后接suggestion, plan, proposal, arrangement, marriage，以及动词原形。
agree on 取得一致意见(表示双方通过协商而取得一致意见或达成协议)；后接price, these terms。

examples.en: Mary looked ahead but could see nothing unusual.
examples.zh: 玛丽目视前方，但没看到什么不寻常的。

phrases: go ahead 先走；向前走；去吧；干吧；继续；着手做

examples.en: The chief aim of man is not to get money.
examples.zh: 人的主要目标并不是赚钱。

examples.en: The new law aims to protect the rights of every citizen.
examples.zh: 这项新法律旨在保护每位公民的权利。

examples.en: I aimed at the target but hit the wall.
examples.zh: 我瞄准靶子却打在了墙上。

examples.en: Open the window to let in some fresh air.
examples.zh: 打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

examples.en: There were no other airlines doing a direct flight to Toronto last year.
examples.zh: 去年没有其他航空公司直飞多伦多。

examples.en: As soon as you come back from the airport, please give me a ring.
examples.zh: 你一从机场回来，就请给我打个电话。

examples.en: I gave the alarm as soon as I saw the smoke.
examples.zh: 我一看到冒烟就马上发出了警报。

examples.en: He turned off the alarm and went back to sleep.
examples.zh: 他关了闹钟继续睡。

examples.en: Are your grandparents still alive?
examples.zh: 你祖父母还健在吗？

notes:
alive 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其固定的用法，及比较与 living 的用法区别：
alive 是形容词，只能作表语用，所以不能用于名词前。
living 也是形容词，一般用于名词前，只能作定语，如：living things“生物”。

examples.en: Almost all students in Junior Three are busy preparing for the coming final exam.
examples.zh: 几乎所有的初三学生都正忙着为即将到来的期末考试做准备。

examples.en: The five articles in the school newspaper are all about memory.
examples.zh: 学校报纸上的那5篇文章都是关于记忆的。

examples.en: Parents often expect their children to do all the things that they couldn't do in the past.
examples.zh: 家长们往往期望他们的孩子去做所有自己过去所不能做的事情。

examples.en: That's all.
examples.zh: 这就是全部。

phrases: all right 行了；好吧；(病)好了
not ... at all 一点也不，根本不
proverbs: As is well known, all work and no play makes Jack a dull boy. 众所周知，只工作，不玩耍，聪明小孩也变傻。

examples.en: Hurry up! Once the concert starts, nobody is allowed to enter the concert hall.
examples.zh: 快点！一旦音乐会开始，就不允许任何人进入音乐厅了。

notes:
allow 是常考单词，相当于 let sb. do sth.，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：aren't allowed to do 与 mustn't do 意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：Students aren't allowed to smoke because smoking is harmful to their health.
= Students mustn't smoke because smoking is harmful to their health.
学生不允许吸烟是因为吸烟有害健康。

examples.en: Almost everyone agreed that the New Year party was a great success.
examples.zh: 几乎所有人都认为，新年晚会办得很成功。

notes:
almost 是常考单词，相当于 nearly 或 not quite，所以学生一定要掌握其固定搭配，及比较与 nearly 的用法区别：
almost 可与 no, none, nobody, nothing, never 连用。
nearly 不可与 no, none, nobody, nothing, never 连用，只可与 not, pretty, very 连用。
例如: Almost no one took any rest. 几乎没有一个人歇过一下。
The car is pretty nearly new. 这辆汽车几乎是全新的。
另外, almost 常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中, 所以学生一定要
知道: almost never 与 hardly ever 意思相同, 在句中可以互换。
例如: He almost never drinks Coke. = He hardly ever drinks Coke.
他几乎从不喝可乐。

examples.en: She is alone, but she doesn't feel lonely.
examples.zh: 她独自一人, 但并不感到孤单。

examples.en: My father often enjoys that piece of music alone at home.
examples.zh: 我父亲常常独自在家欣赏那首曲子。

notes:
alone 是常考单词, 所以学生一定要掌握其用法, 及比较与 lonely 的用法
区别:
alone 用作形容词时, 意为 “独自的, 单独的”, 只能用作表语, 不能用作定语。
例如: I was alone in the house. 我一个人在家。
注意: alone 也可用作副词, 意为 “单独地, 独自地”, 不含感情色彩。
例如: He lives alone. 他单独居住。
lonely 虽以 -ly 结尾, 但它是形容词而不是副词。它可以用作表语, 意为 “寂寞
的”, 多指人, 也可用作定语, 意为 “荒凉的”, 多指地方。
例如: He doesn't feel lonely when he is left alone. 他单独留下时并不感到寂寞。
He was taken to a lonely island. 他被带到一个荒岛上。

senses.zh: 向前; 和……一起; 一同

examples.en: We walked along the road.
examples.zh: 我们沿着公路走。

examples.en: She sang loudly as she walked along.
examples.zh: 她一边高歌一边向前走。

phrases: get along with 和睦相处; 关系良好

examples.en: Although Michael is only six, he has already shown his ability to draw pictures.
examples.zh: 尽管迈克尔只有 6 岁, (但) 他已经显示出绘画才能了。

notes:
already 是常考单词, 常出现在句型转换练习中, 所以学生一定要掌握其用
法, 及比较与 yet 的用法区别: already 用在肯定句中; yet 用在否定句和疑问句中。

examples.en: During his educational visit in the U.K., Simon improved his English and also learnt the culture of this country.
examples.zh: 在英国研学期间，西蒙提高了他的英语水平，也了解了这个国家的文化。

notes:
also是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：also与too和as well意思相同，在句中可以互换；also一般位于句中，而too和as well位于句末。
例如：He also plays the piano.
= He plays the piano, too.
= He plays the piano as well.
他也弹钢琴。

examples.en: Although she is over 85 years old, she still looks after herself very well.
examples.zh: 她虽然年过85岁，(但)仍然能很好地照顾自己。

notes:
although/though是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握其用法：
1) 句中用了although/though，不能再用but。
2) although/though可以和but进行句型转换。
例如：Although/Though he was English, he could speak Japanese fluently.
= He was English, but he could speak Japanese fluently.
他虽然是英国人，但能说一口流利的日语。
Although/Though we can’t smell the air, it is around us.
= We can’t smell the air, but air is around us.
虽然我们闻不到空气，但空气就在我们周围。
_flags: OCR 头部为合并词条，已拆分记录两个词头与两条音标

examples.en: I forgot it altogether.
examples.zh: 我全忘记了。

notes:
altogether是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握单词意思，及比较与all together的意思区别：
altogether的意思是“总共”；all together的意思是“一道”。
例如：I spent a hundred dollars on these books altogether. 这些书我一共花了100美元。
We went there all together. 我们一起去那里。

examples.en: Money and beauty do not always bring happiness to life.
examples.zh: 金钱与美貌并不总是为生活带来幸福。
现在是上午10点。

senses.zh: 令人惊讶的；令人赞叹的

examples.en: The film The Lord of the Rings is amazing, so it is welcomed by teenagers.
examples.zh: 《指环王》是部令人惊叹的电影，所以它受到青少年的欢迎。

examples.en: We are amazed to hear that the girl can run at an amazing speed.
examples.zh: 我们惊奇地得知那个女孩能以惊人的速度奔跑。

examples.en: What an amazing chance it is for you to travel abroad and experience a new culture!
examples.zh: 对你来说，能出国旅行并体验一种全新的文化，这是多么好的机会啊！

examples.en: His ambition is to be an English teacher.
examples.zh: 他的志向是成为一名英语老师。

examples.en: I'll send you an email to tell you everything when I get to America.
examples.zh: 我到了美国会给你发封电子邮件告诉你所有情况。

_flags: OCR音标 /'merɪkə/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ə'merɪkə/

examples.en: The man speaks French with an American accent.
examples.zh: 这个男人说法语时带美国口音。

examples.en: Steve Jobs was an American.
examples.zh: 史蒂夫·乔布斯是美国人。

senses.zh: 在……中间；在（三个以上）之间

examples.en: We finally found the little boy among the trees.
examples.zh: 我们最终在树丛中找到了那个小男孩。

examples.en: Among all the subjects, I like English best.
examples.zh: 在所有科目中，我最喜欢英语。

notes:
among 是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其用法，及比较与 between 的用法区别：
among 指“三者或三者以上之间”，between 指“两者之间”。
例如：The teacher was among her students. 这位老师在学生中间。
The river runs between the two countries. 这条河在两国之间流过。

examples.en: We need huge amounts of money to plant the trees in our city.
examples.zh: 在我们市里种植树木需要大量资金。

examples.en: The cake won't rise unless you use the right amount of baking powder.
examples.zh: 除非你使用适量的发酵粉，否则蛋糕发不起来。

notes:
amount 是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其用法，及比较与 number 的用法区别：
amount 用于修饰不可数名词，number 用于修饰可数名词。
例如：He has a large amount of money. 他有很多钱。
A number of new products have been successfully launched.
许多新产品已成功投放市场。
注意：the number of … 短语作主语时，谓语动词一般通用第三人称单数。
例如：The number of tourists to that place is limited. 去那地方旅游的人数有限制。

examples.en: What a big amusement park it is!
examples.zh: 这个游乐场真大啊！

examples.en: The hotel offers different varieties of amusements to attract the guests.
examples.zh: 这家旅馆提供各种各样的娱乐活动来吸引客人。

phrases: amusement park 游乐园；娱乐公园

examples.en: How amusing it is!
examples.zh: 它多有趣！

examples.en: They wanted to learn the ancient languages such as Greek and Latin.
examples.zh: 他们想学习古代语言，例如希腊语和拉丁语。

examples.en: He always eats an egg, a piece of bread and a cup of milk for breakfast.
examples.zh: 他早餐总是一个蛋、一片面包和一杯牛奶。

notes:
and 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握其在祈使句中的固定用法：在祈使句后，用 and 连接简单句，表
示条件与结果的关系，意思为“如果……就……”。
例如：Use your head, and you'll find a way.
= If you use your head, you'll find a way.
(如果你) 开动脑筋，你就会想出办法的。

examples.en: Jack slammed the door angrily after he was laughed at.
examples.zh: 杰克被嘲笑后，愤怒地将门砰地一声关上。

examples.en: The customer was angry with the waitress for her bad service.
examples.zh: 顾客因女侍者的糟糕服务而生气。

phrases: be angry with sb. 生某人的气
notes:
angry 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其固定搭配：
be angry with sb. 对某人生气
be angry at sth. 对某事生气
be angry about sth. 对……感到气愤
be angry to do sth. 生气地做某事
be angry that ... 生气

examples.en: Jim grew up with many animals at home and knows well how to take care of pets.
examples.zh: 吉姆自小在家里与小动物们相伴成长，深知如何照顾宠物。

examples.en: They worked for another fifteen days and finished the task successfully.
examples.zh: 他们又工作了 15 天，成功完成了任务。

examples.en: I've already had two cups of coffee, but I can still have another.
examples.zh: 我已经喝了两杯咖啡了，但我还能再喝一杯。

phrases: one after another 一个接一个地
proverbs: It is good to learn at another man's cost. 前车之鉴。
notes:
another 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其固定搭配，及比较与 the other 的用法区别：
another 是指三个及三个以上的另一个；the other 是指两个当中的另一个。
例如：I don't like this one, show me another. 我不喜欢这个，请另拿一个给我看看。
I have two hands. One is the right hand and the other is left.
我有两只手。一只是右手，另一只是左手。
one after another 一个接一个地
_flags: 词组 one after another 印刷时未带"常用词组"小节标题，按词组收录

examples.en: The maths teacher wonders if anyone knows the answer to the question.
examples.zh: 数学老师想知道是否有人知道这个问题的答案。

examples.en: She didn't answer my letter.
examples.zh: 她没有给我回信。

examples.en: Last night I didn't answer your phone because I was seeing the film Dune.
examples.zh: 昨晚我没有接听你的电话，因为我正在看电影《沙丘》。

senses.zh: (用于疑问句、否定句、条件句) 一些，什么；任何的，任一的
(无论) 哪一个；(无论) 哪些

examples.en: We shouldn't make friends with any dishonest persons.
examples.zh: 我们不应该和任何不诚实的人交朋友。

examples.en: Tom's Chinese is better than any other boy's in the class.
examples.zh: 汤姆的中文比班上其他男孩都好。

examples.en: I asked my friend for some ink, but she didn't have any.
examples.zh: 我问我的朋友要一些墨水，但是她也没有。

phrases: not any longer = no longer 不再
notes:
any 是常考单词，所以学生一定要知道其用法，及比较与 some 的用法区别：
1) some 用于肯定句中，any 用于否定句或疑问句中。但在表示建议、反问、请求的疑问句中，或期望得到肯定回答时，多用 some，而不用 any。
例如：Would you like some coffee? 你要不要来点咖啡？
What about some fruit juice? 来点果汁如何？
2) any 表示“任何”的意思，起强调作用时，它可以用于肯定句中。
例如：Any student can answer this question. 任何学生都可以回答这个问题。
3) any 的固定搭配 not ... any longer 与 not ... any more(再也不……) 意思相同，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中。
例如：I can't wait any longer/any more. 我一刻也不能再等下去了。

senses.zh: 任何人；无论谁；随便哪一个人

examples.en: There isn't anyone/anybody in the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室里没有任何人。

_flags: OCR 头部为合并词条，已拆分记录两个词头与两条音标

senses.zh: 什么事(物)；任何事(物)；任何东西

examples.en: Alice didn't say anything at the meeting last week, did she?
examples.zh: 在上周的会议上爱丽丝没有说什么，是吗？

examples.en: We will go anywhere you like.
examples.zh: 我们会去你喜欢的任何地方。

examples.en: I apologized to the girl for my being late.
examples.zh: 我因为迟到而向那位女孩道歉。

phrases: apologize to sb. for sth. 为某事向某人道歉
notes:
apologize 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：apologize to sb. 与 say sorry to sb. 意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：The boy apologized to his friend because he had broken his glass.
= The boy said sorry to his friend because he had broken his glass.
这个男孩对他的朋友说“对不起”，因为他打碎了他的杯子。

examples.en: As soon as the boss appeared, the noisy office became quiet.
examples.zh: 老板一出现，喧闹的办公室马上安静了下来。

examples.en: She appears confident when speaking in public.
examples.zh: 她当众讲话时显得很自信。

examples.en: Your answer appears to be right.
examples.zh: 你的答案似乎是对的。

examples.en: Please help yourself to the apples and oranges on the table, Mary.
examples.zh: 玛丽，桌上的苹果和橘子请随便吃。

proverbs: An apple a day keeps the doctor away. 一天一苹果，医生远离我。

examples.en: I advise that they apply to the council for a home improvement grant.
examples.zh: 我建议他们向市政会申请改善住房的补助。

examples.en: In this way they can better apply theory to practice.
examples.zh: 这样他们就能更好地把理论运用到实践中去。

examples.en: April Fool's Day began hundreds of years ago in France.
examples.zh: 愚人节起源于几百年前的法国。

senses.zh: 面积；范围；（地方、城市、国家、世界的）地区，地域

examples.en: Since I'm very familiar with this area, they expect me to show them around.
examples.zh: 因为我非常熟悉这一地区，他们希望我领他们参观一下。

examples.en: Do what you are told and don't argue with me.
examples.zh: 照我说的去做，不要争辩。

examples.en: The baby feels safe while his mother holds him in her arms.
examples.zh: 婴儿被母亲抱在怀里时感到很安全。

examples.en: After many days' fight, the army succeeded in controlling the situation of the area.
examples.zh: 经过许多天的战斗，军队成功地控制了该地区的局势。

examples.en: Smoking too much really does great harm to both himself and people around.
examples.zh: 吸烟太多真的不仅对自己，还会对周围的人造成伤害。

examples.en: Can you show me around this building?
examples.zh: 你能带我参观一下这幢大楼吗？

examples.en: I've arranged to see him on Friday morning.
examples.zh: 我已安排好星期五上午见他。

examples.en: The room looks wide with all the furniture arranged neatly and in order.
examples.zh: 所有家具摆放得整齐有序，这个房间看起来很宽敞。

examples.en: On his arrival at the airport, he received a warm welcome from the teachers and students.
examples.zh: 他一到机场就受到老师和学生们的热烈欢迎。

examples.en: They arrived there on a cold winter evening.
examples.zh: 他们在一个寒冷的冬夜抵达那里。

examples.en: As usual, Frank arrived at the station at 6:30 that morning to catch the early bus.
examples.zh: 像往常一样，弗兰克那天早上 6:30 到达车站赶早班车。

examples.en: You don't know what art is.
examples.zh: 你不知道什么是艺术。

proverbs: Art is long, but life is short. 人生有限，艺海无涯。

examples.en: After the interview, the reporter decided to write an article on school buses in China.
examples.zh: 采访后，记者决定写一篇关于中国校车的报道。

examples.en: The great artist gave his first show in Shanghai and the tickets sold out in minutes.
examples.zh: 这位伟大的艺术家在上海举办了他的首场演出，门票几分钟就售完了。

examples.en: Our new school campus is twice as large as the old one.
examples.zh: 我们的新校园是旧校园的两倍大。

examples.en: As a volunteer, we can help others and make friends with them.
examples.zh: 作为志愿者，我们要帮助别人，并与他们交朋友。

examples.en: On Sundays he gets up early as usual.
examples.zh: 星期天他像往常一样起得很早。

proverbs: As is well known, books teach us to learn life, truth, science and many other useful things. 众所周知，书籍教我们认识生命、真理、科学，以及其他许多有益的事物。

examples.en: Henry has travelled widely in Asia and knows a lot about different countries there.
examples.zh: 亨利在亚洲很多地方旅行过，对那里的不同国家了解很多。

examples.en: Don't always ask for advice from others. You should learn to decide everything by yourself.
examples.zh: 不要老是问别人的意见。你应该学会自己决定一切。

examples.en: The staff are asked to smile at every customer entering the store.
examples.zh: 要求员工对每一位进入商店的顾客微笑。

examples.en: This was the first time David was asked to join in an out-of-school activity.
examples.zh: 这是戴维第一次被邀请参加校外活动。

phrases: ask sb. for sth. 问某人要某物

examples.en: He works as an assistant to a manager.
examples.zh: 他的工作是经理助理。

senses.zh: 在(几点钟)；在(某处)；(表示动作的目标和方向)向，朝

examples.en: Could I have an early morning call at six o'clock tomorrow?
examples.zh: 我是否可以在明天6点钟电话叫早？

examples.en: We were told to turn right at the third traffic light.
examples.zh: 我们被告知在第三个红绿灯右转。

examples.en: He aimed at the target.
examples.zh: 他瞄准了靶子。

proverbs: What may be done at any time will be done at no time. 明日待明日，明日不再来。

examples.en: The enemy attacked us.
examples.zh: 敌人袭击了我们。

examples.en: The patient experienced a sudden asthma attack.
examples.zh: 病人突然哮喘发作。

examples.en: The teacher, as well as his students, was invited to attend the party last week.
examples.zh: 这位老师和他的学生被邀请参加上周的聚会。

examples.en: The news about education has attracted the public attention recently.
examples.zh: 最近有关教育的新闻引起了公众的注意。

examples.en: His attitude to life has changed a lot after the trip.
examples.zh: 那次旅行之后，他对生活的看法改变了许多。

examples.en: The Bund attracts many people with its beautiful night view.
examples.zh: 外滩以其美丽的夜景吸引了许多人。

derivations.zh: 吸引；吸引力；向往的地方

examples.en: The kids were very excited when they saw so many attractive cartoon characters in the amusement park.
examples.zh: 当孩子们在游乐园里看到这么多具有吸引力的卡通人物时，他们很激动。

examples.en: China is becoming more and more attractive to people around the world.
examples.zh: 对世界各地的人们来说，中国正在变得越来越有吸引力。

examples.en: His speech won the applause of the audience.
examples.zh: 他的演讲赢得了观众的掌声。

examples.en: Tourism is at its peak in August.
examples.zh: 八月迎来旅游的旺季高峰。

examples.en: Peter didn't buy the digital camera because his aunt had given him a new one.
examples.zh: 彼得没买这台数码相机，因为他的姨妈给了他一台新的。

examples.en: David's father has never been to Australia before, has he?
examples.zh: 戴维的父亲以前从没去过澳大利亚，是吗？

examples.en: He has many typical Australian habits.
examples.zh: 他有许多典型澳大利亚人的习惯。

examples.en: He is an Australian.
examples.zh: 他是澳大利亚人。

examples.en: This is an automatic door.
examples.zh: 这是自动门。

examples.en: Leaves fall off the trees in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天，叶子从树上掉落下来。

examples.en: This was the only available room.
examples.zh: 只剩下这个房间可用了。

examples.en: The movie card was no longer available, so I threw it away.
examples.zh: 电影卡不再能用了，所以我把它扔掉了。

examples.en: Our English teacher, a kind lady in her early forties, is of average height.
examples.zh: 我们的英语老师是一位四十出头的友善女士，个头中等。

examples.en: Her brother is above average in his reading ability.
examples.zh: 她哥哥的阅读能力在平均水平以上。

examples.en: To avoid being embarrassed, it's better to turn down his invitation with a good excuse.
examples.zh: 为了避免尴尬，最好找个好借口拒绝他的邀请。

notes: avoid 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握它的用法：avoid 后面跟动名词。

examples.en: Joe won an award for his contribution to football.
examples.zh: 乔因为对足球的贡献而获奖。

examples.en: This university awarded him an honorary degree.
examples.zh: 这所大学授予他荣誉学位。

examples.en: As far as I know, he will be away for three months.
examples.zh: 据我所知，他将离开3个月。

examples.en: Please walk as gently as possible because her two babies are sleeping in the room.
examples.zh: 走路时请尽量轻一点，因为她的两个孩子正在房间里睡觉。

examples.en: Old photos bring back memories of freedom and happiness.
examples.zh: 老照片唤起了人们对自由与欢乐的回忆。

examples.en: Three people can sit in the back of his car.
examples.zh: 他的汽车后排可以坐三个人。

examples.en: I wondered about the back story of that mysterious painting.
examples.zh: 我对那幅神秘画作背后的故事感到好奇。

examples.en: The mountains form a background to this photograph of the family.
examples.zh: 这幅家庭照以群山为背景。

senses.zh: 坏的; 有害的, 不利的; 糟糕的, 可惜的; 严重的

examples.en: How bad he is!
examples.zh: 他真坏!

examples.en: It's bad for your eyes.
examples.zh: 这对眼睛有害。

examples.en: It's too bad that Tim's uncle has formed an unhealthy habit of drinking and smoking.
examples.zh: 蒂姆的叔叔已养成了饮酒和吸烟的不良习惯, 这太糟糕了。

derivations.zh: 有害地; 非常; 严重地

senses.zh: 书包; 提包; 袋子

examples.en: He didn't want to tell me how much the bag cost.
examples.zh: 他不想告诉我这个包花了多少钱。

examples.en: This bakery is big.
examples.zh: 这家面包店很大。

examples.en: A small child has to learn to keep his balance before he can walk far.
examples.zh: 小孩要先学会保持平衡才能走远。

examples.en: He slipped and lost his balance.
examples.zh: 他一滑, 便失去了平衡。

examples.en: How big this ball is!
examples.zh: 这个球好大啊！

examples.en: Look! There is a balloon in the sky.
examples.zh: 看！天上有个气球。

examples.en: There is a banana on the desk.
examples.zh: 桌子上有根香蕉。

examples.en: Three banks were robbed by that robber so someone reported to the police about the robbery.
examples.zh: 那个劫匪抢劫了三家银行，于是有人向警方报了案。

examples.en: The swans gracefully swam along the bank.
examples.zh: 天鹅优雅地沿着河岸游水。

examples.en: There is a bar in the hotel.
examples.zh: 在这家酒店里有个酒吧。

examples.en: She ordered a protein bar to refuel after her workout.
examples.zh: 她锻炼后要了一根蛋白棒来补充能量。

examples.en: Many languages have Latin as their base.
examples.zh: 许多语言都是以拉丁语为基础的。

examples.en: You need the basic knowledge of IT to apply for this job.
examples.zh: 申请这份工作你需要具备基本的信息技术知识。

examples.en: Those baskets are full of fruits.
examples.zh: 那些篮子装满水果。

examples.en:
— Jack hurt his arms while playing basketball yesterday afternoon.
— I'm sorry to hear that.
examples.zh:
——杰克昨天下午打篮球时把手臂弄伤了。
——听到这个消息我很难过。

notes: basketball 是常考单词，所以学生一定要牢记：在球类的名词前不能用冠词。

examples.en: She has a bath every day.
examples.zh: 她每天洗澡。

examples.en: My cat sometimes tries to drink water from the bath.
examples.zh: 我的猫有时会试图喝浴缸里的水。

derivations.zh: 洗澡；用水清洗（尤指身体部位）

examples.en: I like my bathroom.
examples.zh: 我喜欢我的浴室。

examples.en: Among all the laptops, this one has the best battery life.
examples.zh: 在所有的笔记本电脑中，这一款的电池续航能力最佳。

examples.en: Many soldiers died in the battle.
examples.zh: 在这次战役中死了许多士兵。

senses.zh: 是；成为 (原形，其人称和时态形式有 am, is, are, was, were, being, been)

examples.en: I think he will be an astronaut.
examples.zh: 我认为他会成为一名宇航员。

examples.en: Congratulations! You've got a chance to be an exchange student.
examples.zh: 祝贺你！你有机会成为一名交换学生。

phrases: be aware of 意识到；觉察；知道

examples.en: What a sunny day it is today! Shall we have a picnic on the beach?
examples.zh: 今天的天气多么晴朗啊！我们去海滩野餐好吗？

examples.en: What a fierce bear it is!
examples.zh: 多凶猛的熊啊！

examples.en: The soldiers had to bear the extreme cold during their mission.
examples.zh: 士兵们在执行任务时不得不忍受极端的寒冷。

senses.zh: 敲打；跳动；打赢；(用叉等) 快速搅拌，打

examples.en: The strong winds began to beat against the doors and windows.
examples.zh: 强风开始拍打门窗。

examples.en: Beat the mixture until it was smooth and creamy.
examples.zh: 搅拌混合物直至丝滑的奶油状。

notes:
beat 是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其用法，及比较与 hit 的用法区别：
beat 表示接连地“打；敲”。
例如：beat sb. senseless 把某人打得失去知觉
The rain was beating against the window. 雨打在窗户上。
hit 表示用力地“打(一下)；击中”。
例如：I hit him a hard blow. 我重重给了他一拳。
He fired and hit the target. 他开枪射中了靶子。

examples.en: Bali is a beautiful place. It attracts a lot of tourists every year.
examples.zh: 巴厘岛是一个美丽的地方。它每年都吸引很多游客。

examples.en: The light music sounded very beautiful. I enjoyed every minute of it.
examples.zh: 这首轻音乐很动听。我沉醉其中。

examples.en: She sang beautifully while she was watching TV.
examples.zh: 她一边看电视，一边优美地歌唱。

examples.en: He was beginning to enjoy the beauties of nature.
examples.zh: 他要开始享受大自然之美。

examples.en: Please be brief because I am in a hurry.
examples.zh: 请长话短说，因为我有急事。

examples.en: The man is called “Wolf Dad” because of his cruel way of parenting.
examples.zh: 那个人被称作“狼爸”是因为他残酷的养育方式。

notes:
because 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其用法：
because 后面跟句子；because of 后面跟名词。
例如：The cars moved slowly because it snowed heavily.
= The cars moved slowly because of the heavy snow.
因为下大雪，汽车行驶得很慢。

examples.en: When people get older, their short-term memory becomes worse.
examples.zh: 当人老了的时候，他们的短期记忆会变差。

examples.en: The students of Class Three became excited when they won the football match.
examples.zh: 三班的学生赢得了这场足球赛，他们变得兴奋不已。

notes:
become 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其用法：become 后面跟形容词。
例如：He became very excited. 他变得很激动。

examples.en: Although Peter is five years old, he is learning to make the bed by himself.
examples.zh: 尽管彼得才 5 岁，他正在学习自己整理床铺。

phrases: make the bed 整理床铺

examples.en: Frank and Mary switch on the bedroom computer in the morning because they want to get the latest news.
examples.zh: 弗兰克和玛丽一早就打开卧室的电脑，因为他们想得到最新消息。

examples.en: Do you like stewed beef?
examples.zh: 你喜欢吃炖牛肉吗？

examples.en: My friend spent eighty yuan on the coat the day before yesterday.
examples.zh: 前天我的朋友花了 80 元买这件外套。

examples.en: Jack does exercise twice a day and he looks much healthier than before.
examples.zh: 杰克一天做两次运动，他看起来比以前健康多了。

examples.en: All the exercise books must be handed in before you leave school.
examples.zh: 所有练习本都必须在放学前交上来。

proverbs: Look before you leap. 三思而后行。

examples.en: He lives by begging.
examples.zh: 他靠乞讨为生。

phrases: beg your pardon 请原谅；请再说一遍

examples.en: She wanted to know when the program would begin.
examples.zh: 她想知道什么时候该方案将开始执行。

proverbs: Well begun is half done. 良好的开端是成功的一半。
_flags: OCR词形变化音标 begun /bi'gæn/ 有误，已修正为 begun /bi'gʌn/

examples.en: I have read the book from beginning to end.
examples.zh: 我把这本书从头到尾看完了。

examples.en: The students played a game at the beginning of the lesson.
examples.zh: 学生在开始上课时做了游戏。

examples.en: The teacher always tells his students to be on their best behaviour.
examples.zh: 这位老师总是教导学生要展现他们最好的一面。

examples.en: I am behind him in maths.
examples.zh: 我数学不如他。

examples.en: The car stopped so suddenly that the bus behind almost ran into it.
examples.zh: 这辆汽车突然刹停，后面那辆公共汽车差点儿撞到它。

examples.en: How long can a human being go without food?
examples.zh: 人不吃东西能活多久？

examples.en: That dishonest man often tells lies, and nobody believes him.
examples.zh: 那个不诚实的人经常撒谎，没有人相信他。

examples.en: Do you believe in the saying that honesty is the best policy?
examples.zh: 你相信“诚实为上策”这句谚语吗？

examples.en: There is a bell on the wall.
examples.zh: 墙上有个钟。

examples.en: Does this house belong to Mr. Winter?
examples.zh: 这幢房子是属于温特先生的吗？

examples.en: The keys belong in the drawer, not on the table.
examples.zh: 钥匙应该在抽屉里，而不是在桌子上。

examples.en: Please do not write below this line.
examples.zh: 请不要写在这条线下面。

notes:
below 是常考单词，学生一定要厘清 below 和 under 这两个词语的意思及用法：
below 表示“在……下面”，但不一定是指在某物的正下方，而是指低于某物，
其反义词是 above；under 表示“在……下方”，是指在某物的正下方，其反
义词是 over。
例如：The noise came from below the floor. 声音来自地板下面。
Shall I write my name on, above or below the line?
我该把名字签在横线线上、横线上方还是横线下方？
The bottle fell under the table. 瓶子掉到桌子底下了。

examples.en: He buckled the safety belt when the plane was making a landing.
examples.zh: 飞机降落时，他扣上了安全带。

examples.en: There is a big tree beside me.
examples.zh: 在我身旁有棵大树。

examples.en: She has three cousins besides Eddie.
examples.zh: 除了埃迪，她还有3个表兄弟。

examples.en: Besides me, there are many other students present.
examples.zh: 除了我，还有许多其他的学生出席。

examples.en: I don't want to go. Besides, I'm too tired.
examples.zh: 我不想去，再说我也太累了。

inflections.form: good /gud/ 和 well /wel/ 的最高级

examples.en: She is my best friend.
examples.zh: 她是我最好的朋友。

examples.en: The thing I liked best about the show was the music.
examples.zh: 这场演出中我最喜欢的是音乐。

examples.en: We offer only the best to our clients.
examples.zh: 我们只提供最好的东西给顾客。

proverbs: East or west, home is the best. 金窝、银窝，不如自己的草窝。

inflections.form: good 和 well 的比较级

examples.en: You must pay extra for a better seat.
examples.zh: 你要坐更好的位子就得加钱。

examples.en: Never mind, next time I'm sure you can do better.
examples.zh: 不要紧，我相信你下次一定能做得更好。

examples.en: You'd better go and see a doctor at once.
examples.zh: 你最好马上去看医生。

examples.en: We expect better of you in the future.
examples.zh: 我们期待你将来有更好的表现。

phrases: had better 最好还是；还是……好

examples.en: Can you tell me the difference between these two words?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我这两个单词之间的区别吗？

examples.en: Six-month-old babies are not old enough to tell the difference between need and want.
examples.zh: 6个月大的婴儿太小，无法区分需要和想要。
examples.rewrite: Six-month-old babies are too young to tell the difference between need and want.

examples.en: In my opinion, riding a bicycle will be more popular than driving a car in the future.
examples.zh: 在我看来，未来骑自行车会比驾驶汽车更受欢迎。

_flags: OCR 头部为合并词条，已拆分记录两个词头与两条音标

examples.en: Professor Lee gave us much advice on how to live a low carbon life in big cities.
examples.zh: 关于如何在大城市低碳生活，李教授给了我们许多建议。

examples.en: The suitcase is so big that they can't take it with them.
examples.zh: 手提箱太大了，他们不能随身携带。

examples.en: He never pays his bill on time.
examples.zh: 他从不按时支付账单。

examples.en: Please put the rubbish in the bin.
examples.zh: 请把垃圾放到垃圾箱里去。

examples.en: There are miles of grassland with no people, just trees and birds.
examples.zh: 绵延数英里的草原上没有人，只有树和鸟。

proverbs: Clumsy birds have to start flying early. 笨鸟先飞。
Kill two birds with one stone. 一箭双雕。

examples.en: My grandfather will celebrate his ninetieth birthday next month.
examples.zh: 我的爷爷下个月将要庆祝他的九十大寿。

examples.en: I got this nice present on my birthday.
examples.zh: 我在生日那天收到了这个漂亮的礼物。

examples.en: The children enjoy eating biscuits.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢吃饼干。

examples.en: Will you give me a bit of time?
examples.zh: 你能给我一点时间吗？

phrases: a bit (of) 有一点儿；稍微

examples.en: Babies who are getting new teeth like something hard to bite on.
examples.zh: 正在长牙齿的婴儿喜欢咬硬物。

examples.en: The sandwich was so big that she could only manage to take small bites.
examples.zh: 这个三明治太大了，她只能小口小口地吃。

examples.en: Which colour do you prefer, black or white?
examples.zh: 你更喜欢哪种颜色，黑色还是白色？

examples.en: This black bag may be that driver's.
examples.zh: 这个黑色的包可能是那个司机的。

examples.en: Mary had to wear her glasses so that she could see the words on the blackboard clearly.
examples.zh: 玛丽不得不戴上眼镜，这样她才能看清黑板上的字。

examples.en: Please give me a blanket.
examples.zh: 请给我一条毯子。

examples.en: His father is blind.
examples.zh: 他父亲是盲人。

examples.en: Many apps today are designed to assist the blind with daily tasks.
examples.zh: 如今，许多应用程序设计用来帮助盲人处理日常事务。

senses.zh: 一排房屋；街区（街道中间的区域）；大块

examples.en: He lives in that block.
examples.zh: 他住在那个街区。

examples.en: Get back, don't block the traffic.
examples.zh: 往后退，不要阻塞交通。

examples.en: There is some blood in the glass.
examples.zh: 玻璃杯里有些血。

examples.en: In spring the wind blows gently. It makes us feel so comfortable.
examples.zh: 春天里，风轻轻地吹。让我们感到很舒适。

examples.en: The gas leak could blow the whole building into pieces if it catches fire.
examples.zh: 如果燃气泄漏遇到明火，可能会把整栋楼炸成碎片。

examples.en: A woman in blue walked into the store.
examples.zh: 一位穿蓝色衣服的妇女走进商店。

examples.en: He has a dark blue shirt on.
examples.zh: 他穿了一件深蓝色衬衣。

examples.en: Will you help me to take the size of the board?
examples.zh: 帮我量一下这木板的尺寸好吗？

examples.en: Passengers must board the ship before 6:00 p.m.
examples.zh: 乘客必须在下午6点前上船。

examples.en: He has his own boat.
examples.zh: 他有他自己的小船。

examples.en: They boated us across the bay.
examples.zh: 他们划船把我们送过了海湾。

examples.en: A balanced diet provides nutrition for your body.
examples.zh: 均衡的饮食使你身体获得营养。

examples.en: I always boil water in this kettle.
examples.zh: 我总是用这个水壶烧水。

senses.zh: 预订，订(房间、车票、座位等)

examples.en: On the eighth page of the book, there is an encouraging story.
examples.zh: 在这本书的第8页，有一个令人鼓舞的故事。

examples.en:
— The musical Notre Dame de Paris is being staged in Shanghai Culture Square. Shall we book two tickets for the show?
— That's a good idea.
examples.zh:
——音乐剧《巴黎圣母院》正在上海文化广场上演。我们去预订两张票好吗？
——好主意。

proverbs: Books are our good teachers and wise friends. 书籍是我们的良师益友。

examples.en: I got really bored because I had nothing to do.
examples.zh: 我真的很无聊，因为无事可做。

derivations.zh: 乏味的；无聊的；令人厌烦的；没趣的

senses.zh: 乏味的；无聊的；令人厌烦的；没趣的

examples.en: Tom always tells us the same things whenever he meets. He is really boring.
examples.zh: 每当汤姆见到我们，他总是告诉我们同样的事情。他真的很无聊。

notes:
boring 是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其意思，及比较与 bored 的用法区别：
boring 用来形容事物，是指某事或某人本身令人感到厌烦、无趣。
bored 用来形容你对事物的感受，是指某人对某事或某人感到厌烦。

senses.zh: (动词 bear /beə(r)/ 的过去分词，仅用于被动语态 be born) 出生；出世

examples.en: Lucy and Linda are twins. They were born on the fourth of November.
examples.zh: 露西和琳达是一对双胞胎。她们出生于 11 月 4 日。

examples.en: This is a useful guidebook. I borrowed it from the school library.
examples.zh: 这是一本有用的指导手册。我从学校图书馆借来的。

notes:
borrow 是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其意思，及比较与 lend, keep 的用法区别：
borrow 是向别人借用不属于自己的东西，表示“借进”，其结构是：borrow sb.
sth. = borrow sth. from/of sb.，但不能与表示一段时间的状语连用。
lend 是将自己的东西借给别人使用，表示“借出”，其结构是：lend sb. sth. =
lend sth. to sb.，但不能与表示一段时间的状语连用。
keep 是表示“持有(某物)；保持(某种状态)”，可以与表示一段时间的状语连用。

examples.en: Do you know, he is the nicest boss I've had here.
examples.zh: 你知道吗，他是我到这儿工作后遇到的最好的上司。

senses.zh: (与复数名词连用) 两个；两个都；双方(都)

examples.en: Both men were Italian.
examples.zh: 两名男子都是意大利人。

examples.en: Both of them are PLA men.
examples.zh: 他们俩都是解放军战士。

examples.en: Tourists can enjoy wonderful views on both sides of the Huangpu River.
examples.zh: 游客可以欣赏黄浦江两岸的美妙景色。

examples.en: Mary reads both entertainment and business news.
examples.zh: 玛丽阅读娱乐和商业新闻。

notes:
both 是常考单词，常出现在改为否定句的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定
要牢记：both 的反义词是 neither，all 的反义词是 none。
例如：They both are editors of the school newspaper.
他们俩都是校报编辑。(改为否定句)
Neither of them is an editor of the school newspaper. 他们俩都不是校报编辑。

examples.en: How shall we deal with the waste paper, bottles and boxes?
examples.zh: 我们应如何处理这些废纸、瓶子和包装盒呢？

examples.en: Fill in your address at the bottom of the application form.
examples.zh: 把你的地址填写在申请表下端。

examples.en: He has a big bowl.
examples.zh: 他有个大碗。

examples.en: Mr. Smith bought three boxes of local snacks for the exchange students.
examples.zh: 史密斯先生为交换生买了 3 盒当地小吃。

examples.en: The boy collected some fallen leaves and made a nice artwork.
examples.zh: 这个男孩收集了一些落叶，做成了一件漂亮的艺术品。

examples.en: She has a good brain.
examples.zh: 她头脑聪明。

examples.en: We Chinese people are brave and industrious.
examples.zh: 我们中国人是勇敢勤劳的。

examples.en: Mark isn't feeling well now as he had too much bread just now.
examples.zh: 马克现在觉得不太舒服，因为他刚才吃了太多的面包。

examples.en: Little David hid all the broken pieces under the bed and denied breaking the vase with his basketball.
examples.zh: 小戴维把所有的碎片都藏在床底，并否认他用篮球打破了花瓶。

examples.en: Have a break.
examples.zh: 休息一下。

phrases: break down 损坏；衰弱下来
break into 闯入；破门而入
break out 突然开始；爆发
a fifteen-minute break 15 分钟的休息
take a lunch break 午休

examples.en: You had better let John buy milk and bread for breakfast himself. He’s ten years old now.
examples.zh: 早餐你最好让约翰自己去买牛奶和面包。他已经 10 岁了。

notes: 在三餐的名词前不用加冠词。

examples.en: If you get nervous, take a deep breath to calm yourself down.
examples.zh: 如果你感到紧张，就深呼吸让自己平静下来。

examples.en: You had to listen hard to hear the old man breathe.
examples.zh: 你要仔细听才能听见老人在呼吸。

senses.zh: 在……上架桥；消除隔阂/鸿沟

examples.en: The ancient Silk Road was a great success, like a bridge between East and West.
examples.zh: 古代丝绸之路是一项伟大的成就，宛如连接东西方的桥梁。

examples.en: The professor used humour to bridge the gap between complex theories and student understanding.
examples.zh: 这位教授用幽默架起了桥梁，消除了复杂理论和学生理解间的隔阂。

senses.zh: 明亮的；聪明的；灿烂的；快活而生气勃勃的

examples.en: What a bright idea!
examples.zh: 好主意！

examples.en: I will try my best to get a bright future.
examples.zh: 我会尽我所能去创造一个光明的未来。

examples.en: Will you bring your new book here? I’d like to have a look at it.
examples.zh: 你能把你的新书带来吗？我想看一看。

notes:
bring, take, fetch, carry 这四个词语的意思较相近，都有“拿”的意思，比较他们的用法区别：
bring 表示“带来”，就是从其他地方将东西拿到或带到说话人处。
take 表示“拿走”，就是从说话人处将东西拿走或带走。
fetch 表示“（去）拿来；（去）请来”，就是从说话人处出发到其他地方将某物拿到或请某人来到说话人处。
carry 表示“携带；运送；搬运”，不一定将某物拿到或某人带到说话人处，可以从任何地方到任何地方。

examples.en: He is from Britain.
examples.zh: 他从英国来。

examples.en: British people often begin their conversations by talking about the weather.
examples.zh: 英国人经常以谈论天气来开始他们的谈话。

examples.en: This is a traditional British cookery book.
examples.zh: 这是一本传统英式烹饪书。

examples.en: This role is played by seventeen-year-old Briton John Martin.
examples.zh: 这个角色由 17 岁的英国人约翰·马丁扮演。

examples.en: The radio station sets up an overseas broadcast program.
examples.zh: 电台新设置了一个对外广播节目。

examples.en: My brother likes drawing very much and his dream is to become an architect.
examples.zh: 我的弟弟非常喜欢画画，他的梦想是成为一名建筑师。

examples.en: In autumn the leaves change from green to brown.
examples.zh: 秋天，树叶由绿色变为褐色。

examples.en: Have you seen the man in the picture? He is thin and of average height with a brown jacket.
examples.zh: 你见过照片上的人吗？他很瘦，中等身高，穿棕色夹克。

examples.en: Have you brushed your teeth?
examples.zh: 你刷牙了吗？

examples.en: I have a brush.
examples.zh: 我有一把刷子。

examples.en: More underground railways will be built in Shanghai in the years to come.
examples.zh: 未来几年上海将建造更多的地铁。

examples.en: On the top of the building you can have a bird's eye view of the whole city.
examples.zh: 在楼顶，你可以俯瞰整个城市。

examples.en: Many buildings along the Bund in Shanghai were built in the 1920s or 1930s.
examples.zh: 上海沿外滩的许多建筑建于20世纪二三十年代。

examples.en: People used to burn an oil lamp to get light.
examples.zh: 从前人们点油灯照明。

proverbs: We should learn a lesson from this incident: He who plays with fire will surely get burnt. 我们应该从这次事件中吸取教训：玩火者必自焚。

examples.en: He asked the government to improve school bus safety.
examples.zh: 他要求政府改善校车的安全。

examples.en: I have two cell phones. One is for business; the other is for private matters.
examples.zh: 我有两部手机。一部用于工作，另一部用于私人事务。

examples.en: He was born to be a successful businessman.
examples.zh: 他天生就是一个成功的商人。

examples.en: My mum is busy making a pizza. She needs some help, doesn't she?
examples.zh: 我妈妈正忙着做一个比萨饼。她需要一些帮助，不是吗？

phrases: be busy with/doing sth. 忙于做某事
keep sb. busy 让某人忙个不停

examples.en: Money is important, but it can’t buy everything.
examples.zh: 钱很重要，但它不能买到一切。

examples.en: The doctors tried their best to save the patient’s life, but failed.
examples.zh: 医生们竭尽全力挽救患者的生命，但是失败了。

notes:
but是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其用法，及比较与however的用法区别：
but是连词，后面不用加逗号。
however是副词，通常放在句首，后面要加逗号。

examples.en: Add the butter last.
examples.zh: 最后加上黄油。

examples.en: Jenney’s father has a collection of beautiful butterflies.
examples.zh: 詹尼的父亲收藏了许多美丽的蝴蝶。

examples.en: There is a button on the wall.
examples.zh: 墙上有一个按钮。

examples.en: I bought a new flat in Puxi last year. It is on the ninth floor.
examples.zh: 去年我在浦西买了一套新房子。这套房子在9楼。

examples.en: If the prices come down in a few years, I will buy a car for myself.
examples.zh: 几年后如果价格降下来，我会给自己买一辆车。

notes:
buy是常考时态的瞬间动词，所以学生一定要知道瞬间动词不能和for加
一段时间构成完成时态。瞬间动词与状态性动词的转换如下：
The film began ten minutes ago. → The film has been on for ten minutes.
He joined the army two years ago. → He has been in/served in the army for two years.
She became a teacher three years ago. → She has been a/worked as a teacher for three
years.
He borrowed a book a week ago. → He has kept the book for a week.
He died two days ago. → He has been dead for two days.
He bought a book the day before yesterday. → He has had the book for two days.
He left Shanghai last year. → He has been away from Shanghai for a year.

senses.zh: 靠近；在……旁边；在……时间；不迟于；（用于被动语态）被；（表示手段、方法）用；由；（用交通工具等）乘(车)

examples.en: On a cold evening it is pleasant to sit by the fire.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的夜晚坐在炉火旁边很舒服。

examples.en: She should be back by now.
examples.zh: 她现在应该回来了。

examples.en: By the end of last term, the students of Class One had finished three projects.
examples.zh: 到上学期末，1 班的学生完成了 3 个项目。

examples.en: Tom is reading a 60-word composition. It was written all by himself.
examples.zh: 汤姆正在读一篇 60 个字的作文。这篇作文是他本人写的。

examples.en: Look up the word in the dictionary, and you’ll get the meaning by yourselves.
examples.zh: 在词典里查查这个单词，你们会知道它的意思。

examples.en: You can improve your spoken English by using it more and more.
examples.zh: 英语说得越多，你就越能提高你的英语口语水平。

examples.en: Are you going there by bike or by bus?
examples.zh: 你骑车还是坐车去那里？

examples.en: More and more people in Shanghai choose to go to work by underground.
examples.zh: 在上海越来越多的人选择乘地铁上班。

phrases: by the way 顺便说；顺便问一下

examples.en: I have to say good-bye to everybody.
examples.zh: 我不得不和大家说再见了。

examples.en: He grows cabbages on his farm.
examples.zh: 他在自家农场里种卷心菜。

examples.en: We went into the café for coffee and dessert yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我们到咖啡馆喝了咖啡，吃了点心。

examples.en: Mike’s mother bought him a big cake on his birthday.
examples.zh: 迈克生日那天，他妈妈给他买了一个大蛋糕。

senses.zh: 打电话给……；称呼；取名；呼唤；喊；叫

examples.en: Please call me when you get home.
examples.zh: 你到家时请给我打个电话。

examples.en: Computers are super calculators, we usually call them electronic brains.
examples.zh: 电脑是超级计算器，我们通常称它们为电子大脑。

examples.en: Rafe Esquith is called the most interesting classroom teacher in the U.S.A.
examples.zh: 雷夫·艾斯奎斯被称为美国最有趣的课堂老师。

examples.en: The charity called for immediate action to help homeless pets.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构呼吁立即采取行动帮助无家可归的宠物。

examples.en: I gave him a phone call yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天给他打电话了。

examples.en: The sea is now calm.
examples.zh: 海现在平静了。

examples.en: I think everybody should just calm down.
examples.zh: 我想每个人都应该冷静下来。

examples.en: Now a camera does not cost much and most young people are certainly able to pay for it.
examples.zh: 现在照相机花费不多，所以绝大多数年轻人都能买得起。

examples.en: Shall we join in the Green World Summer Camp?
examples.zh: 我们参加绿色世界夏令营好吗？

examples.en: They brought all the necessary supplies to camp comfortably in the wilderness.
examples.zh: 他们带了必要的物资，以便在野外能舒适地露营。

examples.en: My son likes reading stories. Now he can tell a story as well as his sister.
examples.zh: 我儿子喜欢阅读故事。现在，他的故事可以讲得和他姐姐一样好。

examples.en: This can holds five litres of water.
examples.zh: 这个容器可装 5 升水。

examples.en: Canada has ten provinces.
examples.zh: 加拿大有 10 个省。

examples.en: My brother has studied in a university in Canada for three years. He will come back to China next week.
examples.zh: 我哥哥在加拿大一所大学学习了 3 年。他将于下周回中国。

examples.en: He went to Canada several years ago. Now he is a Canadian citizen.
examples.zh: 几年前他去了加拿大。他现在是加拿大公民。

examples.en: The Canadian won the championship in this event at the Olympics.
examples.zh: 那位加拿大人赢得了奥运会这个项目的冠军。

examples.en: We shouldn't hurry all the way to the airport, the flight was cancelled because of the foggy weather.
examples.zh: 我们不应该急着去机场，因为有雾，航班被取消了。

examples.en: Beijing is the capital of China.
examples.zh: 北京是中国的首都。

examples.en: The capital of Hainan Province is Haikou.
examples.zh: 海南省的省会是海口。

senses.zh: 船长；（尤指运动队的）队长

examples.en: Tom Zhu is a captain.
examples.zh: 汤姆·朱是一位船长。

examples.en: What terrible news it is! Three people died in the car accident.
examples.zh: 多么可怕的消息！有3人在车祸中丧生。

examples.en: A nice card was chosen for his mother by John on Mother's Day.
examples.zh: 在母亲节，约翰为妈妈选了一张漂亮的贺卡。

examples.en: Without great care, the old man's condition may become even worse.
examples.zh: 如果不多加照料，这位老人的状况可能会变得更糟。

examples.en: I don't care whether he comes or not.
examples.zh: 我不介意他来不来。

derivations.zh: 粗心的；不小心的；不仔细的

phrases: with great care 非常小心
proverbs: Care and diligence bring luck. 谨慎勤奋，好运自来。

examples.en: Be careful while getting off the train. The ground is wet.
examples.zh: 下车时要小心，地面是湿的。

examples.en: Little Tom was sleeping while everybody else was listening to the teacher carefully.
examples.zh: 小汤姆在睡觉，而其他人都在认真听老师讲课。

senses.zh: 粗心的；不小心的；不仔细的

examples.en: It's known to all that careless drivers are a danger to both themselves and others.
examples.zh: 大家都知道，粗心的司机对自己和他人都是危险的。

examples.en: I'll have some more carrots.
examples.zh: 我还要一些胡萝卜。

senses.zh: 拿，搬，提，抬，背，抱；携带；运送等

examples.en: Airplanes carry passengers.
examples.zh: 飞机运送乘客。

examples.en: Nowadays science fiction isn't as popular as cartoon among teenagers.
examples.zh: 如今在青少年中，科幻小说不像漫画那样受欢迎。

senses.zh: 情况；事例；实例；案件；箱；盒

examples.en: It isn't the case.
examples.zh: 情况不是这样的。

examples.en: The case is so heavy that I can't move it out of the room alone.
examples.zh: 这箱子太重了，我一个人没法把它从房间搬出去。
examples.rewrite: The case is too heavy for me to move out of the room alone.

phrases: in case 以防；以防万一

examples.en: I love cats.
examples.zh: 我爱猫。

senses.zh: 接住；捉住；赶上(车辆等)；染上(疾病)；弄清楚；领会；理解

examples.en: He caught a huge fish.
examples.zh: 他抓了一条大鱼。

examples.en: If we want to catch that train, we'd better set off for the station right now.
examples.zh: 如果想赶上那班火车，我们最好现在动身去车站。

examples.en: Don't take off your coat, Tom! It's easy to catch cold in spring.
examples.zh: 汤姆，别脱外套！春天很容易着凉。

phrases: catch up with sb. 赶上某人

examples.en: These causes led to a bad result.
examples.zh: 这些原因导致了不良后果。

examples.en: Many people are passionate about environmental causes.
examples.zh: 许多人对环境事业充满热情。

examples.en: The child's headache may be caused by stress.
examples.zh: 那孩子的头疼可能是紧张引起的。

examples.en: They put the food at the entrance to the cave.
examples.zh: 他们把食物放在洞口。

examples.en: How did you celebrate your fourteenth birthday?
examples.zh: 你是怎么庆祝你的十四岁生日的？

examples.en: It costs 10 cents.
examples.zh: 它值 10 美分。

examples.en: He is the centre of this event.
examples.zh: 他是这次事件的核心人物。

examples.en: At the beginning of last century, people in China lived in darkness.
examples.zh: 在上个世纪初，中国人民生活在黑暗中。

examples.en: We can certainly have the job finished on time.
examples.zh: 我们肯定能按时完成任务。

examples.en: He now owns a chain of 970 food stores.
examples.zh: 他现在拥有 970 家连锁食品店。

examples.en: A chair consists of a seat with a back.
examples.zh: 椅子是由椅座和椅背组成的。

examples.en: He accepted his friend's challenge to swim across the river.
examples.zh: 他接受朋友提出的挑战，游过这条河。

examples.en: I did not think he was right, so I challenged him.
examples.zh: 我认为他是不对的，因此向他提出质疑。

phrases: meet/face a new challenge 面临一个新挑战

examples.en: We should improve ourselves by taking every chance to try more new things.
examples.zh: 我们应该抓住每一个机会去尝试更多新事物，以此提升自我。

senses.zh: 改变，变化；更换；兑换（零钱）

examples.en: At that time, the event seemed unimportant, but it changed history.
examples.zh: 在那个时候，这件事看似无关紧要，却改写了历史。

examples.en: Many old people find it difficult to cope with changes.
examples.zh: 许多老人难以适应变化。

examples.en: Keep the change.
examples.zh: 不用找零了。

phrases: change one's mind 改变主意

examples.en: The weather was changeable last month and many people fell ill with cold and flu.
examples.zh: 上个月天气多变，很多人患了感冒和流感。

examples.en: He changed many channels but still couldn't find any interesting programmes.
examples.zh: 他调了许多频道，但是仍然找不到任何有趣的节目。

senses.zh: 性格；特性；特征，特点；角色

examples.en: What kind of character do you think you have?
examples.zh: 你认为自己具有什么样的性格？

examples.en: She played the character of a brave warrior in the movie.
examples.zh: 她在电影中扮演的角色是一位勇敢的战士。

examples.en: The ward of the hospital is in the charge of Dr. Green.
examples.zh: 医院的这间病房由格林医生负责。

phrases: in charge of 主管，负责
take charge of 负责，管理

examples.en: We have decided to try our best to raise more money for the local charity.
examples.zh: 我们已经决定尽力为当地慈善机构筹集更多的钱。

examples.en: She said she would like to have a chat with me.
examples.zh: 她说她想跟我聊一聊。

examples.en: It's too noisy here. Let's find a quieter place to chat.
examples.zh: 这里太吵闹，让我们找个安静点的地方谈谈。

examples.en: The pad made last year is a lot cheaper than the one made this year.
examples.zh: 去年生产的垫子比今年生产的便宜很多。

senses.zh: 检查；批改；支票；方格图案；格子
核对；检查；查明；查看；核实

examples.en: Can I pay by check or credit card?
examples.zh: 我能用支票或信用卡支付吗？

examples.en: The boy checked his test paper carefully enough in order to get full marks.
examples.zh: 为了获得满分，这个男孩仔细检查了他的试卷。

phrases: check in 办理登机；登记(入住等)
check out 察看，观察(有趣或有吸引力的人或事物)；借阅；借出；退房

examples.en: He's always full of cheer at Christmas.
examples.zh: 圣诞节时，他总是兴致勃勃。

examples.en: The leading actor felt happy when he saw a lot of people cheering him.
examples.zh: 看到很多人为他喝彩，这位男主角感到很高兴。

examples.en: The cheese cake tasted so delicious that the kids asked for more.
examples.zh: 这奶酪蛋糕真好吃，孩子们还想要。

examples.en: The students are doing experiments in the lab with some new chemicals.
examples.zh: 学生正在实验室里用一些新的化学品做实验。

examples.en: Qi Yu hopes to do some chemical research in the near future.
examples.zh: 齐宇希望在不久的将来做一些化学研究。

examples.en: We make experiments in chemistry every day.
examples.zh: 我们每天都做化学实验。

examples.en: In fact, I don't find chemistry interesting.
examples.zh: 事实上，我不觉得化学有趣。

examples.en: Two chess players are playing chess in the park.
examples.zh: 两位棋手在公园下棋。

examples.en: Mary and Alice like eating chicken, but neither of them likes eating fish.
examples.zh: 玛丽和爱丽丝喜欢吃鸡肉，但她们都不喜欢吃鱼。

notes:
chicken 在初中阶段学到的，既可作可数名词，又可作不可数名词，比如：
chicken(鸡肉) → chickens(鸡)，前者不可数，而后者可数，相似用法列举如下：
chocolate(巧克力) → chocolates(巧克力糖)
exercise(锻炼) → exercises(练习)
experience(经验) → experiences(经历)
fish(鱼肉) → fishes(鱼)
glass(玻璃) → glasses(眼镜/玻璃杯)
paper(纸) → papers(论文；试卷)
room(空间) → rooms(房间)
time(时间) → times(次数)
wood(木头) → woods(树林)
work(工作) → works(工程；工场；全套物品)

examples.en: His father is the chief engineer of the building project.
examples.zh: 他父亲是这项建筑工程的总工程师。

examples.en: The chief told him to lead them to the house.
examples.zh: 领导叫他带他们到那栋房子去。

examples.en: In winter the more heavily it snows, the happier the children will feel.
examples.zh: 在冬季雪下得越大，孩子们越感到开心。

proverbs: Children and fools speak the truth. 童言无忌。

examples.en: He had an unhappy childhood because he was poor and no one took care of him.
examples.zh: 他有一个不幸的童年，因为穷，且没有人照顾他。

examples.en: We feel so excited to hear that China has sent its first space laboratory, Tiangong-1 into orbit successfully.
examples.zh: 得知中国发射的第一个空间实验室“天宫1号”成功进入轨道，我们感到非常兴奋。

derivations.zh: 中国的；中国人的；汉语的

examples.en: Judy collects blue-and-white china.
examples.zh: 朱迪收集青花瓷器。

senses.zh: 中国的；中国人的；汉语的

examples.en: Some people enjoy McDonald's hamburgers, but others prefer Chinese fast food.
examples.zh: 有些人喜欢麦当劳的汉堡包，但另一些人喜欢中式快餐。

examples.en: I am proud that I'm a Chinese.
examples.zh: 我为我是中国人而骄傲。

examples.en: There are many chocolates in the fridge.
examples.zh: 冰箱里有许多巧克力。

senses.zh: 选择；挑选；抉择；入选者；被选中的东西

examples.en: Life is simple. You make choices, and you don't look back.
examples.zh: 生活很简单。你做出选择，就不要回头。

examples.en: The team has no choice but to stay late at the office to finish the project.
examples.zh: 团队别无选择，只能在办公室加班到很晚来完成这个项目。

phrases: have no choice but to do 别无选择；只能

examples.en: I chose the flat on the ninth floor because I think "9" stands for "long lasting".
examples.zh: 我选择了9楼的公寓，因为我认为“9”代表“持久”。

examples.en: He can barely use chopsticks.
examples.zh: 他几乎不会用筷子。

examples.en: We always say "Merry Christmas" to each other at Christmas.
examples.zh: 在圣诞节，我们总是互相说“圣诞快乐”。

examples.en: We always go to my parents' house on Christmas Eve.
examples.zh: 在平安夜，我们总是去我父母家。

notes:
Christmas 是常考单词，学生必须掌握其固定搭配：
at Christmas 在圣诞节
on Christmas Day 在圣诞节那天
on Christmas Eve 在圣诞节前夕；在圣诞夜

examples.en: My friends were showing some foreigners around the ancient church this time yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天的这个时候，我的朋友们正在陪一些外国人参观古老的教堂。

_flags: OCR音标 /tʃʌtʃ/ 明显有误，已修正为 /tʃɜːtʃ/

examples.en: What's on at the cinema today?
examples.zh: 今天电影院放映什么电影？

examples.en: When I got to the cinema, the film had been on for five minutes.
examples.zh: 我到电影院时，电影已经开始5分钟了。

senses.zh: 将……圈起来；(尤指在空中)盘旋，环行

examples.en: Draw a circle.
examples.zh: 画一个圆。

examples.en: This is the road that circles the city.
examples.zh: 这就是那条环城路。

examples.en: The birds circled around the tree before landing on its branches.
examples.zh: 鸟儿在树上盘旋了几圈，然后落在树枝上。

examples.en: It's a duty for citizens to stop pollution for a better Earth.
examples.zh: 为了一个更美好的地球，制止污染是公民的责任。

examples.en: Miss Li has taught English in this school since she moved to this city from her hometown.
examples.zh: 自从李小姐从家乡搬到这座城市，她就一直在这所学校教英语。

examples.en: Would you please tell me when we will have our class meeting?
examples.zh: 请你告诉我，我们什么时候开班会？

examples.en: The students are busy with the survey on their classmates' spending habits.
examples.zh: 这些学生正忙于调查他们同班同学的消费习惯。

examples.en: When I got to the classroom just now, I found that Tom was working on a math problem.
examples.zh: 我到教室时，发现汤姆正在演算一道数学题。

examples.en: Betty can't join us in the card game. She is cleaning the classroom.
examples.zh: 贝蒂不能参加我们的纸牌游戏。她正在打扫教室。

examples.en: Nancy always keeps her room spotlessly clean and free of any mess.
examples.zh: 南希总是把她的房间保持得一尘不染，毫不杂乱。

senses.zh: 清晰的；明亮的；清楚的；听得清的；明白的
清除(不需要的东西), 移走; 清扫

examples.en: It's great fun to watch the beautiful stars in the sky on clear nights in autumn.
examples.zh: 在秋季晴朗的夜晚观看空中美丽的星星, 这是非常有趣的。

examples.en: She made it clear that she wanted to join the school basketball team.
examples.zh: 她明确表示自己想加入校篮球队。

examples.en: Please clear away all that rubbish.
examples.zh: 请把那些垃圾全部清除掉。

derivations.zh: 清晰地; 明亮地; 清楚地

notes:
clear是常考单词, 与clean一样, 既可作动词, 又可作形容词。比较其用法区别:
clear作动词时, 意为“扫清”, 表示将多余的、不需要的东西拿走或清除; 作形容词时, 意为“清晰的、明亮的”。
clean作动词时, 意为“打扫干净”, 表示可以用水将某物洗干净; 作形容词时, 意为“清洁的、干净的”。

senses.zh: 清晰地; 明亮地; 清楚地

examples.en: You need to explain your opinions quite clearly when having a debate.
examples.zh: 辩论时, 你需要很清楚地解释你的观点。

examples.en: He is a clerk of that department store.
examples.zh: 他是那家百货商店的店员。

examples.en: She is the cleverest girl in her class.
examples.zh: 她是她班上最聪明的女孩。

examples.en: Reading can make us become knowledgeable and clever.
examples.zh: 阅读能使我们知识渊博, 变得聪明。

senses.zh: (在计算机屏幕上用鼠标) 点击, 单击

examples.en: The box closed with a click.
examples.zh: 盒子咔嗒一声关上了。

examples.en: Click the square icon again to minimize the window.
examples.zh: 再次点击正方形图标, 把窗口最小化。

examples.en: They were excited after they climbed up to the top of the mountain.
examples.zh: 他们爬上山顶后非常兴奋。

examples.en: You’d better go to the clinic and have a thorough check.
examples.zh: 你最好去诊所，做一个彻底检查。

examples.en: Big Ben is a famous clock in London.
examples.zh: 大本钟是伦敦一座著名的钟。

examples.en: Would you be kind enough to close the window?
examples.zh: 请你把窗户关上好吗？

examples.en: I was lucky enough to have a close relationship with my parents.
examples.zh: 我很幸运能与父母关系亲密。

examples.en: He was sitting close to the stranger.
examples.zh: 他紧靠那位陌生人坐着。

examples.en: Is it necessary for us to try on clothes before buying them?
examples.zh: 我们有必要在买衣服之前试穿吗？

notes:
clothes 是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其用法，及比较与 cloth, clothing 的用法区别：
clothes 是复数名词，表示衣服，前面不能用数量词和不定冠词，但可以用 some, these, those, many, (a) few, a suit of 等词语来修饰。
cloth 是不可数名词，表示衣料，布匹，前面只能用 a piece of, three yards of 等词语来修饰。
clothing 是不可数名词，表示衣服，前面可以用 winter, articles of 等词语来修饰。
常与动词 buy, donate, provide 等搭配。

examples.en: There are so many clouds today.
examples.zh: 今天云特别多。

examples.en: I like the cloudy sky very much.
examples.zh: 我非常喜欢多云的天空。

notes: cloudy 是常考单词，由名词 cloud + y 转换为形容词。学生一定要牢记在中考词汇中类似这种转换的有关天气的名词，如：fog—foggy, rain—rainy, snow—snowy, sun—sunny, wind—windy

examples.en:
— How about making a poster to introduce our club?
— Are you kidding? It’s a waste of time and money.
examples.zh:
——制作一张海报，介绍我们的俱乐部如何？
——你在开玩笑吧？这是浪费时间和金钱。

examples.en: Mom, what should we buy for Dad, a shirt or a coat?
examples.zh: 妈妈，我们应该给爸爸买什么？一件衬衫还是一件外套？

examples.en: One of the household robots makes coffee for Mary and Frank.
examples.zh: 其中一个家庭机器人在为玛丽和弗兰克煮咖啡。

examples.en: His hobby is to collect coins from different countries.
examples.zh: 他的业余爱好是收集不同国家的硬币。

examples.en: What a cold day it is! We’d better turn on the air-conditioner.
examples.zh: 今天好冷啊！我们最好开空调。

examples.en: A cold kept him in bed for three days.
examples.zh: 感冒使他卧床3天。

examples.en: By the end of last month, we had collected enough money to help Linda’s mother.
examples.zh: 到上个月月底，我们已经募集到足够的钱，以帮助琳达的母亲。

examples.en: Huge amounts of information about pollution was collected by the scientist last year.
examples.zh: 去年，这位科学家收集了大量有关污染的信息。

examples.en: Shanghai Museum has a large collection of works of art from home and abroad.
examples.zh: 上海博物馆收藏了大量的国内外艺术品。

examples.en: Our daughter is going to college in autumn.
examples.zh: 我们的女儿秋天就要上大学了。

examples.en: I don’t like the colour of the scarf. Please show me another one.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢这条围巾的颜色。请再给我看一条。

examples.en: Colour it.
examples.zh: 为它涂上颜色。

derivations.zh: 颜色鲜艳的；五彩缤纷的

examples.en: Never give up trying, and success will finally come to you.
examples.zh: 永不放弃尝试，成功最终会来到你的身边。

phrases: come on 快；走吧；跟我来
come to an end 结束
come up with 想出（主意或计划）；提出；赶上
How come? 怎么回事？怎么发生的？

examples.en: I feel comfortable talking with that nice girl.
examples.zh: 和那个可爱的女孩谈话我感觉很好。

senses.zh: 普通的，一般的；共有的，共同的；常见的

examples.en: It's common knowledge that the sun sets down in the west.
examples.zh: 夕阳西下，这是常识。

phrases: have ... in common 有相同的特征

senses.zh: 交流；沟通；交际；传达（感情、信息等）

examples.en: The foreign visitor could speak only a little Chinese, but he managed to communicate with us.
examples.zh: 这位外国游客只会说一点中文，却成功地与我们进行了交流。

derivations.zh: 爱说话的；好社交的；健谈的；通信的

examples.en: The volunteers have offered a lot to the community for nearly ten years.
examples.zh: 近10年来，志愿者为社区提供了许多服务。

examples.en: He refuses to join any community.
examples.zh: 他拒绝参加任何社团。

examples.en: The general manager of that new company is quite a young lady.
examples.zh: 那家新公司的总经理是一位很年轻的女士。

examples.en: He decided to keep company with her while she waited for the bus.
examples.zh: 他决定陪她等公交。

examples.en: It is hard to compare.
examples.zh: 很难比较。

phrases: compare A with B 把 A 和 B 作比较

examples.en: Her success in the competition made her parents very proud.
examples.zh: 她在比赛中的成功让父母感到无比骄傲。

examples.en: Do you think it is useful to complain about the current situation?
examples.zh: 你认为抱怨现状有用吗？

examples.en: They could do nothing but complain.
examples.zh: 他们只能抱怨。

senses.zh: 完成的；完整的，(用以强调) 完全的，彻底的

examples.en: The doctor advised me to take a complete rest.
examples.zh: 医生让我彻底休息。

examples.en: On February 29, the world's tallest broadcast tower, the Tokyo Skytree, was finally completed. 2
examples.zh: 月29日，世界上最高的广播塔“东京晴空塔”终于完工了。

derivations.zh: (用以强调) 完全地，完整地，彻底地

senses.zh: (用以强调) 完全地，完整地，彻底地

examples.en: I completely agree that healthy living habits help people balance work and play.
examples.zh: 我完全赞同健康的生活习惯有助于人们平衡工作与娱乐。

examples.en: Computer is more popular than any other subject.
examples.zh: 计算机比其他学科更受欢迎。
examples.rewrite: Computer is the most popular of all the subjects.

examples.en: Computers work accurately. They seldom give wrong answers, do they?
examples.zh: 电脑运行准确。他们很少给出错误的答案，是吗？

examples.en: We can't go to the concert because we are quite busy now.
examples.zh: 我们不能去听音乐会，因为我们现在很忙。

examples.en: All of us come to a conclusion that we should work better as a team.
examples.zh: 我们所有人得出一个结论——作为一个团队，我们应该更好地合作。

examples.en: I found the conclusion of his book very interesting.
examples.zh: 我觉得他这本书的结尾很有趣。

examples.en: She will leave Shanghai to attend an important conference in the U.S.A. the week after next.
examples.zh: 她将离开上海去参加一个下下周在美国举行的重要会议。

examples.en: They had every confidence of success.
examples.zh: 他们对成功充满信心。

examples.en: I feel quite confident that I will pass the Chinese exam this time.
examples.zh: 我觉得很有信心，我会通过这次语文考试。

examples.en: Practice made her more confident in her public speaking skills.
examples.zh: 练习让她对自己的公众演讲技巧更有信心。

examples.en: They asked so many questions that they confused me.
examples.zh: 他们问了许多问题，都把我弄糊涂了。

derivations.zh: (某人感到) 迷惑的；糊涂的
(某事) 难以理解的；不清楚的

examples.en: Congratulations! It is the twelfth time that you have been praised this term.
examples.zh: 恭喜你！这是你这学期第 12 次获得表扬。

examples.en: You must connect this wire with that one.
examples.zh: 你必须把这根电线和那根接起来。

phrases: be connected to/with 与……有联系

examples.en: I'm considering starting my own business someday.
examples.zh: 我一直在考虑有一天自己创业。

examples.en: Bob is considered the most hardworking of all the students in his class.
examples.zh: 大家认为鲍勃是他们班所有学生中最勤奋的。

notes:
consider 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其用法：
consider 后面跟疑问代词+不定式。例如：
I am considering what to do after supper. 我正在考虑吃过晚饭做什么。
consider 后面跟动名词，例如：
Have you considered hiring a car? 你考虑过租辆车吗？

examples.en: The entire world consists of matter.
examples.zh: 整个世界都是由物质组成的。

examples.en: Even if we cannot agree, we should maintain our contact.
examples.zh: 即使我们不能取得一致，我们也要保持联系。

examples.en: I'll tell our manager about it and ask him to contact you.
examples.zh: 我会将有关情况告诉我们的经理并且请他和您联系。

examples.en: Luckily, Charlie got the first prize in the English speech contest.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，查理获得了英语演讲比赛一等奖。

examples.en: The cold wave will continue.
examples.zh: 寒潮还将继续。

examples.en: I couldn't control myself, and I hit him.
examples.zh: 我控制不住就打了他。

examples.en: The situation is getting out of control.
examples.zh: 局势正在失控。

examples.en: Shopping online is a useful and convenient way for us to buy things.
examples.zh: 对我们来说，网购是一种实用、便利的购物方式。

examples.en: Life in 2050 will be more convenient because robots will be able to help us with a lot of work. 2050
examples.zh: 年的生活将会更便利，因为机器人可以帮助我们做很多工作。

senses.zh: 会话，谈话，(非正式) 交谈

examples.en: Conversation is one of the pleasures of life.
examples.zh: 交谈是人生一大乐趣。

_flags: OCR音标 /kən've:sə:ʃən/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ˌkɒnvə'seɪʃn/

examples.en: The cook is in charge of the kitchen helper.
examples.zh: 这位厨师负责管理厨工。

examples.en: My mother cooked food for us as soon as she came back from work yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我妈妈一下班回来就为我们做饭。

examples.en: How cool your new phone is! I want to have the same one.
examples.zh: 你那新手机多酷啊！我想买个和你一样的。

examples.en: He used a fan to help cool the room during the heatwave.
examples.zh: 在热浪期间，他用风扇帮房间降温。

senses.zh: 抄本, 副本; (书、报纸等的) 一本 (份、册……)
抄写; 复印; (计算机用语) 拷(备份); 模仿; 抄袭

examples.en: The book Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone sold hundreds of millions of copies.
examples.zh: 《哈利・波特与魔法石》这本书卖出了上亿册。

examples.en: A child copies his example.
examples.zh: 孩子学他的模样。

examples.en: Don't copy.
examples.zh: 不要抄袭。

examples.en: I drop the letter in the mailbox on the corner.
examples.zh: 我把信投在拐角处的邮箱里。

senses.zh: 正确的, 对的; 恰当的; 准确无误的

examples.en: We've got four different answers to that question, but none of them is correct.
examples.zh: 那个问题我们有 4 个不同的答案, 但没有一个是正确的。

examples.en: Your homework is well done. Just correct some small mistakes in it.
examples.zh: 你的作业做得很好。只要改正其中的一些小错误。

examples.en: The writer expresses himself correctly in English.
examples.zh: 作家用英语正确地表达自己的意思。

examples.en: The new type of bicycle cost him about 1,000 yuan, but he thought it was worth buying.
examples.zh: 这辆新型自行车花了他 1000 元左右, 但他认为值得购买。

examples.en: It cost him a great deal of time to complete the project.
examples.zh: 他花了大量时间来完成这个项目。

examples.en: The cost of living in the city is much higher than in the suburbs.
examples.zh: 城市的生活成本比郊区高得多。

senses.zh: 棉花; 棉织物; 棉布

examples.en: This shirt is made of cotton.
examples.zh: 这件衬衣是棉布的。

examples.en: She coughed the whole night.
examples.zh: 她咳了一晚上。

examples.en: Your cough sounds much better today.
examples.zh: 今天你的咳嗽声听上去好多了。

examples.en: The baby can read, write and count.
examples.zh: 这个小孩能读写，还会数数。

examples.en: We ought to try our best to make our country more powerful.
examples.zh: 我们应该尽力使我们的国家更强大。

_flags: OCR音标 /'kAntri/ 明显有误，已修正为 /'kʌntri/

senses.zh: 夫妇；一对；一双；一副；几个人；几件事物

examples.en: To my surprise, the young couple designed their new house by themselves.
examples.zh: 令我惊讶的是，这对年轻夫妇亲自设计了他们的新房。

examples.en: My cousin will stay with me for a couple of days this summer holiday.
examples.zh: 今年暑假，我的表哥将在我这里暂住几天。

phrases: a couple of 两个；几个
_flags: OCR音标 /'kApI/ 明显有误，已修正为 /'kʌpl/

senses.zh: 过程，经过；进程；课程；一道菜

examples.en: The college course was then cut to three years.
examples.zh: 那时大学学制缩短到了3年。

examples.en: Alice and Betty are my cousins.
examples.zh: 艾丽丝和贝蒂是我的表姐妹。

_flags: OCR音标 /'kAuZn/ 明显有误，已修正为 /'kʌzn/

examples.en: In autumn the road is always covered with fallen leaves.
examples.zh: 在秋天，道路总是铺满落叶。

examples.en: The book needs a new cover.
examples.zh: 这本书需要一个新封面。

_flags: OCR音标 /'kAvə(r)/ 明显有误，已修正为 /'kʌvə(r)/

senses.zh: 疯狂的；着迷的；热衷的；狂热的

examples.en: She must be crazy to wear a short skirt in such freezing weather.
examples.zh: 她一定是疯了，在这么寒冷的天气穿短裙。

examples.en: He is so crazy about science that he wants to become an inventor.
examples.zh: 他如此热爱科学，以至于想成为一名发明家。

examples.en: Please put cream in her coffee.
examples.zh: 请在她的咖啡里加奶油。

examples.en: If you have good imagination, you can create an attractive story easily.
examples.zh: 如果你有出色的想象力，就能轻松写出一个引人入胜的故事来。

derivations.zh: 创造性的，有创意的，有创造力的

senses.zh: 创造性的，有创意的，有创造力的

examples.en: The new-media industry attracts young and creative people.
examples.zh: 新媒体产业吸引着有创意的年轻人。

examples.en: Mark the place on the map with a cross.
examples.zh: 在地图上用十字形记号标出这个地方。

examples.en: Don't let the boy cross the street by himself. He is too young.
examples.zh: 不要让这男孩自己过马路。他太小了。

examples.en: To everyone's excitement, Jim was the first to cross the finish line.
examples.zh: 让所有人兴奋的是，吉姆是第一个冲过终点线的人。

examples.en: Yao Ming's height makes him stand out in the crowd.
examples.zh: 姚明的身高使他在人群中很突出。

examples.en: The restaurant is always crowded with people. The food there must be very delicious.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅总是挤满了人。那里的食物一定很美味。

examples.en: The baby can cry as soon as he is born.
examples.zh: 婴儿生下来就会哭。

examples.en: He jumped into the river to save the little boy as soon as he heard the cry for help.
examples.zh: 他一听到呼救，就马上跳入河中去救那个小男孩。

examples.en: Young people are showing interest in Guofeng culture for the time being.
examples.zh: 目前，年轻人对国风文化表现出兴趣。

examples.en: Would you like me to bring you a cup of tea?
examples.zh: 我给你拿一杯茶，好吗？

examples.en: If you travel around the world, you will be surprised at how different the foreign customs are.
examples.zh: 如果你在世界各地旅行，你会惊奇地发现外国的习俗是如此不同。

examples.en: If the manager can't make the service better, the shop will soon lose all the customers.
examples.zh: 如果经理不能提高服务水平，商店会很快失去所有的客户。

examples.en: I cut a piece of meat for you.
examples.zh: 我给你切了一块肉。

examples.en: It's important to properly care for a cut to prevent infection.
examples.zh: 正确护理伤口很重要，可以预防感染。

examples.en: The little girl is very cute.
examples.zh: 那个小女孩非常可爱。

examples.en: He always practises cycling with other cyclists.
examples.zh: 他总是和其他车手一起练习骑自行车。

examples.en: How do you feel, Dad?
examples.zh: 爸爸，你感觉怎么样？

examples.en: He does daily exercises to help control his weight.
examples.zh: 他为控制体重，每天坚持锻炼。

examples.en: The Visitor Centre is open daily from 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
examples.zh: 游客中心每天上午 8:30 至下午 4:30 开放。

examples.en: China Daily
examples.zh: 《中国日报》

examples.en: The forest fires kill many plants and animals in an eco-system so they cause damage to a forest.
examples.zh: 森林火灾烧死生态系统中的许多动物和植物，所以会给森林带来毁灭性破坏。

examples.en: He damaged a car with a baseball bat.
examples.zh: 他用棒球棍损坏了一辆汽车。

examples.en: I enjoy the popular dance “hip-hop”, but neither my father nor my mother likes it.
examples.zh: 我喜欢流行的“嘻哈”舞蹈，但我父亲和母亲都不喜欢。

examples.en: It was unusual for such old people to dance Swan Lake.
examples.zh: 对于这个年纪的老年人来说，跳《天鹅湖》是不寻常的。

examples.en: She is the best dancer in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 她是上海最好的舞蹈演员。

examples.en: Sadly, some drivers are still unaware of the danger of using phones while driving.
examples.zh: 令人遗憾的是，一些司机仍然没有意识到开车时使用手机的危险性。

examples.en: The peace-keeping armies from different countries work together in dangerous areas.
examples.zh: 来自不同国家的维和部队在危险地区协同工作。

senses.zh: (作情态动词时，后接不带 to 的不定式；主要用于疑问、否定或条件句) 敢，敢于

examples.en: He dare not speak to her.
examples.zh: 他不敢和她说话。

examples.en: He didn't dare to speak to her.
examples.zh: 他不敢和她说话。

examples.en: Cats have a remarkable ability to see in the dark.
examples.zh: 猫拥有在黑暗中视物的非凡能力。

examples.en: That was a dark, moonless night.
examples.zh: 那是一个黑暗的、无月光的夜晚。

examples.en: March 6th is the date of his death.
examples.zh: 他去世的日期是3月6日。

examples.en: Kathy was delighted to find that her daughter had cleaned the room by herself.
examples.zh: 凯茜很高兴地发现，她的女儿已经自己打扫了房间。

examples.en: Let’s enjoy the days with our classmates. We will finish our junior high school in two months.
examples.zh: 让我们好好享受和同班同学在一起的日子。我们将在两个月内完成初中学业。

examples.en: The days are getting longer in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天，白昼变长了。

examples.en: Qingming Festival is an important Chinese festival to remember people’s dead relatives.
examples.zh: 清明节是中国的一个重要节日，是缅怀已故亲人的节日。

senses.zh: 对付；分配，分给；给予；经营；处理

examples.en: How will you deal with these things?
examples.zh: 你将如何处理这些事情？

examples.en: We lost a lot of money on that deal.
examples.zh: 我们在那笔交易中亏损了许多钱。

examples.en: The two armies stopped fighting and agreed to a peace deal.
examples.zh: 这两支军队停止了交战，达成了和平协议。

phrases: a great deal of 很多；大量

examples.en: Diego Maradona’s death made the football fans from all over the world very sad.
examples.zh: 迭戈·马拉多纳的去世使得全世界的足球迷都很伤心。

examples.en: We're debating what to do next.
examples.zh: 我们正在讨论下一步该做什么。

examples.en: There is a general debate nowadays about housing problems.
examples.zh: 目前，针对住房问题存在普遍的争论。

examples.en: What a coincidence! Alice's birthday is on the ninth of December just as mine.
examples.zh: 真是太巧了！爱丽丝的生日和我一样是12月9日。

examples.en: We've decided to decorate our new flat by ourselves this weekend.
examples.zh: 我们已经决定本周末自己来装饰我们的新房子。

examples.en: Mr. Chen hasn't decided what to do next.
examples.zh: 陈先生尚未决定下一步要做什么。

examples.en: For many students, choosing a job is the most important life decision they must make at school.
examples.zh: 对于很多学生来说，择业是他们在学校必须做的最重要的人生决定。

phrases: make a decision 做出决定

examples.en: My mother likes to decorate rooms with flowers.
examples.zh: 我妈妈喜欢用花装饰房间。

examples.en: The river is not deep; we can walk through it.
examples.zh: 这河不深，我们可以涉水过去。

examples.en: The deep rumble of thunder echoed through the valley.
examples.zh: 低沉的隆隆雷声在山谷中回荡。

examples.en: It's at 10 degrees centigrade.
examples.zh: 气温是10℃。

examples.en: I have already got my master's degree of Education.
examples.zh: 我已经获得了教育硕士学位。

examples.en: It is getting late, don't delay.
examples.zh: 时间已晚，不要耽搁了。

examples.en: His delay made the teacher angry.
examples.zh: 他的迟到使老师生气了。

notes: delay是常考单词，所以学生一定要知道：delay = put off“延期”。

senses.zh: 美味的，可口的；令人开心的，令人愉快的，宜人的

examples.en: Thank you for your delicious dinner, Tony.
examples.zh: 谢谢您的美味晚餐，托尼。

examples.en: The delicious aroma of flowers filled the sitting room.
examples.zh: 宜人的花香充满了整个起居室。

senses.zh: 投递（信件、邮包等）；传送；递送；分发

examples.en: Will you take the goods with you or shall we deliver them to your house?
examples.zh: 你随身带走货物还是我们把货物送到你家？

examples.en: The guest professor delivered an inspiring speech about youth and creativity.
examples.zh: 客座教授发表了一场关于青春与创造力的鼓舞人心的演讲。

examples.en: I have got a toothache, so I must go to a dentist.
examples.zh: 我牙疼，必须去看牙医。

examples.en: The driver denied causing the serious car accident during the police interview.
examples.zh: 在警方问询时，司机否认自己引发了这起严重的车祸。

notes: deny 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其用法：deny 后面跟动名词。

examples.en: Within ninety minutes the ship was ready for departure.
examples.zh: 90 分钟之内轮船准备出发。

senses.zh: 依靠，依赖；取决于；根据……而定

examples.en: Our future happiness depends on the choices we make today.
examples.zh: 我们未来的幸福取决于我们今天所做的选择。

examples.en: I don’t know whether he can join us for dinner tonight, it depends.
examples.zh: 我不知道他今晚是否和我们共进晚餐，看情况吧。

examples.en: About three-fifths of the students in our class can describe that place in English.
examples.zh: 在我们班大约有 3/5 的学生可以用英语描述那个地方。

examples.en: He deserves a reward for his efforts.
examples.zh: 他积极努力，应受奖赏。

_flags: OCR音标 /dɜːz:v/ 明显有误，已修正为 /dɪ'zɜːv/

examples.en: A new car has been designed for the film The Italian Job.
examples.zh: 专为电影《偷天换日》设计出一款新型汽车。

examples.en: The design of the smartphone was fashionable and innovative.
examples.zh: 这款智能手机的设计时尚而创新。

examples.en: She has a desire of climbing mountains.
examples.zh: 她想去爬山。

examples.en: We all desire happiness and health.
examples.zh: 我们都渴望得到幸福和健康。

examples.en: The orange on the desk is for you, David.
examples.zh: 桌上的橙子是给你的，戴维。

examples.en: Hundreds of buildings in that area were destroyed by the terrible flood.
examples.zh: 那个地区有数以百计的建筑物毁于洪水。

examples.en: If you're interested in the job, I'll send you all the details.
examples.zh: 如果你对这份工作感兴趣，我将把所有详细说明发给你。

examples.en: Pansy didn't read many detective stories.
examples.zh: 潘西看过的侦探小说不多。

examples.en: The detective found that the young man took part in many bank robberies.
examples.zh: 这位侦探发现那个年轻人参与过多次银行抢劫。

senses.zh: 发展；开发；培养；(使) 成长；壮大

examples.en: We must do our best to develop the national economy.
examples.zh: 我们必须努力发展国民经济。

examples.en: With the development of economy, our life is getting better and better.
examples.zh: 随着经济的发展，我们的生活越来越好。

examples.en: Do you often dial home?
examples.zh: 你常给家里打电话吗？

examples.en: They had long dialogues.
examples.zh: 他们进行了长时间的对话。

examples.en: The teacher asked her students to keep an English diary every day.
examples.zh: 老师要求她的学生每天写一篇英语日记。

examples.en: You'd better look it up in the dictionary.
examples.zh: 你最好查一下词典。

examples.en: Many brave soldiers choose to die for honour rather than live in shame.
examples.zh: 许多英勇的士兵选择为荣誉献身，而非屈辱地活着。

phrases: die of 因……(病) 而死

senses.zh: (日常) 饮食；(日常) 食谱；(日常) 食物

examples.en: If you want to memorise things better, you'd better have a healthier diet.
examples.zh: 要想记性好一点，你最好吃得健康点。

phrases: go on a diet 节食

examples.en: The mother can easily tell the difference between the twins.
examples.zh: 母亲很容易区分这对双胞胎。

derivations.zh: 不同的；有差异的；有区别的；不平常的；与众不同的

senses.zh: 不同的；有差异的；有区别的；不平常的；与众不同的

examples.en: My new computer is different from yours.
examples.zh: 我的新电脑与你的不同。

examples.en: It was difficult for human beings to predict weather in the past.
examples.zh: 在过去人们很难预测天气。

proverbs: Nothing is difficult to the man who will try. 世上无难事，只要肯登攀。
_flags: OCR音标 /'drɪfɪkəlt/ 明显有误，已修正为 /'dɪfɪkəlt/

examples.en: I had no difficulty in getting in touch with him.
examples.zh: 我和他取得联系没有什么困难。

_flags: OCR音标 /'drɪfɪkəlti/ 明显有误，已修正为 /'dɪfɪkəlti/

examples.en: They dug a hole.
examples.zh: 他们挖了一个坑。

examples.en: I haven't had dinner yet.
examples.zh: 我还没有吃饭呢。

examples.en: Nick was having dinner when I visited him.
examples.zh: 当我去拜访尼克的时候，他正在吃饭。

senses.zh: 方向；趋势；用法说明(常用复数)

examples.en: On your way to success, you must keep your direction.
examples.zh: 在通往成功的路上，你必须坚持你的方向。

examples.en: Follow the directions on the package to cook the noodles properly.
examples.zh: 按包装上的说明操作，面条才能煮得恰到好处。

derivations.zh: 导演；(某一活动的) 负责人；主任，主管，经理

examples.en: But even if some don't ask it directly, you can feel it.
examples.zh: 即使一些人没有直接问出来，你仍然能够感觉到。

senses.zh: 导演；(某一活动的) 负责人；主任，主管，经理

examples.en: Tim wants to be a great director like Zhang Yimou when he grows up.
examples.zh: 蒂姆希望长大后，能像张艺谋一样成为一名大导演。

examples.en: Even in the dirtiest weather, they were driven to go out to sea.
examples.zh: 即使是最恶劣的天气，他们也被迫出海。

senses.zh: 丧失能力的；有残疾的；无能力的

examples.en: It is our bounden duty to help the disabled.
examples.zh: 帮助残疾人士是我们义不容辞的责任。
