examples.en: Some voluntary organisations run workshops for disabled people.
examples.zh: 一些志愿组织为残疾人士开办作坊。

examples.en: The children from poor families were at a distinct disadvantage.
examples.zh: 来自贫困家庭的孩子们处于明显的不利地位。

_flags: OCR音标 /disə'dvɑ:ntidʒ/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ˌdɪsəd'vɑːntɪdʒ/

examples.en: Some rainforests are likely to disappear if we don't take action to protect them.
examples.zh: 如果我们不采取行动进行保护，一些热带雨林有可能就会消失。

examples.en: The black car drove away from them and disappeared.
examples.zh: 那辆黑色轿车驶离了他们的视线，不见了。

examples.en: He was disappointed at the result.
examples.zh: 他对这样的结果感到失望。

examples.en: These natural disasters have warned us that everyone should start to protect the environment immediately.
examples.zh: 这些自然灾害警示我们，每个人都应该立即行动起来保护环境。

examples.en: A good education will help you discover and develop your talents.
examples.zh: 良好的教育，将有助于你发现和发挥你的才华。

examples.en: All your suggestions will be discussed carefully before we come to a decision.
examples.zh: 在我们做决定之前，您的建议将会被仔细地讨论。

examples.en: He never contributes to the discussion.
examples.zh: 他在讨论时从不发表意见。

senses.zh: 盘, 碟; 盘装菜; 盘形物

examples.en: Please remember to bring your dishes and cakes to Tom's birthday party.
examples.zh: 请记得带上你的菜和蛋糕去汤姆的生日聚会。

phrases: side dish (随同主菜一起上的) 配菜

senses.zh: 不诚实的, 欺骗性的

examples.en: Don't be dishonest with your friends, or you may lose their trust.
examples.zh: 不要对朋友不诚实, 否则你可能会失去他们的信任。

examples.en: We like him personally, but dislike his way of living.
examples.zh: 我们喜欢他这个人, 但不喜欢他的生活方式。

examples.en: I have walked half the distance.
examples.zh: 我走了一半的距离。

examples.en: We do not want to disturb what we have got.
examples.zh: 我们不想打乱我们现有的东西。

_flags: OCR音标 /dɜːbʃtɜːb/ 明显有误，已修正为 /dɪ'stɜːb/

senses.zh: 分, 划分; (算数用语) 除

examples.en: The chef divided the cake into equal slices for the guests.
examples.zh: 主厨把蛋糕平分成几块给顾客。

examples.en: By the end of fifth grade, they should be able to multiply and divide.
examples.zh: 到五年级结束, 他们应该有能力计算乘法和除法。

examples.en: The generation gap often leads to a divide in understanding between parents and children.
examples.zh: 代沟通常会导致家长和孩子间的理解差异。

senses.zh: 做, 干 (用以构成疑问句及否定句; 第三人称单数现在时用 does)

examples.en: Tom very soon decided what he would do next (= what to do next).
examples.zh: 汤姆很快决定下一步他会做什么。

examples.en: I'm sure that you will do well in your interviews.
examples.zh: 我相信你在采访中会做得很好。

examples.en: Do you remember getting some medicine for her last week?
examples.zh: 你还记得上星期给她买药的事吗?

phrases: do harm to 对……有害; 损害
do one's best 尽最大努力
do sb. a favour 帮某人忙
proverbs: Never do things by halves. 凡事不要半途而废。

examples.en: The doctor told my grandpa not to eat too much fat.
examples.zh: 医生告诉我的爷爷，不要吃太多的脂肪。

examples.en: The clever dog can open the gate of the garden by itself.
examples.zh: 这条聪明的狗自己能打开花园的门。

senses.zh: 元(美国、加拿大、澳大利亚等国货币单位)

examples.en: Let me change the dollar bill for coins.
examples.zh: 让我把这张美元纸钞换成硬币。

examples.en: Do you know the man over there by the door?
examples.zh: 你认识站在门边的那个男人吗？

examples.en: We cannot pay double (of) this amount.
examples.zh: 我们不能付双倍的数目。

examples.en: He carefully doubled the map to fit it into his pocket.
examples.zh: 他仔细地对折了地图，以便把它放进口袋。

examples.en: We're going down a mountain.
examples.zh: 我们正在下山。

examples.en: Danny put down his glass.
examples.zh: 丹尼放下他的玻璃杯。

examples.en: You can also use the interface to download, copy, or delete objects.
examples.zh: 您还可以使用界面来下载、复制或删除东西。

examples.en: Are the children downstairs?
examples.zh: 孩子们在楼下吗？

examples.en: He drew pictures worse than me. = He didn't draw pictures as well as I.
examples.zh: 他画得比我更糟糕。

examples.en: In the end they had to draw lots to decide who would take part in the competition.
examples.zh: 最后他们不得不抽签决定谁去参加比赛。

examples.en: Hard work pays off. I believe you will enter your dream school.
examples.zh: 努力学习是有回报的。我相信你会考入你梦想中的学校。

examples.en: Many young people dream of becoming top models.
examples.zh: 许多年轻人梦想成为顶级模特儿。

senses.zh: 女装，连衣裙；(统指) 服装；童装

examples.en:
— You look so beautiful in your new dress.
— Thank you.
examples.zh:
——你穿这条新裙子看起来真漂亮。
——谢谢。

examples.en: My sister likes to dress in bright colours.
examples.zh: 我妹妹喜欢穿颜色鲜艳的衣服。

examples.en: The nurse helped to dress the patient.
examples.zh: 护士帮助病人穿衣服。

examples.en: Drinking too much fruit juice can be harmful to children's teeth.
examples.zh: 喝太多果汁对孩子的牙齿有害。

examples.en: Coca-cola is a soft drink.
examples.zh: 可口可乐是一种软饮料。

examples.en: If I fail the driving test, I will have another try.
examples.zh: 如果我驾驶考试失败了，我会再试一次。

examples.en: Drivers must obey the traffic rules at any time when they are driving.
examples.zh: 司机在任何时候驾驶，都必须遵守交通规则。

senses.zh: 降低；减少；掉下，落下；扔掉；放弃

examples.en: Even a drop of water mustn't be wasted because it is so important to all the living things.
examples.zh: 即使是一滴水也不能浪费，因为水对所有生命是如此重要。

examples.en: Temperatures can drop to freezing at night.
examples.zh: 晚上气温能降到零度。

examples.en: The medicine must be kept in a cool and dry place.
examples.zh: 药必须存放在干燥阴凉的地方。

examples.en: Dry the dishes before putting them away in the cupboard.
examples.zh: 在把盘碟放进橱柜前先把它们擦干。

examples.en: The children love to feed the ducks at the lake.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢喂湖里的鸭子。

examples.en: Art is not as important as life, but life without art is dull.
examples.zh: 艺术远远没有生命重要，但是没有艺术的生活是多么乏味呀！

examples.en: Kitty said she enjoyed herself during the summer holiday.
examples.zh: 姬蒂说在暑假期间她过得很开心。

examples.en: Inside I saw the head nurse, who said Miss Barkley was on duty.
examples.zh: 我在里面见到了护士长，她说巴克莱小姐正在值班。

senses.zh: 每人；每个；每件；(两个或以上的人或物中) 各自，各个

examples.en: Each bird loves to hear itself sing.
examples.zh: 每只鸟都喜欢听自己唱歌。

examples.en: We each have different needs and interests.
examples.zh: 我们每个人都有不同的需要和兴趣。

proverbs: Each age offers its own men of parts. 江山代有才人出。

examples.en: Recently, more and more people are eager to learn the traditional skills.
examples.zh: 最近，越来越多的人渴望学习这些传统技艺。

examples.en: Julia sang too terribly for me to believe my ears.
examples.zh: 朱丽亚唱得太糟糕了，以至于我简直不敢相信我的耳朵。
examples.rewrite: Julia sang so terribly that I couldn't believe my ears.

examples.en: The policeman asked Mary whether she always caught such an early train.
examples.zh: 警察问玛丽她是否总是赶这么早的火车。

examples.en: He did the work as quickly as he could so as to go back home early.
examples.zh: 他尽快干活，以便可以早点回家。

examples.en: The more quickly he walks, the earlier he will get there.
examples.zh: 他走得越快，就能越早到那里。

proverbs: Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise. 早睡早起会使人健康、富有和聪明。
notes: early 是常考单词，常出现在词形变化练习中，所以学生一定要牢记中考考纲中 6 个拼写同形的形容词和副词。它们是：early, fast, hard, high, late, straight。

examples.en: My brother studies in a university and he knows a lot about the Earth.
examples.zh: 我的哥哥在大学学习，他知道很多关于地球的事情。

notes: 单指地球时要大写，表示其他意思不需要大写。

examples.en: I was watching TV when the earthquake happened in Shanghai half a month ago.
examples.zh: 半个月前上海发生地震，当时我正在看电视。

examples.en: With the help of the app, we found the address of the theatre easily.
examples.zh: 在这款应用程序的帮助下，我们很容易找到了这家剧院的地址。

examples.en: a bitter east wind
examples.zh: 一阵刺骨的东风

examples.en: The room faces east.
examples.zh: 这间房朝东。

examples.en: There has been heavy rain in the east today.
examples.zh: 今天东边下了场大雨。

examples.en: Nobody thought it easy to finish so much work in two days' time.
examples.zh: 没有人认为在两天之内完成这么多工作是件容易的事。

proverbs: Easier said than done. 说起来容易做起来难。

examples.en: It's selfish of Jim to eat the whole cake and it's necessary for us to think more of others.
examples.zh: 吉姆真自私，吃了整个蛋糕。我们有必要多想想别人。

examples.en: The plan of our country is based on a rising economy.
examples.zh: 我国的计划建立在不断发展的经济基础上。

_flags: OCR音标 /'knəmi/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ɪ'kɒnəmi/

examples.en: His parents pay about 200,000 yuan for his college education in the UK each year.
examples.zh: 父母每年为他在英国的大学教育支付 20 万元左右。

examples.en: They hold readings, celebrations, book displays and educational events.
examples.zh: 他们举办读书会、庆祝活动、图书展示和教育活动。

examples.en: The new medicine will have a good effect on his illness, won't it?
examples.zh: 这种新药会对他的病情有良好的效果，不是吗？

examples.en: Jane Goodall's Roots & Shoots has had a huge effect on global youth environmental action.
examples.zh: 珍妮·古道尔创办的“根与芽”组织，对全球青少年的环保行动产生了巨大影响。

derivations.zh: 产生预期结果的；有效的

phrases: special effects (电影或电视节目的) 特技效果
_flags: OCR音标 /'i:fekt/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ɪ'fekt/

senses.zh: 产生预期结果的；有效的

examples.en: This Chinese medicine proved to be highly effective in curing the cold.
examples.zh: 这种中药被证明对治疗感冒非常有效。

examples.en: Her success here depends upon effort and ability.
examples.zh: 她在这里的成功靠的是努力和能力。

examples.en: She has an egg for breakfast every day, doesn't she?
examples.zh: 她每天早餐吃一个鸡蛋，不是吗？

senses.zh: 两方任一方的；二者之一的
(用于否定句或短语后) 也(不)

examples.en: You may use either printer.
examples.zh: 两台打印机中你可以随便用哪一台。

examples.en: Either of them will agree to this arrangement.
examples.zh: 他们两人都会同意这样的安排。

examples.en: The new policy enables people to buy train tickets either from the station or on the internet.
examples.zh: 新政策使人们能够从火车站或互联网上购买火车票。

examples.en: Mary, you can go to the museum either by bus or by underground.
examples.zh: 玛丽，你可以乘公共汽车或者地铁去博物馆。
examples.rewrite: Mary, you can go to the museum by bus. You can go there by underground, too.

examples.en: No one stayed at home, either.
examples.zh: 也没有一个人待在家里。

notes:
either 是常考单词，常出现在主谓一致的练习中，所以学生一定要知道：
either ... or ..., neither ... nor ..., not only ... but also ..., there be 等词语在连接多个主语时，谓语动词用单数还是复数形式取决于离它最近的那个主语。
例如：Either you or he is going. 要么你去，要么他去。
Neither I nor you are wrong. 我和你都没有错。
Not only you but also I was surprised by the news.
不仅你，连我也对这条消息感到惊讶。
There is a pen and some books on the desk. 桌子上有一支笔和几本书。

senses.zh: 年龄较大的；前辈的；年长的

examples.en: Is the girl in blue your elder sister?
examples.zh: 穿蓝衣服的那个女孩是你的姐姐吗？

examples.en: If oil prices continue to rise, people will start driving electric cars.
examples.zh: 如果油价持续上涨，人们就会开始驾驶电动汽车。

derivations.zh: 电子的；电子设备的；电子器件的

_flags: OCR音标 /'lektrik/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ɪ'lektrɪk/

examples.en: When water moves from a high place to a lower place, it can make electricity.
examples.zh: 当水从高处流往低处时，它可以发电。

examples.en: The new laws deprived many people of the most elementary freedoms in that country.
examples.zh: 在那个国家，新法律剥夺了许多人的最基本的自由。

_flags: OCR音标 /'el'mentri/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ˌelɪ'mentri/

examples.en: I saw a baby elephant drinking.
examples.zh: 我看见一只小象在喝水。

examples.en: Can you show me something else?
examples.zh: 你可以给我看点别的吗？

examples.en: We communicate with each other in many ways, such as by email or by phone.
examples.zh: 我们用很多方式交流，比如通过电子邮件或打电话。

examples.en: With the help of the new technology, you can email your friends by mobile phone.
examples.zh: 在新技术的帮助下，你可以用手机给你的朋友发邮件。

senses.zh: 局促不安的；为难的；尴尬的；窘迫的

examples.en: He looked a bit embarrassed.
examples.zh: 他看起来有点尴尬。

examples.en: The government is taking emergency action to deal with a housing crisis.
examples.zh: 政府正采取紧急措施解决住房危机。

examples.en: Except for an old lady, the bus was empty.
examples.zh: 这辆公共汽车除了一位老妇人之外是空的。

examples.en: The garbage truck comes once a week to empty our bins.
examples.zh: 垃圾车一周来一次清空我们的垃圾箱。

examples.en: Good team work will enable us to get the job done on time.
examples.zh: 良好的团队协作能使我们按时完成这项工作。

examples.en: The mother always encouraged her baby to stand up by himself when he fell over.
examples.zh: 当婴儿摔倒时，母亲总是鼓励他自己站起来。

phrases: encourage sb. to do sth. 鼓励某人做某事
_flags: OCR音标 /in'kərəid3/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ɪn'kʌrɪdʒ/

senses.zh: 末尾；终点；结束；尽头；末梢

examples.en: Kevin came from England. He had lived in Shanghai for ten years by the end of last year.
examples.zh: 凯文来自英格兰。到去年年底，他在上海已经生活了10年。

examples.en: The robot's sensors detected movement at the end of its mechanical arm.
examples.zh: 机器人的传感器检测到了机械臂末端的运动。

examples.en: The concert ended with a spectacular fireworks display.
examples.zh: 音乐会在一场绚丽壮观的烟花表演中落下帷幕。

phrases: at the end of 在……结束的时候
in the end 最后；终于

examples.en: I don't know why a successful person often has many enemies.
examples.zh: 我不知道为什么一个成功的人往往有许多敌人。

examples.en: He brought new energy to the science department.
examples.zh: 他为科学部门带来了新的活力。

examples.en: The engine seems to need piles of oil.
examples.zh: 这种发动机似乎需要很多油。

examples.en: My father has worked as an engineer in the factory for several years.
examples.zh: 我的父亲作为一名工程师在这家工厂已经工作几年了。

examples.en: Do you use chopsticks in England?
examples.zh: 在英格兰你们用筷子吗？

derivations.zh: 英国的；英国人的；英语的

senses.zh: 英国的；英国人的；英语的

examples.en: The foreign teachers in our school are mainly from some English-speaking countries.
examples.zh: 我校的外籍教师主要来自一些讲英语的国家。

examples.en: By the end of last term, we had learned English for four years.
examples.zh: 到上学期结束时，我们已经学了4年英语。

notes: English 是常考单词，常出现在对划线部分提问的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要牢记：划线划在 English 要用 What language 提问；划线划在 English or Chinese 要用 Which language 提问。

examples.en: Enjoy yourselves at the party, boys and girls.
examples.zh: 孩子们，聚会上尽情地玩吧。

examples.en: Billy said he enjoyed reading magazines at the beginning of his speech.
examples.zh: 比利在演讲开始时说他喜欢看杂志。

derivations.zh: 使人愉快的；使人欢乐的；有乐趣的

phrases: enjoy oneself 过得快乐；玩得高兴
notes:
enjoy 是常考单词，其后面一定要跟动名词。同时要牢记以下这些动词和动词词组，其后面也一定要跟动名词：
enjoy, deny, finish, keep, practise, mind, prefer, spend, be busy, be worth, be good at, be/get used to, feel like, give up, do well in, pay attention to, what about, how about, look forward to, keep/stop/prevent sb. from

senses.zh: 使人愉快的；使人欢乐的；有乐趣的

examples.en: We hope you had an enjoyable holiday.
examples.zh: 我们希望您度过一个愉快的假期。

examples.en: I like this piece of music quite a lot. It's enjoyable.
examples.zh: 我相当喜欢这首音乐。它使人愉悦。

examples.en: Of the two pairs of jeans, I chose the less expensive one because I hadn't enough money on me.
examples.zh: 两条牛仔裤中，我选择了更便宜的一条，因为我带的钱不够。

examples.en: He was lucky enough to win the game. = He was so lucky that he won the game.
examples.zh: 他很幸运，赢得了比赛。

examples.en: I think I have said enough.
examples.zh: 我想我已经说得够多了。

examples.en: Sandy likes drawing very much and she believes it can enrich her whole life.
examples.zh: 桑迪非常喜欢绘画，她相信绘画可以丰富她的整个人生。

derivations.zh: 富有的；有钱的；味道浓的；重油的

_flags: OCR音标 /m'ritf/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ɪn'rɪtʃ/

examples.en: Dick would rather enter a vocational school than a high school.
examples.zh: 迪克宁愿进职业学校也不愿进入高中。

examples.en: Television provides universal entertainment.
examples.zh: 电视提供大众化的娱乐。

examples.en: David will meet his friend Martin at the entrance to the museum.
examples.zh: 戴维将在博物馆的入口处与他的朋友马丁碰头。

examples.en: Can I use this envelope?
examples.zh: 我可以用这个信封吗？

examples.en: Please tell us what to do to protect our environment.
examples.zh: 请告诉我们应该做什么来保护我们的环境。

_flags: OCR音标 /m'vaɪərəmənt/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ɪn'vaɪərənmənt/

examples.en: We do business with all countries, big or small, on an equal basis.
examples.zh: 我们同所有国家做生意，无论大国小国，都一视同仁。

examples.en: Nine percent interest less seven percent inflation equals two percent.
examples.zh: 9% 的利率减去 7% 的通货膨胀率等于 2%。

examples.en: I read love stories as an escape from reality.
examples.zh: 我读爱情小说以逃避现实。

examples.en: Do you know whether the Chinese seamen managed to escape from the pirates?
examples.zh: 你知道中国船员是否已经设法摆脱了海盗？

examples.en: Their ideas still influence us today, especially in the arts, science, literature and philosophy.
examples.zh: 今天，他们的思想仍然影响着我们，尤其是在艺术、科学、文学和哲学方面。

examples.en: Most students have not been to Europe, have they?
examples.zh: 大多数学生都没有去过欧洲，是吗？

examples.en: People like to go out on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 人们喜欢在跨年夜出门。

senses.zh: (强调出乎意料) 甚至；连(……都)；即使；更

examples.en: She didn't even apologise for her mistake.
examples.zh: 她甚至都没为她的错误道歉。

examples.en: We hope we can cooperate even more closely in the future.
examples.zh: 希望我们今后能更加密切地合作。

notes:
even 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握以下这些词语的用法：
even, much, far, still, a bit, a little, a lot 等词语可以修饰比较级，如：a bit bigger,
much better, far more useful, even earlier, still greater, a little longer.
例如：Don't you think travelling by train is much cheaper and far more enjoyable
than a trip by air? 你不认为坐火车旅行比坐飞机旅行更便宜、更愉快吗？

examples.en: What an amazing performance the singer gave at the opening ceremony yesterday evening!
examples.zh: 这位歌手在昨晚开幕式上的表演多么精彩啊！

senses.zh: 发生的事件，大事；比赛项目；公开活动

examples.en: Call the police in the event of an emergency.
examples.zh: 若发生紧急事件就打电话报警。

senses.zh: 曾经；无论何时，在任何时候；从来

examples.en: Both my husband and I think it is the most amusing story we have ever heard.
examples.zh: 我丈夫和我都认为这是我们听到过的最有趣的故事。

examples.en: Many people are unaware of how much sugar they take in every day.
examples.zh: 很多人没有意识到他们每天摄入了多少糖。

examples.en: If everyone takes a bus instead of driving a car, there will be less air pollution.
examples.zh: 如果每个人都坐公共汽车而不是驾驶汽车，空气污染将会减少。

examples.en: Please speak louder, so that everybody in the hall can hear you clearly.
examples.zh: 请大声点说，让在大厅里的每个人都听清楚。

proverbs: If everyone gives a love to each other, the world will become much more beautiful. 如果人人都献出一点爱，世界将会更美好。
_flags: OCR 头部为合并词条，已拆分记录两个词头与两条音标

examples.en: These are my everyday shoes, not my best ones.
examples.zh: 这些是我平常穿的鞋，不是最好的鞋。

notes:
everyday是常考单词，学生一定要掌握 everyday和everyday的用法区别：
everyday是形容词，意思是“每天的，日常的”。
every day是表示时间的短语，作状语，意思是“每天”。
例如：Computers are part of everyday life. 电脑是日常生活的一部分。
Such things do not happen every day. 这种事情不是每天都会发生的。
You can improve your English by reading English newspapers every day.
通过每天阅读英文报纸，你可以提高英语水平。

examples.en: Kevin is so independent that he always tries to do everything by himself.
examples.zh: 凯文是如此独立，以至于他总是设法自己去做每一件事。

examples.en: Where have you been? I looked everywhere for you.
examples.zh: 你去哪儿了？我到处找你。

senses.zh: 确切地；（表示赞同的回答）确实如此

examples.en: What are you busy with exactly?
examples.zh: 那你究竟在忙什么？

senses.zh: （笔头、口头或操作）考试，测试；检查

examples.en: After we pass the exams, we will celebrate by having a party next week.
examples.zh: 我们通过考试后，下周将举办个派对庆祝一下。

derivations.zh: 检查, 细查; 对……进行考试

_flags: 原行括号未闭合（OCR 漏识别右括号），已按原书版式重建 = examination 与 n. 释义

senses.zh: 检查, 细查; 对……进行考试

examples.en: The officers at the airport examine every traveler's passport carefully.
examples.zh: 机场工作人员仔细检查每一个旅客的护照。

_flags: OCR音标 /ɪɡ'zæmn/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ɪɡ'zæmɪn/

senses.zh: 例子; 榜样; 实例

examples.en: I don't quite understand what you said. Would you please give us another example?
examples.zh: 我不明白你说什么。请给我们另外举一个例子好吗?

senses.zh: 极好的, 优秀的; 杰出的

examples.en: An excellent story is the key to making a successful film.
examples.zh: 一个优秀的故事是拍一部成功电影的关键。

examples.en: I think no one can help me except you.
examples.zh: 我想除了你之外没有人能帮助我。

examples.en: Everyone in our class has brought his dictionary to class except me.
examples.zh: 除了我以外, 我们班上每个人都带了词典到教室。

notes:
except 是常考单词, 所以学生一定要掌握 besides, except, except for 之间的用法区别:
besides 作“除……之外”时, 表示“另外附加”的含义, 相当于“加法”。
except 用于表示同类事物之间的关系, 其意为“除……以外”“除去”。常用
在 all, whole, any, every, no, anything, anybody, anyone, everything, everybody,
everyone 等词之后, 相当于“减法”。
except for 不表示同类事物之间的关系, for 后面的词, 往往是补充说明主语的
某个方面。可以理解成有点“美中不足”的意思, 肯定了一个事物的大部分
属性, 只否定其中的一小部分。
例如: Jack also went fishing besides Tom. 除了汤姆, 杰克也去钓鱼了。
We all went fishing except Tom. 除了汤姆, 我们都去钓鱼了。
The article is excellent, except for a few grammar mistakes.
这篇文章很好, 除了有点语法错误。(语法错误和文章不是同类事物)
Smith is a good man, except for his bad temper.
史密斯是个好人, 就是脾气不好。
_flags: OCR音标 /k'sept/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ɪk'sept/

senses.zh: 交换; 互换; 交流

examples.en: The Italian exchange student was thankful to the host for his care and help.
examples.zh: 这位意大利的交换学生感谢接待方对他的关心和帮助。

examples.en: The students exchanged ideas during the group project.
examples.zh: 学生们在小组项目中交换了想法。

_flags: OCR音标 /ɪks'tfeindz/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ɪks'tʃeɪndʒ/

examples.en: Users have been very excited about the development of this AI model.
examples.zh: 用户们对这款人工智能模型的发展感到十分兴奋。

derivations.zh: 令人兴奋的；令人激动的

senses.zh: 令人兴奋的；令人激动的

examples.en: How exciting it is to travel around the world by bike!
examples.zh: 骑自行车环游世界，这是多么令人兴奋啊！

notes:
excited 和 exciting 都是与 excite 相关的形容词，但它们的含义和用法有一定区别：
excited 表示“感到兴奋的；激动的”，通常用来修饰人，或与人的感受、表情、行为等相关的名词，如 voice, face 等，强调人自身因为某件事或物而产生兴奋、激动的情绪；也可作表语，说明主语的状态。
例如：The excited children opened their Christmas presents.
兴奋的孩子们打开了他们的圣诞礼物。
He was excited about the upcoming trip. 他对即将到来的旅行感到兴奋。
exciting 表示“令人兴奋的；使人激动的”，主要用于修饰事物，说明该事物具有能够引起他人兴奋、激动的特性；可作定语放在名词前，或作表语说明主语的性质。
例如：The football game was really exciting. 这场足球比赛真的很令人兴奋。
It's an exciting opportunity for her. 对她来说，这是一个令人兴奋的机会。

examples.en: Excuse me, what time is it now?
examples.zh: 对不起，请问现在几点了？

examples.en: There's no excuse for behaviour like that.
examples.zh: 别为那样的行为找借口。

phrases: excuse me (因打扰别人或失礼表示歉意) 对不起；劳驾

examples.en: To keep fit, we should get rid of unhealthy eating habits and do more exercise.
examples.zh: 为了强身健体，我们应该摒弃不健康的饮食习惯，多做运动。

examples.en: You should exercise more.
examples.zh: 你应该多多锻炼。

notes:
exercise 是常考单词，它既是可数名词，也是不可数名词，所以学生一定要掌握其用法：
1) exercise 表示“体育锻炼，训练，运动”的时候，它是不可数名词。
例如：I walk to work every day because it is good exercise.
我每天步行上班，因为那是很好的运动。
Swimming is one of the healthiest forms of exercise.
游泳是最有益于健康的运动方式之一。
Do more exercise every day and you’ll be stronger than before.
每天做更多的运动，你会比以前更强壮。
2) exercise 表示“做操”或“练习(题)”的时候，它是可数名词，要用复数形式。
例如：We won’t do morning exercises if it rains tomorrow.
如果明天下雨，我们就不做早操。
We do English exercises to help us learn good English.
我们做英文练习是为了学好英语。
He is doing an exercise in English grammar. 他在做英语语法练习。

examples.en: Although it was getting dark, many people were still waiting outside the Shanghai Museum to visit the exhibition.
examples.zh: 虽然天渐渐黑了，上海博物馆外还有许多人等着参观展览。

examples.en: Does life exist on Mars?
examples.zh: 火星上有生命吗？

examples.en: The customer starts walking to the exit nearest where he parked.
examples.zh: 顾客开始走向距离他的停车点最近的出口。

examples.en: At the end of the third scene the actress exits.
examples.zh: 这位女演员于第三场结束时退场。

examples.en: Ben and Lily have one child and they are expecting the second one in July.
examples.zh: 本和莉莉有一个孩子，他们预计 7 月份迎来第 2 个孩子。

examples.en: Grandparents just called to say that they expected us to visit them very often.
examples.zh: 爷爷奶奶刚打电话来，说希望我们能经常去看望他们。

notes:
expect 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：expect 与 look forward to 意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：I'm expecting to receive a letter from you.
= I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
我期待收到你的来信。

examples.en: This beautiful skirt is as expensive as that red scarf.
examples.zh: 这条漂亮的裙子和那条红色的围巾一样贵。
examples.rewrite: This beautiful skirt is the same price as that red scarf.

examples.en: He had little experience in managing a team, but he learned quickly and soon became good at it.
examples.zh: 他几乎没有管理团队的经验，但学得很 快，不久就驾轻就熟了。

examples.en: The experience in Australia in July was truly unforgettable.
examples.zh: 7 月份在澳大利亚的经历确实难忘。

derivations.zh: 有经验的；熟练的；有见识的

proverbs: Experience is the father of wisdom and memory the mother. 经验是智慧之父，记忆是智慧之母。
notes:
experience 是常考单词，所以学生一定要知道 experience 作“经验”解时，是不可数的；作“经历”解时，是可数的。
例如：He has a lot of experience in the research. 在这项研究上他很有经验。
He has a lot of experiences of travelling. 他有很多旅游的经历。

examples.en: Now the good method is widely used in the experiments.
examples.zh: 现在这个好方法被广泛应用在实验中。

examples.en: It is better to learn how to do the experiment right now.
examples.zh: 现在最好立刻学习如何做实验。

phrases: do interesting experiments and projects 做有趣的实验和项目

examples.en: Do I really have to explain this?
examples.zh: 我真的需要对此做出解释吗？

examples.en: Byrd explored the region around the South Pole.
examples.zh: 伯德探测了南极地带。

examples.en: Language is how you express yourself and your culture.
examples.zh: 语言是表达自我和表达自身文化的方式。

examples.en: He had boarded an express for Rome.
examples.zh: 他已经登上了前往罗马的特快列车。

examples.en: You need to be extra careful not to make any mistake.
examples.zh: 你要格外小心，别犯错误。

examples.en: What should we do with this extra income?
examples.zh: 我们应该如何处理这笔额外的收入呢？

examples.en: Reading can open up my eyes to the outside world. And books are like teachers that introduce different countries to me.
examples.zh: 读书能够开拓我的视野，并且，书也像老师一样把不同的国家介绍给我。

examples.en: Class, I'm going to tell you a fable.
examples.zh: 同学们，我要给你们讲一则寓言。

examples.en: Fancy is a pleasant girl with a cheerful face. She is a good friend of mine.
examples.zh: 范西是一个可爱的女孩，她脸上总是洋溢着喜悦。她是我的好朋友。

examples.en: The British government is faced with a sharp increase in refugee issues.
examples.zh: 英国政府面临着难民问题的急剧增加。

examples.en: The fact that I didn't have enough experience was really a big disadvantage.
examples.zh: 我没有足够的经验，这确实是一个很大的劣势。

phrases: in fact 事实上；实际上

examples.en: The people there did not allow them to set up a factory so as not to pollute the water in the river.
examples.zh: 为防止污染河水，那里的人不允许他们在那儿建立工厂。

examples.en: Hollywood was on strike because labor and management failed to reach a new deal.
examples.zh: 由于劳方和资方未能达成新的协议，好莱坞陷入了停工状态。

examples.en: You will fail the English exam unless you practise it more after class.
examples.zh: 如果课后不多练习，你英语考试会不及格。
examples.rewrite: You will fail the English exam if you don't practise it more after class.

examples.en: Your brother failed the English test last week, didn't he?
examples.zh: 上周你弟弟的英语考试不及格，是吗？

senses.zh: 公平的，合理的；(头发或皮肤) 浅色的；白皙的

examples.en: She tries to be fair to all her employees.
examples.zh: 她尽量公平对待所有雇员。

examples.en: She had fair skin that burned easily in the sun.
examples.zh: 她皮肤白皙，在阳光下容易晒伤。

examples.en: A book fair is held here each year.
examples.zh: 每年这里都要举办书展。

senses.zh: 落下；降落；(突然) 倒下；跌倒

examples.en: The leaves will fall from the trees.
examples.zh: 树叶会从树上落下。

examples.en: He was elected a judge in the fall of 2024.
examples.zh: 他于 2024 年秋天当选为法官。

proverbs: Fall into a pit, a gain in your wit. 吃一堑，长一智。

examples.en: Since you have been in Beijing for many years, you must be quite familiar with the city.
examples.zh: 既然你已经在北京待了很多年，你一定很熟悉这座城市。

examples.en: Pan Zhanle is a world-famous sports star. His name is familiar to almost everybody in China.
examples.zh: 潘展乐是世界著名的体育明星。他的名字在中国家喻户晓。

phrases: be/get familiar to/with 对……熟悉；通晓

examples.en: I will take a holiday with my family as I finish all the exams.
examples.zh: 考试一结束，我就会与家人一起去度假。

notes:
family 是常考单词，所以学生一定要正确使用这个词。
1) family 若被看作整体时，后接单数动词。
2) family 若被看作组成该集体的各个成员时，后接复数动词。
例如：The family is a very happy one. 这户人家很幸福。
The family are very pleased about the news.
全家人对此消息感到非常高兴。

examples.en: We are surprised to learn the death of the famous French actor.
examples.zh: 我们惊讶地获悉那位法国著名影星的死讯。

derivations.zh: 声名狼藉的；臭名远扬的

phrases: be famous for 以……而著名

senses.zh: (电影、运动等的) 迷；热心的爱好者(支持者)；扇子

examples.en: His fans are satisfied with his latest work.
examples.zh: 他的粉丝对他的新作感到满意。

examples.en: It was far from my home.
examples.zh: 那个地方离我家很远。

examples.en: Mr. Lin gave us the further information about the competition by email just now.
examples.zh: 林先生刚刚通过电子邮件给我们发来了关于比赛的进一步信息。

examples.en: Tom checked his homework far more carefully than me.
examples.zh: 汤姆检查作业比我仔细得多。

examples.en: What's the first-class fare from Chicago to Los Angeles?
examples.zh: 从芝加哥到洛杉矶的头等舱费用是多少？

examples.en: Uncle Tom is a farmer. He keeps many sheep on his farm and leads a happy life.
examples.zh: 汤姆叔叔是个农民。他在农场养了许多羊，且过着幸福的生活。

examples.en: The farmer looked sadly at the flooded field and he became sadder and sadder.
examples.zh: 这个农民忧郁地望着被洪水淹没的田地，他变得越来越悲伤。

examples.en: Don't easily follow a fashion. Being yourself is the best rule.
examples.zh: 不要轻易跟风(跟着时尚走)，做你自己是最好的准则。

examples.en: Simon is a fast runner. John runs even faster. But Liu Xiang runs fastest.
examples.zh: 西蒙跑得很快。约翰跑得更快。但刘翔跑得最快。

examples.en: That clock's an hour fast.
examples.zh: 那个钟快了一个小时。

examples.en: She got quickly into her car and fastened the seat-belt.
examples.zh: 她迅速钻进她的车里并系紧安全带。

examples.en: You will become fatter and fatter if you don't go on a diet.
examples.zh: 如果你不节食，会变得越来越胖。
examples.rewrite: You will become fatter and fatter unless you go on a diet.

examples.en: I don't eat much fat, for example, fatty meat.
examples.zh: 我吃的脂肪不多，比如肥肉。

examples.en: Wendy's father helped her invent a new way of doing business.
examples.zh: 温迪的父亲帮助她发明了一种新的经商方式。

examples.en: Could you please do me a favour?
examples.zh: 你能帮我个忙吗？

examples.en: National Treasure is one of my favourite TV shows.
examples.zh: 《国家宝藏》是我最喜欢的电视节目之一。

examples.en: Chocolate ice cream is Helen's favourite.
examples.zh: 巧克力冰淇淋是海伦的最爱。

examples.en: Bob seldom has meals in restaurants for fear of spending too much money, does he?
examples.zh: 鲍勃因怕花费太多很少在餐馆吃饭，是吗？

examples.en: My birthday is in February.
examples.zh: 我的生日在2月。

senses.zh: 喂养；饲养；给(人或动物)食物

examples.en: Everyday after dinner the kind girl often goes to our campus to feed homeless cats.
examples.zh: 每天晚饭后，这个善良的女孩经常去我们的校园喂流浪猫。

examples.en: She felt terribly guilty for forgetting her best friend's 15th birthday.
examples.zh: 她因为忘了最好朋友的15岁生日而深感愧疚。

examples.en: She won the award for best female artist.
examples.zh: 她荣膺最佳女艺术家奖。

_flags: OCR音标 /'fi:mil/ 明显有误，已修正为 /'fi:meɪl/

examples.en: The boy vaulted over the fence.
examples.zh: 男孩翻身跳过围栏。

examples.en: I haven't decided which ferry I shall take to Hong Kong Island.
examples.zh: 我还没有决定坐哪一班渡轮去香港岛。
examples.rewrite: I haven't decided which ferry to take to Hong Kong Island.

examples.en: Thousands of people went travelling during the Spring Festival.
examples.zh: 成千上万的人在春节期间去旅行了。

examples.en: My uncle Jim had a high fever.
examples.zh: 我叔叔吉姆发高烧了。

examples.en: Few of the beach houses still had lights on.
examples.zh: 海滩上的房子几乎没有亮着灯的。

examples.en: With the help of their teachers, they have made fewer mistakes this term than before.
examples.zh: 在老师的帮助下，他们这学期犯的错误比以前少多了。

examples.en: There are so many heroes from different fields working together.
examples.zh: 有那么多来自不同领域的杰出人物在一起工作。

senses.zh: 打仗；打架，打斗；战斗；争论

examples.en: The two armies fought together for freedom and independence.
examples.zh: 这两支军队为了自由与独立并肩作战。

examples.en: She has a fight with her mum about staying out late.
examples.zh: 她因为在外面待得太晚和她妈妈吵了一架。

_flags: OCR音标 /fɔ:t/ 明显有误，已修正为 /faɪt/

examples.en: The dress she wore highlighted her elegant figure.
examples.zh: 她穿的那条裙子突显了她优雅的体形。

examples.en: She quickly figured the final budget for the event.
examples.zh: 她很快计算出了活动最终预算。

senses.zh: 填空；(使) 装满；充满；注满

examples.en: Now, please fill out this form.
examples.zh: 现在请您完整填写这张表格。

examples.en: Could you tell me when the film will start tomorrow evening?
examples.zh: 你能否告诉我明天晚上的电影什么时候放映？

examples.en: In some cases, you can hardly tell who is the final winner.
examples.zh: 在某些情况下，你很难分辨出谁是最后的赢家。

examples.en: Finally, Grace made up her mind to live abroad with her daughter.
examples.zh: 最后，格雷丝决定去国外与女儿一起生活。

examples.en: Finally, many readers are already trying to guess what will happen in Harry Potter.
examples.zh: 最后，许多读者已经开始猜测《哈利·波特》中会发生什么。

examples.en: The detective wants to know what Mr. Jones found in the room.
examples.zh: 侦探想知道琼斯先生在房间里找到了什么。

examples.en: Join us, and you'll find learning English can be enjoyable and wonderful.
examples.zh: 加入我们，你会发现学习英语相当有趣和快乐。

examples.en: This was her fourth time to visit the Great Wall, but she still found it amazing.
examples.zh: 这是她第四次游览长城，可她依旧觉得这里令人惊叹。

phrases: find out 找出；查明；了解
notes:
find 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握 find, keep, make, leave, get, set 等单词 + 名词 + 形容词，表示状态的搭配用法。
例如：find the man dead 发现那个人死了
keep the room clean 保持房间清洁
make the city greener 使城市更绿
leave the door open 让门开着
get everything ready 准备好一切
set the man free 让人自由

senses.zh: 晴朗的；美好的；(身体)健康的

examples.en: It is a fine Wednesday morning.
examples.zh: 这是一个晴朗的周三早晨。

examples.en: One of his fingers was wounded. What about the others?
examples.zh: 他的一根手指受伤了。其他的呢？

examples.en: Jenny can ask her teacher for help if she can't finish writing the report by herself.
examples.zh: 如果珍妮自己不能完成报告的话，她可以求助于她的老师。

notes: finish 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其用法：finish 后面跟动名词。

examples.en: Without fires, the oldest and largest trees would stop sunlight from reaching the forest floor. Fires can get rid of some of these old trees.
examples.zh: 没有火，那些古老而高大的树会阻挡阳光透入森林，而火恰恰能烧掉这些老树。

examples.en: The officer ordered his men to fire at the enemy.
examples.zh: 军官命令士兵向敌人开火。

proverbs: There is no smoke without fire. 无风不起浪。

examples.en: A fireman usually helps people put out the fire.
examples.zh: 消防员通常帮助人们把火扑灭。

examples.en: There are also fabulous fireworks displays.
examples.zh: 还有精彩的烟火表演。

examples.en: That band was the first rock band to perform at the Bird’s Nest.
examples.zh: 那支乐队是第一支在鸟巢演出的摇滚乐队。

examples.en: The Battle of Shanghai was first performed by Shanghai Acrobatic Troupe and Shanghai Circus School in 2019. 2019
examples.zh: 年，《战上海》首次由上海杂技团和上海马戏学校演出。

examples.en: From the very first, we knew the project would be a success.
examples.zh: 从一开始，我们就知道这个项目会成功。

phrases: at first 起先；开始的时候

examples.en: Damin taught his grandsons how they could catch more fish.
examples.zh: 达明教他的孙子如何能捕到更多的鱼。
examples.rewrite: Damin taught his grandsons how to catch more fish.

examples.en: It is better to teach a man to fish than to give him fish.
examples.zh: 授人以鱼，不如授人以渔。

notes: fish是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其用法。当指许多鱼时，其复数一般用fish，但当指不同品种的鱼类时，用fishes。作“鱼肉”解时，fish是不可数名词。

examples.en: Did you see several fishermen sitting on the beach, repairing their nets?
examples.zh: 你看到几个渔夫坐在海滩上修补渔网了吗？

senses.zh: (形状和尺寸)适合，合身；与……相配

examples.en: Do you have any ready-made clothes that will fit me?
examples.zh: 你们这儿有适合我穿的成衣吗？

examples.en: You look very fit.
examples.zh: 你看上去很健康。

senses.zh: 修理；安装；确定；安排；解决

examples.en: Perhaps Sam can fix your TV set.
examples.zh: 或许萨姆能修好你的电视机。

examples.en: We mixed up our basket with theirs, but we soon fixed it.
examples.zh: 我们把自己的篮子和他们的弄混了，但很快就分清了。

senses.zh: 旗；(体育运动的)信号旗；标志旗

examples.en: Our flag is red and yellow.
examples.zh: 我们的旗帜是红黄两色的。

examples.en: Everything will be all right in a flash.
examples.zh: 转瞬间什么事情都会好的。

examples.en: My uncle lives on the twentieth floor. The flat has a nice view of the Huangpu River.
examples.zh: 我叔叔住在20楼。这套房间能看到黄浦江的美景。

examples.en: The road was flat and easy to drive on.
examples.zh: 道路平坦且易于驾驶。

senses.zh: 能适应新情况的；灵活的；可变动的；柔韧的；有弹性的

examples.en: Our plans need to be flexible enough to cater (
examples.zh:
满足) for the needs of everyone.
我们的计划必须能够变通，以满足每个人的需要。

examples.en: Would you please find out the time of my flight for me?
examples.zh: 请帮我查一下这个航班的起飞时间，好吗？

derivations.zh: 飞，飞行；乘飞机旅行；(旗帜等)飘动；放(风筝、飞机模型等)

examples.en: The flood deposited a layer of mud.
examples.zh: 洪水过后沉积了一层泥浆。

senses.zh: 地面；地板；(楼房的) 层

examples.en: I have bought a new flat and it's on the eighth floor of the building.
examples.zh: 我买了一套新公寓，它在这栋楼的8楼。

examples.en: There were so many beautiful flowers on show at the park yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天在公园有这么多美丽的鲜花展示。

examples.en: He had come down with the flu before he could board his flight.
examples.zh: 他在登机前染上了流感。

senses.zh: 飞，飞行；乘飞机旅行；(旗帜等) 飘动；放(风筝、飞机模型等)

examples.en: My parents spent two hours flying to Beijing.
examples.zh: 我的父母坐了两个小时飞机到北京。
examples.rewrite: It took my parents two hours to get to Beijing by plane.

examples.en: I can fly a kite.
examples.zh: 我会放风筝。

examples.en: You can see lots of flies flying inside the dirty restaurant.
examples.zh: 你可以在那家脏乱的餐馆里看到许多苍蝇飞来飞去。

examples.en: Their talks are expected to focus on arms control.
examples.zh: 他们的会谈预计会聚焦于军备控制问题。

senses.zh: 听从；遵循；跟随；仿效；跟得上

examples.en: I would follow your advice.
examples.zh: 我会听从你的劝告。

examples.en: I had my first date with Polly the following evening.
examples.zh: 第二天晚上，我和波丽有了第一次约会。

examples.en: I'm very fond of country music.
examples.zh: 我非常喜欢乡村音乐。

examples.en: This truck is used to deliver frozen food from the factory to the supermarket.
examples.zh: 这辆卡车是用来将冷冻食品从工厂运送到超市的。

examples.en: Is it possible that I am a fool?
examples.zh: 难道我是一个傻瓜吗？

examples.en: I’ve been fooled!
examples.zh: 我被骗了。

examples.en: I was very foolish to believe him and lend him the money.
examples.zh: 我真蠢，竟相信了他，还借钱给他。

proverbs: Stay hungry, stay foolish. 求知若饥，虚心若愚。

examples.en: My feet hurt awfully.
examples.zh: 我的脚很痛。

senses.zh: (英式) 足球；(美式) 橄榄球

examples.en: How about playing football now?
examples.zh: 现在踢足球怎么样？

senses.zh: (表示目的、用途等) 为了……；(表示方向) 向……；(表示时间、距离等) 达；计；(表示原因) 因为……；(表示对象) 对……来说

examples.en: The postman cried out downstairs, “Mr. Anderson, here is a letter for you.”
examples.zh: 邮递员在楼下大叫：“安德森先生，这里有你的信。”

examples.en: They made a rush for the exit.
examples.zh: 他们猛然冲向出口处。

examples.en: By the end of last year, Ben had worked as a postman for ten years.
examples.zh: 到去年年底，本作为一名邮递员已工作了 10 年。

examples.en: For this, he failed.
examples.zh: 由于此原因他失败了。

examples.en: Fortunately for him, he can swim.
examples.zh: 幸亏他会游泳。

examples.en: Prepare to alight, for we are almost there.
examples.zh: 我们马上要到了，准备下车吧。

phrases: for the first time 第一次
for the time being 暂时；眼下

examples.en: What’s the weather forecast today?
examples.zh: 今天的天气预报怎么说？

examples.en: We’ll forecast the weather.
examples.zh: 我们将预报天气。

examples.en: Most foreign students in our school are used to the changeable weather in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 我们学校的大多数外国学生习惯了上海的易变天气。

examples.en: With the development of China, more and more foreigners will choose to invest in China in the future.
examples.zh: 随着中国的发展，越来越多的外国人将会选择在中国投资。

examples.en: The air in the forest is much fresher than that in the city.
examples.zh: 森林里的空气比城市中的要清新得多。

examples.en: This moment will stay in my memory forever.
examples.zh: 这一刻将永远留在我的记忆中。

examples.en: Never forget to say “Thanks”.
examples.zh: 永远别忘了说“谢谢”。

notes:
forget 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握 forget doing 和 forget to do 的用法
区别：
forget doing 表示忘记做过的某事（已做）。
forget to do 表示忘记去做某件事（没做）。
例如：I’ll never forget meeting my school headmaster for the first time.
我永远忘不了和我小学校长初次见面的情景。
The light in the office is still on. I forgot to turn it off.
办公室的灯还亮着，我忘记关了。

examples.en: As time passes, he is getting more and more forgetful.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，他正变得越来越健忘。

examples.en: Forgive me, I don’t mean to insult you.
examples.zh: 请原谅，我并非有意侮辱你。

examples.en: There is a fork in my one hand, and a knife in my other hand.
examples.zh: 我一手拿叉，另一手拿刀。

examples.en: A test is a form of measuring what students have learned.
examples.zh: 测验是检验学生学习成果的一种方式。

examples.en: Over time, a strong bond formed between the two friends.
examples.zh: 久而久之，一条牢固的纽带在两位朋友之间形成了。

examples.en: We must only look forward.
examples.zh: 我们必须只向前看！

examples.en: Keep going past the fountain.
examples.zh: 一直走，经过那个喷泉。

examples.en: Paris is the capital and largest city of France.
examples.zh: 巴黎是法国的首都和第一大城市。

derivations.zh: 法国的；法国人的；法语的

examples.en: After six months in prison, the famous music producer and director was set free.
examples.zh: 经过6个月的监禁，这位著名的音乐制作人兼导演被释放了。

examples.en: We're old enough to have the freedom to do what we like.
examples.zh: 我们已长大，有自由去做我们喜欢做的事。

senses.zh: 结冰；(使) 冻结；(屏幕) 冻结

examples.en: I left water outside last night and it froze solid.
examples.zh: 我昨晚把水放在外面，结果它冻得结结实实的。

examples.en: If your phone freezes, try holding down the power button to restart it.
examples.zh: 如果手机屏幕卡住了，可以长按电源键重启。

examples.en: I won't feel very cold in freezing weather.
examples.zh: 在极冷的天气下，我也不会感到很冷。

senses.zh: 法国的；法国人的；法语的

examples.en: The Eiffel Tower is a famous French landmark.
examples.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔是一个著名的法国地标。

examples.en: The French take great pride in their cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 法国人对他们的文化遗产深感自豪。

examples.en: With the help of apps and textbooks, these students teach themselves French.
examples.zh: 在应用程序和课本的帮助下，这些学生自学法语。

examples.en: She kept the windows open to let the fresh air in.
examples.zh: 她把窗户打开，让新鲜空气进来。

examples.en: We moved into the flat last Friday.
examples.zh: 我们是上星期五搬进公寓的。

examples.en: There is some bread in the fridge. It is not necessary to go to the store today.
examples.zh: 冰箱里有一些面包。今天没有必要去商店了。

examples.en: The main dish is a fried steak.
examples.zh: 主菜是煎牛排。

examples.en: The lady over there is a friend of mine.
examples.zh: 那边的那位女士是我的一个朋友。

examples.en: A friend of hers visited Beijing three days ago.
examples.zh: 她的一位朋友3天前游览了北京。

derivations.zh: 朋友般的；友好的；友爱的

phrases: make friends with 与……交朋友
proverbs: A friend in need is a friend indeed. 患难见真情。

senses.zh: 朋友般的；友好的；友爱的

examples.en: When we were visiting the small town, the people there were very friendly to us.
examples.zh: 我们参观小镇时，那里的人们对我们很友好。

examples.en: Jenny likes the new neighbourhood because people here are friendly.
examples.zh: 珍妮喜欢新小区，因为这儿的人很友好。

notes:
friendly 是常考单词，所以学生一定要牢记在中考考纲中有4个以 -ly 结尾
的形容词，friendly 是其中的一个，其他三个是：lovely, silly, early。

examples.en: Real friendship is more valuable than money.
examples.zh: 真正的友谊比金钱更宝贵。

examples.en: What makes you happy in life? Perhaps it is the love of your family or the friendship of your classmates.
examples.zh: 是什么使你的生活快乐？也许是你家人的爱或是同学的友谊。

examples.en: Even a mouse can frighten a guilty man.
examples.zh: 做贼心虚。

examples.en: My dog is gentle and never bites, so you needn't be frightened.
examples.zh: 我的狗很温驯，从不咬人，所以你不必害怕。

examples.en: My trip to Phuket Island was really a frightening experience.
examples.zh: 我的普吉岛之旅真是一次可怕的经历。

notes:
frightened 是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其与 frightening 的用法区别：
frightened 用于形容人的感受，frightening 用于形容事物。
例如：Lili is frightened of cockroaches. 莉莉很怕蟑螂。
The forest was very dark and frightening. 森林很黑暗恐怖。

senses.zh: （表示起点）从；自；（表示时间）从……开始；（表示距离）离……；距……；（表示来源）来自

examples.en: How far is it from the office to your home?
examples.zh: 从办公室到你家有多远？

examples.en: One starry night, when the seven little dwarfs went back home from work, they found something unusual at once.
examples.zh: 一个星光灿烂的夜晚，当七个小矮人下班回家，他们立刻发现了一些不同寻常的东西。

examples.en: The meeting will last from 2 p.m. to 4 p.m.
examples.zh: 会议将从下午 2 点持续到 4 点。

examples.en: The restaurant is only a few blocks away from my house.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅离我家只有几个街区的距离。

examples.en: She received some gifts from her friend.
examples.zh: 她收到了来自朋友的礼物。

phrases: from then on 从那时起
from time to time 不时；有时

examples.en: The front seats are sold out.
examples.zh: 前排的座位已经售罄。

examples.en: I'm in front of you.
examples.zh: 我在你前面。

examples.en: I don't think I like frozen food. It's not fresh.
examples.zh: 我想我不喜欢冷冻食品。它不新鲜。

examples.en: It's important to eat a variety of fruits and vegetables.
examples.zh: 吃各种各样的水果和蔬菜很重要。

_flags: OCR音标 /frut/ 明显有误，已修正为 /fru:t/

examples.en: They ran out of fuel.
examples.zh: 他们的燃料用完了。

senses.zh: 满的，充满的；完全的；饱的

examples.en: If you are full of confidence, you'll be happy all the time.
examples.zh: 如果你充满自信，你会一直开开心心。

senses.zh: 乐趣；有趣的事；娱乐；玩笑；快乐

examples.en: What great fun it is to have a barbecue in the park on such a sunny day!
examples.zh: 在这样一个晴朗的日子，在公园烧烤是多么有趣啊！

examples.en: It is not nice to make fun of someone because of their appearance.
examples.zh: 因为别人的外貌而取笑他们是不好的。

phrases: make fun of 拿……开玩笑
_flags: OCR音标 /fAn/ 明显有误，已修正为 /fʌn/

examples.en: Mark Twain's stories are funny and full of surprising events of his childhood.
examples.zh: 马克·吐温的故事很有趣，里面都是他童年时期的奇闻趣事。

_flags: OCR音标 /'fAni/ 明显有误，已修正为 /'fʌni/

examples.en: I wonder if the floor can support such a weight of furniture.
examples.zh: 我不知这地板能否承受住这样重的家具。

notes: furniture 是常考单词，所以学生一定要知道：像 furniture, fun, music, advice, weather, information, news 等这些词都是不可数名词。
_flags: OCR音标 /'f3:nftjə(r)/ 明显有误，已修正为 /'fɜːnɪtʃə(r)/

examples.en: Now we live further away from the city centre.
examples.zh: 现在我们住得离市中心更远了。

examples.en: She took the new job to further her career.
examples.zh: 她接受了这项新工作以进一步发展她的事业。

examples.en: We need further consideration on this matter.
examples.zh: 我们需要更深入地考虑此事。

_flags: OCR音标 /'f3:ə(r)/ 明显有误，已修正为 /'fɜːðə(r)/

examples.en: We should take serious responsibilities and work for a better future.
examples.zh: 我们应当承担起重大的责任，为更美好的未来而努力。

examples.en: Gaining knowledge through experience is more valuable than learning from books.
examples.zh: 通过实践获得知识比从书本上学更有价值。

examples.en: No pain, no gain.
examples.zh: 一份耕耘，一份收获。

examples.en: Online games are very interesting, but we can't spend too much time on them.
examples.zh: 网络游戏很有趣，但我们不能花太多时间。

examples.en: Football is a team game.
examples.zh: 足球是一项团队运动。

examples.en: The game lasted 2 hours.
examples.zh: 比赛进行了两个小时。

examples.en: How happily Little Tommy is playing with his cousin in the garden!
examples.zh: 小汤米和他的表弟在花园里玩耍多么快乐！

phrases: take up gardening 从事园艺

examples.en: A lot of gases are harmful.
examples.zh: 有许多气体是有害的。

examples.en: A friend of theirs is waiting for the manager at the gate of the company.
examples.zh: 他们的一个朋友正在公司门口等经理。

senses.zh: 大体的，笼统的；总的；全体的；普遍的

examples.en: This is the general trend.
examples.zh: 这是总体趋势。

examples.en: A soldier who doesn't want to be a general is not a good soldier.
examples.zh: 不想当将军的士兵不是好士兵。

examples.en: Some famous speeches in history have left a lasting impact on future generations.
examples.zh: 历史上一些著名的演讲对后世产生了深远的影响。

examples.en: She is a warmhearted, generous old lady.
examples.zh: 她是一位热心、慷慨的老太太。

examples.en: I want to play with the gentle cat.
examples.zh: 我想和那只温驯的猫玩耍。

examples.en: I am a gentleman.
examples.zh: 我是一个绅士。

examples.en: Ladies and gentlemen, we'll arrive in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 女士们、先生们，我们将到达上海。

examples.en: He picked the injured bird up gently.
examples.zh: 他小心翼翼地捡起受伤的小鸟。

notes:
gently 是常考单词，是由形容词 gentle 转换而来。学生一定要牢记在中考
考纲中有些形容词去 e 再加 y 即可转换为副词，如：possible—possibly(可能，
也许)，simple—simply(简单地)，terrible—terribly(可怕地)。

examples.en: Geography is an important subject.
examples.zh: 地理是一门很重要的学科。

senses.zh: 德国的；德国人的；德语的

examples.en: They are Germans, so they can speak German.
examples.zh: 他们是德国人，所以他们会说德语。

examples.en: Do you think the Germans clever?
examples.zh: 你认为德国人聪明吗？

examples.en: Shall we have lunch at the German restaurant?
examples.zh: 我们在德国餐厅吃午饭好吗？

notes:
German 是常考单词，所以学生一定要牢记，German 的复数是 Germans；
human 的复数是 humans；walkman 的复数是 walkmans。

examples.en: Do you know what the population of Germany is?
examples.zh: 你知道德国的人口是多少？

_flags: OCR音标 /d3:meni/ 明显有误，已修正为 /'dʒɜːməni/

senses.zh: 成为；变得；得到；到达；（用于 have got 短语中）具有

examples.en: After taking tennis classes, Tim is getting much stronger than he was one year ago.
examples.zh: 上了网球课之后，蒂姆比一年前强壮多了。

examples.en:
— She looked unhappy today. What's wrong with her?
— She got a "D" in English.
examples.zh:
——她今天看上去不高兴。她怎么了？
——英语她得了一个“D”。

examples.en: I got to the station at half past four.
examples.zh: 我于4点半到达车站。

examples.en: Lucy has got a lovely pet dog. Its name is Taffy.
examples.zh: 露西有一条可爱的宠物狗。它的名字叫“太妃糖”。

phrases: get away 走开，离开；逃走
get into the habit of 养成……的习惯
get tired of 对……感到厌倦

examples.en: It's our family tradition to exchange gifts on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 在除夕夜交换礼物是我们家的传统。

examples.en: It was unusual for such a little girl to solve this hard problem in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 对于这样一个小女孩，在10分钟内就解决了这个棘手的问题，太不寻常了。

examples.en: What a useful suggestion you have given me!
examples.zh: 你给我的建议是多么有用啊！

examples.en: On leaving school, all the students felt thankful to the teachers for giving them a good education.
examples.zh: 离开学校时，所有的学生都感谢老师给了他们良好的教育。

examples.en: I am glad to hear from you.
examples.zh: 我很高兴收到你的来信。

examples.en: I will be glad to do it for you.
examples.zh: 我很乐意为你做这件事。

examples.en: It is said that eight glasses of water a day can help you keep fit.
examples.zh: 有人说，每天 8 杯水可以帮助你保持健康。

examples.en: The glasses are made of fine glass.
examples.zh: 眼镜是由优质玻璃制成的。

examples.en: Mike hurt one of his feet in an accident yesterday. Shall we go and see him after school?
examples.zh: 昨天的事故中迈克伤了一只脚。放学后我们去看看他好吗？

examples.en: I won't go to the party unless I'm invited.
examples.zh: 除非我受到邀请，否则我不会去参加聚会。

phrases: go for it 加油，大胆尝试
go hiking 去远足；去徒步旅行
go in for 参加；从事于；酷爱
go on a diet 节食
go on a picnic 去野营；去野餐
go on with/doing 继续做某事
go over 复习；仔细地再读一遍
go sailing 去航海，去航行
go to (the) hospital 去医院（看病）
go to the cinema/movies 去看电影
proverbs: Pride goes before a fall. 骄者必败。
notes:
go 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握 have gone to, have been to, have been in 的用法区别：
have gone to 意为“到某地去”，说话时该人不在现场，一般不用第一人称和第二人称代词作句子的主语。
例如：— Where is Jim? 吉姆在哪里？
— He has gone to England. 他去英国了。（尚未回来）
Mr. Wang isn't here. He has gone to Qingdao.
王先生不在这里。他去青岛了。
have been to 意为“曾经去过某地”，现在已不在那里了。后可接表示次数的词，
如 once, twice, three times 等，也可和 before, just, never, ever 等词连用。
例如：My father has been to Beijing twice. 我父亲去过北京两次。
I have never been to the Great Wall. 我从未去过长城。
have been in 表示“在某地待了多少时间”，句尾常接 for + 时间段，或 since +
时间点，或句首有 How long。
例如：I have been in Shanghai for three years. 我到上海已有 3 年了。

examples.en: Finally, Jack achieved his goal and became the owner of a company.
examples.zh: 最后，杰克实现了他的目标，成为了一家公司的老板。

examples.en: She kicked the ball into the net, scoring a goal for her team.
examples.zh: 她把球踢进球网，为球队得了分。

examples.en: Fire is the test of gold.
examples.zh: 真金不怕火炼。

examples.en: Her hair is golden.
examples.zh: 她的头发是金黄色的。

examples.en: Nadal is a good tennis player, but I think Djokovic is better.
examples.zh: 纳达尔是一名优秀的网球运动员，但我认为德约科维奇更优秀。

phrases: be good for 对……有好处
proverbs: All things in their being are good for something. 天生我材必有用。

examples.en: The government is going to widen the road this coming summer.
examples.zh: 政府打算今年夏天拓宽道路。

senses.zh: 等级；（中小学的）学年，年级；成绩，分数

examples.en: Kitty is in Grade Eight.
examples.zh: 姬蒂读八年级。

examples.en: He received a failing grade.
examples.zh: 他得了一个不及格的成绩。

examples.en: Mum has been working in this school since she graduated from university in 2000.
examples.zh: 妈妈自 2000 年大学毕业后就一直在这所学校工作。

examples.en: Li Fang is a graduate of Fudan University.
examples.zh: 李芳是一名复旦大学的毕业生。

examples.en: Does Jane often read newspapers to her 90-year-old grandma after school?
examples.zh: 放学后，简经常给她 90 岁的奶奶读报吗？

examples.en: My grandpa is so forgetful that he always leaves things about.
examples.zh: 我的爷爷很健忘，他总是到处丢东西。

examples.en: Wine is made from grapes.
examples.zh: 葡萄酒由葡萄酿制而成。

examples.en: She was very frightened at the sight of a snake on the grass.
examples.zh: 看到草地上的蛇，她很害怕。

senses.zh: 伟大的；重要的；〈口〉好极了，很好

examples.en: The great ship Titanic went down into the water and over 1,500 lives were lost.
examples.zh: 巨轮“泰坦尼克号”沉入水中，1500 多人失去了生命。

examples.en: We are very thankful to our teachers for their great help.
examples.zh: 我们非常感谢老师给予的巨大帮助。

examples.en: It is great for me to see her.
examples.zh: 看见她对我来说真好。

proverbs: Great hopes make great man. 远大的理想造就伟大的人物。

examples.en: Don't start moving the car until the traffic lights change to green.
examples.zh: 交通信号灯变绿之前，不要启动汽车。

examples.en: I like green grass.
examples.zh: 我喜欢青草。

examples.en: There are a lot of beans in the greenhouse.
examples.zh: 暖房里有许多豆子。

senses.zh: 问候；打招呼；欢迎；向……致敬

examples.en: When you first meet the interviewer, greet him or her politely.
examples.zh: 当你第一次见到面试官时，必须有礼貌地向他或她打招呼。

phrases: greet a teacher politely 礼貌地和老师打招呼

examples.en: Look out! There is a dead cat on the ground.
examples.zh: 小心！地上有一只死猫！

examples.en: The STEM course in our school requires students to do some projects in groups.
examples.zh: 我们学校的 STEM 课程要求学生分组完成一些项目。

senses.zh: 生长；发育；种植，栽种；逐渐变得；逐渐成为

examples.en: She has grown up.
examples.zh: 她长大了！

examples.en: Grandpa grew vegetables in his garden.
examples.zh: 爷爷在他的园子里种了蔬菜。

examples.en: As the days passed, her love for literature grew stronger.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，她对文学的热爱变得愈发强烈。

examples.en: I guess you are right.
examples.zh: 我想你是对的！

examples.en: His guess about the outcome of the game turned out to be correct.
examples.zh: 他对比赛结果的猜测是正确的。

examples.en: All the guests are pleased with the restaurant for its excellent service.
examples.zh: 所有的客人都对这家餐厅的优质服务表示满意。

examples.en: You can follow the guide.
examples.zh: 你可以跟着导游。

examples.en: Can you pass me the travel guide?
examples.zh: 你能将旅行指南递给我吗？

examples.en: The GPS system guided us safely to our destination in the unfamiliar city.
examples.zh: 在陌生的城市里，导航系统将我们安全引到了目的地。

examples.en: She was trying to teach him to play the guitar.
examples.zh: 她在试着教他弹吉他。

examples.en: Put the gun down!
examples.zh: 把枪放下！

examples.en: To improve your writing skills, you'd better develop a habit of reading.
examples.zh: 为了提高写作技巧，你最好养成阅读习惯。

examples.en: The beautiful girl has long hair.
examples.zh: 这个美丽的小女孩有一头长发。

examples.en: Joe spent nearly half a year planning his journey around the world.
examples.zh: 乔用了将近半年的时间来规划他的环球之旅。

examples.en: We will meet at half past four.
examples.zh: 我们将在4点半集合。

proverbs: Never do things by halves. 凡事不要半途而废。
notes:
half是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握以下表示“半小时或一个半小时”的固定搭配和数词的习惯用法。
half an hour 半小时
one hour and a half = one and a half hours 一个半小时
two hundred students = two hundred of the students 200 名学生
hundreds of students 许多学生，数百名学生
one-third of the students 三分之一的学生
two-thirds of the students 三分之二的学生
a ten-year-old boy 一个10 岁的男孩
The boy is ten years old. 这个男孩10 岁。
He is over fifty years old. 他已过了50 岁。
He is in his fifties. 他50 多岁了。
It's ten minutes' walk. = It's a ten-minute walk. 需要步行10 分钟。

examples.en: There was hardly anything interesting in today's party. We all left the hall early.
examples.zh: 今天的派对几乎没什么有趣的。我们都很早离开了会堂。

examples.en: Would you like to eat a hamburger?
examples.zh: 你想吃一个汉堡吗？

examples.en: Although Liu Wei has no hands, he can play the piano very beautifully.
examples.zh: 虽然刘伟没有手，但他能非常优美地弹奏钢琴。

examples.en: He handed me the glass.
examples.zh: 他把玻璃杯递给了我。

examples.en: Hand in please!
examples.zh: 请交上来！

phrases: give sb. a hand 助某人一臂之力
on the other hand 在另一方面

examples.en: He was the last man to be hanged for murder in this country.
examples.zh: 他是这个国家里最后一个因谋杀被处绞刑的人。

examples.en: The picture used to hang here and there are some marks on the wall.
examples.zh: 这幅画以前挂在这儿，墙上还有些痕迹呢。

_flags: OCR词形变化音标 hanged /'heind/ 有误，已修正为 hanged /hæŋd/

examples.en: The fight happened so quickly that nobody could describe the start and the finish of it.
examples.zh: 这场打斗发生得太快，以至于没人能描述它是怎么开始和结束的。

examples.en: They happened to see the famous Chinese tennis player at the airport yesterday.
examples.zh: 他们昨天碰巧在机场看到了那位著名的中国网球运动员。

phrases: happen to sb. 发生到某人身上
notes:
happen 是常考单词，所以学生一定要牢记：happen = take place 没有被动语态。
例如：Billy neither knows nor cares what happened.
比利既不知道也不关心发生了什么事。

examples.en: Mary and Peter are playing happily.
examples.zh: 玛丽和彼得快乐地玩耍着。

examples.en: I want to live happily.
examples.zh: 我想生活幸福。

examples.en: Diligence is the path leading to happiness.
examples.zh: 勤劳是获得幸福的途径。

_flags: OCR音标 /'hæpmis/ 明显有误，已修正为 /'hæpinəs/

examples.en:
— Happy birthday! Here is a present for you.
— Thank you!
examples.zh:
——祝你生日快乐！这是送给你的礼物。
——谢谢！

examples.en: Every student in Grade Nine is studying hard to achieve more.
examples.zh: 为了获得更多的知识，九年级的每一位学生都在努力学习。

examples.en: It's hard to eat the hard bread.
examples.zh: 硬面包不好啃。

examples.en: Becoming a better person would not be hard if you follow all these instructions.
examples.zh: 如果你遵循这些指示，要成为一个更好的人是不难的。

examples.en: Linda, pass my glasses to me, please. I can hardly read the words in the newspaper.
examples.zh: 琳达，请把我的眼镜递给我。报纸上的字我几乎看不清。

examples.en: It hardly snows in Shanghai in winter, does it?
examples.zh: 上海的冬天几乎不下雪，是吗？

notes:
hardly 是常考单词，常出现在反义疑问句中，所以学生一定要知道：
1) 陈述部分含有 hardly, never, none, seldom, rarely, little, few, no, neither, nobody,
no one, nothing, too ... to ... 表示否定意义的词时，疑问部分要用肯定形式。
例如：The children seldom have any eggs for breakfast every morning, do they?
孩子们每天早餐几乎不吃鸡蛋，是吗？
2) 陈述部分含有否定前、后缀构成的词时，作肯定句处理，疑问部分要用否定
形式。
例如：He failed/disliked/disagreed ..., didn't he?
He is a man of few words, isn't he? 他是个沉默寡言的人，不是吗？
He is told not to ..., isn't he? 他被告知不要……，不是吗？
He is unhappy/dishonest, isn't he? 他不高兴/不诚实，不是吗？
3) 当陈述部分是 I think, I believe, I guess 等主句后跟 that 从句时(当主句的主语是第一人称)，疑问部分应该与从句保持一致，并且要注意否定的转移。
例如：I believe he will pass the exam, won't he?
我相信他会通过考试，不是吗？
I don't think he will pass the exam, will he?
我不认为他会通过考试，是吗？

examples.en: The Chinese nation is hardworking and brave.
examples.zh: 中华民族是勤劳勇敢的。

_flags: OCR音标 /ˈhaːdʌɪŋk/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ˌhɑːd'wɜːkɪŋ/

examples.en: Don't harm your eyes by reading in dim light.
examples.zh: 不要在昏暗的灯光下看书，以免损伤眼睛。

examples.en: It wouldn't do any harm to ask for advice.
examples.zh: 向别人征询建议是不会有任何害处的。

examples.en: The organisation has set strict rules on the release of harmful chemicals.
examples.zh: 该组织对有害化学品的排放制定了严格的规定。

examples.en: The red hat is too small to wear.
examples.zh: 这顶红帽子太小了，不能戴。

examples.en: I hate to see posers showing off.
examples.zh: 我最恨看装腔作势的人一副卖弄的样子。

examples.en: Dad sometimes goes to the supermarket with us though he hates going shopping.
examples.zh: 爸爸虽然讨厌购物，但有时会和我们一起去超市。

examples.en: I was seventeen and filled with a lot of hate.
examples.zh: 我那时 17 岁，满腔仇恨。

examples.en: I have something important to discuss with Tim. I will wait for Tim until he gets back.
examples.zh: 我有一些重要的事情要与蒂姆讨论。我会一直等到他回来。

examples.en: Could you tell me when we will have a meeting?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我，我们什么时候开会吗？

examples.en: She had a fever last night.
examples.zh: 她昨晚发烧了。

notes:
have 是常考使役动词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法：
have sb. do sth. 使某人做某事
have sth. done = ask sb. to do sth. 请某人做某事

examples.en: We've never seen a more amazing creature. It has no head but is alive.
examples.zh: 我们从没见过比这更令人惊异的生物。它没有头，但是活的。

examples.en: I have a terrible headache.
examples.zh: 我头痛得厉害。

examples.en: The headline is important.
examples.zh: 大标题很重要。

_flags: OCR音标 /'hedlam/ 明显有误，已修正为 /'hedlaɪn/

examples.en: The headmaster gave a wonderful speech despite the rain.
examples.zh: 校长冒雨发表了一场精彩的演讲。

examples.en: Smoking is harmful to our health.
examples.zh: 吸烟有害健康。

examples.en: Healthy eating and doing exercise every day can keep us fit.
examples.zh: 健康饮食和每天运动能让我们保持健康。

examples.en: Can you speak louder, please? I can't hear you clearly.
examples.zh: 你可以大声一点吗？我听不清楚。

examples.en:
— Billy lost his bike yesterday and had to walk home.
— Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
examples.zh:
——昨天比利的自行车丢了，他只好步行回家。
——哦，听到这个消息我很抱歉。

examples.en: We heard two people arguing when we walked past that area.
examples.zh: 当我们走过那个地方的时候，听到两人正在争论。

notes:
hear 是常考感官动词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法：
1) hear sb. doing sth. 指动作正在进行当中。
例如：I hear him talking next door. 我听到他正在隔壁房间讲话。
2) hear sb. do sth. 指动作已发生，完成了，也就是说听到整个过程。意思是“听到某人做了某事”，动作不再呈现。
例如：Would you ask her to sing a song for us? We'd like to hear her sing like a soprano.
你能让她为我们唱一首歌吗？我们喜欢听她像女高音那样唱。
3) 大多数的感官动作 (see, watch, notice 等) 都可以用于这两种结构，但要注意加以区别。用 v-ing，表示动作正在进行，即处于发生的过程中，还没有结束；
用不定式则表示全过程，或经常性的动作，或过去的动作。
试比较：Do you hear someone knocking at the door? (讲时还在敲)
I heard someone knock at the door three times. (讲时敲的动作已结束)

examples.en: I will remember you in my heart.
examples.zh: 我将把你记在心中。

examples.en: The sun gives off heat.
examples.zh: 太阳散发出热量。

examples.en: The stove heats the room.
examples.zh: 暖炉使房间暖和起来。

_flags: OCR音标 /hɪt/ 明显有误，已修正为 /hiːt/

examples.en: The gentleman lost his temper for the first time and shut the door heavily when he left.
examples.zh: 这位绅士第一次发了脾气。他离开时重重地关上了门。

examples.en: How heavy is that typewriter? = What is the typewriter's weight?
examples.zh: 那台打字机有多重？

examples.en: Jim is of average height in our class, but he is still taller than Tommy.
examples.zh: 吉姆在我们班身高中等，但他仍比汤米高。

examples.en: Hello, how are you?
examples.zh: 喂，你好吗？

examples.en: Can you help me to get some help?
examples.zh: 你能帮我找人帮个忙吗？

examples.en: Professor Wang personally thanked everyone who helped with the project.
examples.zh: 王教授亲自向所有为这个项目提供过帮助的人表示了感谢。

examples.en: The students have recently finished their group project with the teacher's help.
examples.zh: 在老师的帮助下，同学们最近完成了他们的小组课题。

phrases: help sb. with sth. 帮助某人做某事
with the help of 在……的帮助下

examples.en: But have you ever heard of a forest fire that can be helpful for a forest?
examples.zh: 但你有没有听说过森林火灾有助于森林生态的发展呢？

examples.en: The Greeks were glad to find the wooden horse was helpful in capturing the city.
examples.zh: 希腊人很高兴地发现这匹木马对攻占这座城市很有帮助。

examples.en: The mother felt so helpless when she knew her child was seriously ill.
examples.zh: 当这位母亲得知自己的孩子病得很重时，她感到非常无助。

examples.en: I was born here. I'm quite familiar with the streets in this town.
examples.zh: 我出生在这里。我对这个小镇的街道相当熟悉。

examples.en: Though they are really great, they have never thought of themselves as heroes.
examples.zh: 虽然他们真的很伟大，但他们从来没有认为是英雄。

examples.en: I'm still hesitating.
examples.zh: 我仍然在犹豫。

examples.en: The boy hid in the tree.
examples.zh: 这个小男孩躲在树里。

examples.en: Nowadays the oil price in the world is getting much higher than before.
examples.zh: 如今世界上的石油价格比以前高得多。

examples.en: Shanghai Tower is one of the highest buildings in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 上海中心大厦是上海最高建筑物之一。

examples.en: I got out of breath running up the hill from the station.
examples.zh: 我从车站跑上山顶，连气都喘不上来了。

examples.en: The book is based on historical events.
examples.zh: 这本书是根据历史事件写成的。

derivations.zh: 历史上著名的；历史上重要的

examples.en: Southwold, a seaside town in England, has a history of more than thirteen centuries.
examples.zh: 索思沃尔德，一个英国海边的小镇，有1300多年的历史。

senses.zh: 打，撞，击中，碰撞；达到(某水平)

examples.en: You hit my head.
examples.zh: 你打了我的头。

examples.en: The company's sales hit a record high last quarter.
examples.zh: 公司上季度的销售额达到了历史新高。

examples.en: You know Mike's hobby is playing football, but mine is collecting stamps.
examples.zh: 你知道迈克的爱好是踢足球，但我的爱好是集邮。

senses.zh: 拿；抱；握住；举行；进行；保持；容纳；使……保持在某位置

examples.en: I can hold the baby.
examples.zh: 我能抱这个小孩。

examples.en: The Eighth China International Import Expo was held successfully in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 第八届中国国际进口博览会在上海成功举办。

examples.en: This hall can hold more than one hundred people.
examples.zh: 这个大厅可以容纳100多人。

examples.en: She held the door open for her friend as they entered the building.
examples.zh: 进楼的时候她为朋友们把着门。

phrases: hold a meeting 举行会议
hold on 等一等(别挂电话)
hold one's breath 屏住呼吸

examples.en: The hole is too small, I cannot push my arm through.
examples.zh: 这个洞太小了, 我的胳膊伸不过去。

examples.en:
—I will fly to Qingdao for my holiday this weekend.
—Wonderful!
examples.zh:
——这个周末我将飞往青岛度假。
——太好了!

senses.zh: 在家; 到家; 回家

examples.en: Frank works with others from home through computers.
examples.zh: 弗兰克在家里通过电脑与其他人联系办公。

examples.en: We have spent all our money, so we have to walk home now.
examples.zh: 我们已经花光了所有的钱, 所以现在不得不步行回家。

examples.en: The earthquake in that country left thousands of people homeless.
examples.zh: 发生在那个国家的地震使成千上万的人无家可归。

examples.en: He returned to his hometown in the spring of 1917.
examples.zh: 他在 1917 年的春天回到了家乡。

examples.en: Don't go out of the classroom until your homework is finished.
examples.zh: 做完家庭作业前不准离开教室。

senses.zh: 诚实的; 正直的; 坦率的

examples.en: Children are educated to be honest when they are very young.
examples.zh: 在孩子们还很小的时候, 就要教育他们诚实。

examples.en: Honesty is the most important thing for a person.
examples.zh: 对一个人来说，诚实是最重要的。

senses.zh: 蜂蜜；(爱称) 亲爱的；宝贝

examples.en: I like to eat honey.
examples.zh: 我喜欢吃蜂蜜。

examples.en: “Good morning, honey,” Mum said with a smile. “
examples.zh: 早上好，宝贝。”妈妈笑着说。

examples.en: It is an honour for me to be chosen as a group leader of our class project.
examples.zh: 被选为我们班级项目的组长，对我来说是一种荣誉。

examples.en: If we don't give up hope, we will surely succeed.
examples.zh: 如果我们不放弃希望，我们一定会成功的。

examples.en: I hope you will succeed.
examples.zh: 我希望你能成功。

examples.en: I hope to hear from you.
examples.zh: 我希望收到你的来信。

proverbs: Where there is life, there is hope. 生命不息，希望常在。

senses.zh: 满怀希望的；抱有希望的；表现出希望的；给人以希望的

examples.en: Surgeons were hopeful of saving the sight in Sara's left eye.
examples.zh: 外科医生有望保住萨拉的左眼视力。

examples.en: My sister felt so sad to find that it was hopeless to clean her favourite T-shirt.
examples.zh: 我妹妹难过地发现，清洗干净她最喜欢的 T 恤衫是没指望了。

examples.en: His face is horrible.
examples.zh: 他的脸很恐怖。

examples.en: When the horse finished the race, its sides were wet all over with sweat.
examples.zh: 当这匹马跑完比赛，它浑身上下都是汗水。

examples.en: The doctors in that hospital always examine patients with great care.
examples.zh: 该院医生总是细心地为患者检查身体。

senses.zh: 主人；节目主持人 (hostess /ˈhəʊstəs/ n. 女主人；女节目主持人)

examples.en: I'm the host of the house.
examples.zh: 我是这间房子的主人。

examples.en: He's the host.
examples.zh: 他是主持人。

examples.en: In such hot weather, people live comfortably with air conditioners.
examples.zh: 在如此炎热的天气里，空调使人们生活舒适。

examples.en: This curry is very hot.
examples.zh: 这咖喱特别辣。

examples.en: I like to eat hot dog.
examples.zh: 我喜欢吃热狗。

examples.en: The Magic Hotel is amazing because it's completely underwater.
examples.zh: 魔术酒店很奇妙，因为它完全在水下。

examples.en: Thanks to Mrs. Lin! With her help, we finished our work an hour earlier.
examples.zh: 谢谢林太太！在她的帮助下，我们提前一个小时完成了工作。

examples.en: What good news it is! The government is planning to build more low-cost houses for its people.
examples.zh: 政府正计划为本国人民建造更多低价住房。真是好消息啊！

examples.en:
— Would you like me to help you with the housework?
— That's very kind of you.
examples.zh:
——我帮你做家务好吗？
——你真好。

senses.zh: (方法、手段、状态) 怎样；如何；(程度、数量、价钱) 多少；(感叹) 多么

examples.en: I really don't know how to answer your question.
examples.zh: 我真的不知道该如何回答你的问题。

examples.en: How about having a picnic?
examples.zh: 去野餐如何？

examples.en: How long did Tom spend finding the answer?
examples.zh: 汤姆花了多长时间才找到这个答案？

examples.en: How often do you go for a swim, once a week or twice a week?
examples.zh: 你多久去游一次泳，是每周一次还是每周两次？

examples.en: How well she sings!
examples.zh: 她唱得多好啊！

notes:
how 是常考单词，常出现在对划线部分提问的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握 how, what, where, why, which 等词的转换用法：
划线划在 twice a year 上，用 How often 提问
划线划在 twice 上，用 How many times 提问
划线划在 for twenty minutes 上，用 How long 提问
划线划在 until 8 o'clock 上，用 How long 提问
划线划在 since 1918 上，用 How long 提问
划线划在 in 1918 上，用 When 提问
划线划在 in twenty minutes 上，用 How soon 提问
划线划在 at 7 o'clock 上，用 What time 提问
划线划在 fifty miles an hour 上，用 How fast 提问
划线划在 fifty minutes' walk 上，用 How far 提问
划线划在 English 上，用 What language 提问
划线划在 English or Chinese 上，用 Which language 提问
划线划在 to do 上表示目的，用 Why 或 What ... for 提问
划线划在 on the tenth floor 上，用 Where 或 Which floor do you live on? 或 On which floor 提问
划线划在 5 dollars 上，用 How much is ...?/How much does ... cost?/What's the price of ...? 句型提问

examples.en: However hard he tries, he never succeeds.
examples.zh: 无论他多么努力尝试，都没能成功。

examples.en: However, modern technology has changed all that.
examples.zh: 然而，现代技术已经改变了所有这一切。

examples.en: He greeted her with a loving hug.
examples.zh: 他以一个深情的拥抱来迎接她。

examples.en: It's common to hug when people meet in the US.
examples.zh: 在美国，见面拥抱是件很平常的事。

senses.zh: 巨大的，庞大的；极多的；程度高的

examples.en: This is really a huge amount of money, but it is much less than we need.
examples.zh: 这实在是一笔巨款，但跟我们所需的还差得很远。

examples.en: Her greatness lies in her deep understanding of human nature.
examples.zh: 她的伟大之处在于她对人性的深刻了解。

examples.en: Whatever is done has to be done by humans.
examples.zh: 一切事情都是要人去做的。

examples.en: This new book brings together a few stories in a humorous way.
examples.zh: 这本新书以幽默的方式把一些故事串联在一起。

examples.en: The animals can go hungry because their food has been damaged in the forest fire.
examples.zh: 因为食物在这次森林火灾中遭到破坏，所以动物们可能要挨饿了。

examples.en: I've hunted everywhere but I can't find it.
examples.zh: 我到处都找遍了，就是找不到。

examples.en: When I hurried to the cinema, the film had been on for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 当我匆匆赶到电影院时，电影已经开始 10 分钟了。
examples.rewrite: When I went to the cinema in a hurry, the film had been on for ten minutes.

examples.en: Hurry up, or you won't catch the early bus.
examples.zh: 快点，否则你就赶不上早班车了。

examples.en: I am in a hurry.
examples.zh: 我很急。

senses.zh: 伤害(身体、感情等)；痛；使受伤痛；使烦恼

examples.en: If you feel that it hurts you, it will probably hurt the rest too.
examples.zh: 如果你觉得它伤害了你，它也可能会伤害其他人。

examples.en: Be careful not to touch the hot water, or you will get hurt.
examples.zh: 小心别碰热水，否则你会受伤的。

examples.en: I love my husband.
examples.zh: 我爱我的丈夫。

examples.en: It is made of ice.
examples.zh: 它是由冰做的。

examples.en: I like to eat ice cream.
examples.zh: 我喜欢吃冰淇淋。

examples.en: The idea to go to Shanghai Chenshan Botanical Garden sounds wonderful.
examples.zh: 去上海辰山植物园，这个主意好极了。

senses.zh: (连接状语从句) 如果，假使；(连接宾语从句) 是否，是不是

examples.en: I won’t go to Kitty’s birthday party if she doesn’t invite me.
examples.zh: 如果姬蒂不邀请我，我不会去她的生日聚会。
examples.rewrite: I won’t go to Kitty’s birthday party unless she invites me.

examples.en: You won’t have a chance to win the contest if you don’t prepare enough.
examples.zh: 如果你准备不充分，就没有机会赢得比赛。

examples.en: I don’t know if he will come tomorrow, if he comes, please call me.
examples.zh: 我不知道他明天是否会来，如果他来了，请打电话给我。

examples.en: I want to know if he is friendly.
examples.zh: 我想知道他是否友善。

notes:
if是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握以下句型的用法：
if句式=祈使句+and句式=否定祈使句+or句式。
例如：If you work hard, you will get high marks.
= Work hard, and you will get high marks.
努力学习，你就会得高分。
If you stay up too late, you will fall ill.
= Don’t stay up too late, or you will fall ill.
不要熬太晚，否则你会生病的。

examples.en: The government had ignored his views on the subject.
examples.zh: 政府忽视了他对这一问题的看法。

examples.en: John is seriously ill, so you ought to spend more time caring for him these days.
examples.zh: 约翰病得很重，所以这些天你应该多花些时间照顾他。

derivations.zh: (身体或精神上的) 疾病，病

senses.zh: (身体或精神上的) 疾病，病

examples.en: Don't worry about my illness; what I need is nothing but a few days' rest.
examples.zh: 不要为我的病担心，我只要休息几天就好了。

examples.en: Can you imagine living on Mars one day?
examples.zh: 你能想象有朝一日在火星上生活的场景吗？

examples.en: I'll do it immediately.
examples.zh: 我马上就做。

notes:
immediately 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，
所以学生一定要知道：immediately 与 at once/right away/in no time 意思相同，在
句中可以互换。
例如：After seeing the message I left on the desk, Mr. Wang called back immediately.
= After seeing the message I left on the desk, Mr. Wang called back at once/
right away/in no time. 看到桌上我留下的信息后，王先生马上回了电话。

examples.en: More and more people have realised the importance of saving water.
examples.zh: 越来越多的人已经意识到了节约水的重要性。

examples.en: It's important to keep as many cultural traditions as possible.
examples.zh: 尽可能多地保留文化传统很重要。

examples.en: It's quite impossible for one with little experience to finish the task within two days.
examples.zh: 对于一个几乎没有经验的人来说，要在两天内完成这项工作是不可能的。

examples.en: Her gentleness has given me a deep impression.
examples.zh: 她的和蔼可亲给我留下了很深的印象。

_flags: OCR音标 /im'prefn/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ɪm'preʃn/

examples.en: The government has built two more water treatment factories to improve the water quality.
examples.zh: 政府又新建了两座水质处理厂，以提升水质。

phrases: improve one's life 改善某人的生活
improve gardening skills 提升园艺技能

senses.zh: 在……(位置)里(内)；在……(时间)；在……(情况、状态)中；以……(方法)；使用……(语言)；穿；戴

examples.en: She found a note in the book.
examples.zh: 她在书里发现了一张纸条。

examples.en: The Titanic struck an iceberg and sank on its first voyage in April, 1912.
examples.zh: “泰坦尼克”号在1912年4月第一次远航中撞上冰山并沉没。

examples.en: I'll get there in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 我将在10分钟内到那儿。

examples.en: The car is in excellent condition.
examples.zh: 这辆车状态非常好。

examples.en: You can do it in different ways.
examples.zh: 你可以用不同的方法做。

examples.en: You can say in Chinese.
examples.zh: 你可以用中文说。

examples.en: Do you know the lady in blue?
examples.zh: 你认识穿蓝衣服的女士吗？

examples.en: Come in and sit down.
examples.zh: 进来坐下吧！

phrases: in one's fifties 在某人50多岁时
notes:
in是常考单词，常出现在按要求改写句子的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：
1) “in+一段时间”要用一般将来时态。
2) 划线划在“in+一段时间”上，要用How soon提问。
例如：The new bridge will be built in three months. 这座新桥将在3个月内建成。
(对划线部分提问)
How soon will the new bridge be built? 这座新桥还有多久建成？
_flags: OCR音标 /m/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ɪn/

examples.en: She shortened the skirt by an inch.
examples.zh: 她把裙子缩短了一英寸。

proverbs: An inch of time is an inch of gold. 一寸光阴一寸金。
_flags: OCR音标 /mʌtʃ/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ɪntʃ/

senses.zh: 包括，包含；把……列为……的一部分

examples.en: The traditional breakfast in this area includes bread, cakes and eggs.
examples.zh: 这个地区的传统早餐包括面包、蛋糕和鸡蛋。

examples.en: Did you include Nick in the group chat for the project?
examples.zh: 你把尼克加到项目群聊里了吗？

_flags: OCR音标 /m'klu:d/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ɪn'klu:d/

examples.en: I've got three days' holiday including New Year's Day.
examples.zh: 包括元旦在内，我有 3 天假。

_flags: OCR音标 /m'klu:dɪŋ/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ɪn'klu:dɪŋ/

examples.en: She has an annual income of ¥330,000.
examples.zh: 她年收入 33 万人民币。

examples.en: I'll increase your income.
examples.zh: 我将增加你的收入。

examples.en: We have seen a great increase in the use of renewable energy in the past five years.
examples.zh: 在过去 5 年里，我们看到可再生能源的使用量大幅增长。

_flags: OCR音标 /m'kri:s/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ɪn'kri:s/

examples.en: My little brother is learning to be independent by cleaning his room on his own.
examples.zh: 我的小弟正通过自己打扫房间，学着变得独立。

examples.en: I like indoor activities.
examples.zh: 我喜欢室内运动。

examples.en: Our industry is expanding.
examples.zh: 我们的产业正在发展壮大。

senses.zh: 影响；作用；影响力；支配力
影响；左右；对……起作用；支配

examples.en: Van Gogh had a major influence on the development of modern painting.
examples.zh: 梵高对现代绘画的发展有着重大影响。

examples.en: We became the best of friends and he influenced me deeply.
examples.zh: 我们成了最好的朋友，他深深地影响了我。

senses.zh: 信息；消息；情报；资料；资讯

examples.en: It is impossible for us to memorise so much information by just reading once.
examples.zh: 要记住这么多的信息，只读一次对我们来说是不可能的。

examples.en: Don't write your exercise in red ink.
examples.zh: 不要用红墨水做练习。

examples.en: The mouse is inside the box.
examples.zh: 老鼠在盒子中。

examples.en: Do you mind turning on the electric fan? It is a bit hot inside.
examples.zh: 你介意打开电风扇吗？里面有一点热。

examples.en: You can have pizza for dinner, or you can try the noodles instead.
examples.zh: 你晚餐可以吃比萨饼，或者可以试试面条。

examples.en: Instead of going further, the tourists took a rest in the hotel nearby.
examples.zh: 游客没有走得更远，就在附近的酒店休息了。

senses.zh: 用法说明；命令，指令；指示；指导

examples.en: Follow the safety instructions, or you could end up in a dangerous situation.
examples.zh: 遵循安全指示，否则你可能会陷入危险境地。

examples.en: In the end, he lost interest in learning Japanese.
examples.zh: 最终，他对学习日语失去了兴趣。

examples.en: I'm interested in playing basketball.
examples.zh: 我的爱好是打篮球。

phrases: be interested in 对……感兴趣

examples.en: What an interesting story!
examples.zh: 多有趣的故事啊！

examples.en: Pudong International Airport is one of the biggest airports in the world.
examples.zh: 浦东国际机场是世界上最大的机场之一。

examples.en: Please show me how to use WeChat to talk with each other on the internet.
examples.zh: 请告诉我如何使用微信在网上互相交谈。

examples.en: Then you will possibly understand your questions better and get right answers on the day of the interview.
examples.zh: 这样你可能在面试那天更好地理解问题并正确回答。

examples.en: I'll interview you about your research work.
examples.zh: 我将就您的研究工作采访您。

senses.zh: 到……里；向内；（表示状态的变化）变成；进入

examples.en: It turned into ice.
examples.zh: 它变成了冰。

examples.en: Could you introduce three historical events in the Tang dynasty to us?
examples.zh: 你能向我们介绍唐朝的 3 个历史事件吗？

examples.en: Since the new rules were introduced, many complaints have been made.
examples.zh: 自从新规出台以来，已经出现了诸多投诉。

_flags: OCR音标 /,intrə'dju:s/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ˌɪntrə'dju:s/

examples.en: Edison invented quite a lot of things during his life.
examples.zh: 爱迪生在他一生中发明了很多东西。

examples.en: The local government is planning to create more jobs for young people.
examples.zh: 当地政府正计划为年轻人创造更多的就业机会。

phrases: get a job 找到一份工作
notes:
job 是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其与 work 的用法区别：
在作名词，表示“一件工作”时，job 是可数名词，而 work 是不可数名词。
例如：He got a job as a waiter. 他找到一份服务员的工作。
Cooking is not an easy job. 做饭不是一件容易的事。
My brother is looking for work. 我的哥哥正在找工作。
Our teacher gave us a lot of work to do today.
老师今天给我们布置了很多作业。

examples.en: It must be fantastic if more students join in the charity show tomorrow.
examples.zh: 要是有更多的学生参加明天的慈善演出，那一定很棒。

notes:
join 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法。join 与 attend, enter
for, join in, take part in 都有“参加”的意思，学生需知道它们的用法区别：
join 指加入某个组织、团体，并成为其中一员，也可用于表示加入某人做某事。
例如：She joined the club two years ago. 她两年前加入了这个俱乐部。
Will you join us for dinner? 你愿意和我们一起吃晚饭吗？
attend 常用于表示参加会议、婚礼、讲座、课程等较为正式的活动，强调出席这一动作。
例如：He will attend an important meeting tomorrow. 他明天将参加一个重要会议。
enter for 主要用于表示报名参加竞赛、考试等活动。
例如：Visitors can enter for a guided tour of the museum.
游客可以报名参加博物馆的导览活动。
join in 更强调加入到他人正在进行的活动中的，通常指小规模的活动，可与 take part in 互换。
例如：Can I join in the game? 我能加入这个游戏吗？
take part in 侧重于参加活动并在其中发挥作用、承担角色，通常用于参加会议、比赛、活动等。
例如：They will take part in the volunteer activities this weekend.
他们将参加本周末的志愿者活动。

senses.zh: 保持；保存；继续不断；培育，饲养

examples.en: Amazing new products are developed constantly to keep customers excited.
examples.zh: 令人惊叹的新产品不断研发出来，让顾客保持兴奋。

examples.en: You are lucky enough to keep the book for a week.
examples.zh: 你够幸运，这本书你可以借一周。

examples.en: The poor baby has kept crying for a long time because he can't find his mother.
examples.zh: 可怜的宝宝一直哭了很久，因为他找不到他的母亲。

examples.en: Keeping pet dogs can help people learn more about life and death.
examples.zh: 养宠物狗可以帮助人们更了解生命和死亡。

phrases: keep doing sth. 继续做某事
keep off 阻挡；不让……接近
proverbs: Keeping is harder than winning. 创业不易，守业更难。
notes:
keep 主要有以下三种用法：
1) keep sth. + 形容词使某物保持某种状态
2) keep a dog (= raise a dog) 养一只狗
3) keep doing sth. 继续做某事
keep 作为常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型或词语转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：keep doing 与 go on doing/didn't stop doing 意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：Jimmy kept talking with others in the Maths lesson yesterday.
= Jimmy went on/didn't stop talking with others in the Maths lesson yesterday.
在昨天的数学课上，吉米一直在与他人讲话。

examples.en: I searched every corner of the house for the key, but couldn't find it.

examples.zh: 这个年轻人爱上了一个可爱的女孩，两个月后，他们结婚了。

examples.en: The bank is on your left.

examples.en: A spider has 8 legs.

examples.en: There is something wrong with my computer, so Mary lent me hers.
examples.zh: 我的电脑坏了，玛丽就把她的借给了我。

examples.en: If Tony isn't careful enough with his lesson, more mistakes will be made later.
examples.zh: 托尼如果不仔细做功课，他以后将犯更多的错误。

examples.en: Don't let such a thing happen again, or you will lose your job!
examples.zh: 不要让这样的事情再次发生，否则你会失去你的工作！

examples.en: They let me have a look at the new flat.

proverbs: Let's cross the bridge when we come to it. 船到桥头自然直。
notes:
let 是常考单词，常出现在反义疑问句句型中，所以学生一定要掌握祈使句
在反义疑问句中的习惯用法：
1) 祈使句的反义疑问句，疑问部分用 will you?
2) Let's 开头的祈使句，后用 shall we?
3) Let us 开头的祈使句，后用 will you?
例如：Close the door, will you? 把门关上，好吗？
Let's show the German friends around the town in the holiday, shall we?
Let us show the German friends around the town in the holiday, will you?
让我们在假期陪德国朋友参观这座城市，好吗？

examples.en: I’ve borrowed two books from our school library.

examples.en: Don’t tell lies. Nobody likes those dishonest people.
examples.zh: 不要说假话。没有人喜欢那些不诚实的人。

examples.en: Whenever Jerry lies, he doesn’t dare to look at me.
examples.zh: 每当杰瑞说谎时，他都不敢看我。

examples.en: Gork lay down on his bed.
examples.zh: 高克躺在床上。

notes:
lie 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其正确含义及用法。
| 原形 | 过去式 | 过去分词 | 现在分词 | 词义 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| lie | lay | lain | lying | 躺；位于(vi.) |
| lie | lied | lied | lying | 说谎(vi.) |
| lay | laid | laid | laying | 放(vt.)；下蛋(vi. & vt.) |
例如：Don’t lie in bed all morning. 别一上午都躺在床上。
Japan lies to the east of China. 日本位于中国东面。
He lied about his age to join the army. 他为了参军而谎报了年龄。
He laid his hand on my shoulder. 他把手放在我的肩上。
The hen laid three eggs this week. 这个星期母鸡下了3个蛋。

examples.zh: 这些创意画作让每个角色和场景都栩栩如生！

examples.en: Everybody needs a shoulder to cry on sometime in his life.
examples.zh: 每个人在他人生的某个时刻都需要有个肩膀来哭泣。

proverbs: To save time is to lengthen life. 珍惜时间就是延长生命。
