examples.en: I cannot lift this box.
examples.zh: 我举不起这个盒子。

examples.en: The lift is out of order again.
examples.zh: 这部电梯又出故障了。

examples.en: People turn off their lights for an hour on Earth Day every year.
examples.zh: 每年地球日那天，人们关灯一个小时。

examples.en: — I like light music better than pop music. — Me too.
examples.zh: ——比起流行音乐我更喜欢轻音乐。——我也是。

examples.en: She used a match to light the candles on the birthday cake.
examples.zh: 她用火柴点燃了生日蛋糕上的蜡烛。

proverbs: Light come, light go. 来得容易，去得快。

examples.en: They had hobbies like fishing and sailing.
examples.zh: 他们爱好捕鱼和出海。

examples.en: We must solve this problem like detectives studying clues.
examples.zh: 我们必须像侦探探查线索那样解决这个问题。

examples.en: How do you like the film Avatar?
examples.zh: 电影《阿凡达》你认为怎么样？

examples.en: Generally speaking, I don't enjoy swimming, but I'd like to swim this afternoon.
examples.zh: 总的来说，我不喜欢游泳，但今天下午我想去游泳。

notes:
名师点拨：like 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握其固定搭配：like ... better than 与 prefer ... to 意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：Arnold's parents like rice dumplings better than hamburgers.
= Arnold's parents prefer rice dumplings to hamburgers.
相比汉堡，阿诺德的父母更喜欢粽子。

examples.en: The organisers are very likely to cancel the fireworks display.
examples.zh: 主办方很有可能会取消烟花表演。

examples.en: Profit will most likely have risen by about $25 million.
examples.zh: 利润将极有可能增长约 2500 万美元。

examples.en: There is a limit to the amount of pain we can bear.
examples.zh: 我们对疼痛的忍耐是有限度的。

examples.en: He limited payments on the country's foreign debt.
examples.zh: 他对该国外债的偿还作出了限制。

examples.en: Fresh water is so limited that we can't waste it any more.
examples.zh: 净水如此有限，我们再也不能浪费。

examples.en: The middle line has seven words.
examples.zh: 中间的一行有7个单词。

examples.en: This factory uses advanced robots to operate the production lines.
examples.zh: 这家工厂使用先进的机器人来操作生产线。

examples.en: The line on the graph shows a steady increase in sales over the past year.
examples.zh: 图表上的线条显示了过去一年销售额稳步增长。

examples.en: My stomach is growling. Let's line up.
examples.zh: 我饿得肚子咕咕叫，我们排队吧。

examples.en: Some people link the world warming to the El Nino Phenomenon.
examples.zh: 有些人把全球气温上升跟厄尔尼诺现象联系在一起。

examples.en: Do you know the link between smoking and lung cancer?
examples.zh: 吸烟和肺癌之间的关系，你知道吗？

examples.en: She was frightened by the roars of a lion.
examples.zh: 她被狮子的吼叫声吓呆了。

examples.en: Air is a fluid but not a liquid.
examples.zh: 空气是流体而不是液体。

examples.en: The medicine was in liquid form, making it easy to swallow.
examples.zh: 这药是液体的，很容易吞服。

examples.en: Please choose three books from the list for your winter reading.
examples.zh: 请从这份书单里挑选三本书作为你的寒假读物。

examples.en: The travel agency will list the available tour packages on their website.
examples.zh: 旅行社将在他们的网站上列出可用的旅行套餐。

examples.en: How wonderful the music is! I will listen to it again.
examples.zh: 这音乐多么美妙！我会再听一遍的。

examples.en: Don't leave litter everywhere.
examples.zh: 不要把垃圾扔得到处都是。

examples.en: If you litter, you will spoil the natural beauty of the surroundings.
examples.zh: 如果你随手乱扔垃圾的话，就会破坏周围环境的自然美。

inflections: 比较级 less /les/, 最高级 least /liːst/

examples.en: There is little pollution here in Shanghai, is there?
examples.zh: 上海这里很少有污染，是吗？

examples.en: The Shanghai Airport Link Line will be open to traffic, so it will take us less time to go to Pudong International Airport.
examples.zh: 上海机场联络线将要通车，所以我们去浦东国际机场会花费更少时间。

examples.en: I have seen him very little recently.
examples.zh: 最近我很少见到他。

examples.en: Little remains to be done about it.
examples.zh: 关于这一点，几乎没有什么可做的。

notes:
名师点拨：little 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法，及比较与 few 的用法区别：
1) few, a few 用来修饰可数名词；little, a little 用来修饰不可数名词。
2) a few, a little 表示肯定意义；few, little 表示否定意义。
例如：I can speak a little English. 我能讲一点英语。
He has made a few mistakes in the exam. 他在考试中犯了一些错误。
There is little sugar left. I will go to the supermarket to buy some. 几乎没有糖了。我要去超市买一些。
Few people came to the meeting. 几乎没人来参加会议。
3) 在 only 和 quite 后面要用 a few 或 a little, 不能用 few 或 little。
例如：only a little water 只有一点点水
quite a few students 不少学生
4) few 和 little 可与 very, so, too 等词连用。
例如：very few 非常少
so little 如此少

senses.zh: 活的；现场直播的；现场演出的

examples.en: Miss Wang has got a big room to live in.
examples.zh: 王小姐住在一间大房间里。

examples.en: This is my favourite live album of all time.
examples.zh: 这是我有史以来最喜爱的现场版专辑。

proverbs: Live and learn. 活到老，学到老。

examples.en: During the war, the old lady was protected by a local family in Shanghai in her fifties.
examples.zh: 战争期间，这位老妇人在她 50 多岁时受到上海一户人家的保护。

examples.en: I'm a local.
examples.zh: 我是本地人。

senses.zh: 坐落于；确定……的准确地点

examples.en: Where shall we locate our new office building?
examples.zh: 我们的新办公楼将坐落于何处？

examples.en: It also shows the location of the products.
examples.zh: 它还显示了产品的摆放位置。

examples.en: A golden key will open every lock.
examples.zh: 金钥匙可以打开每一把锁。

examples.en: Lock the door when you're away.
examples.zh: 不在家时，门要锁上。

examples.en: What time does the train from London get in?
examples.zh: 从伦敦来的火车何时进站？

examples.en: He doesn't feel lonely when he is left alone.
examples.zh: 在只剩下他一个人的时候，他并不感到孤独。

notes:
名师点拨：lonely 是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其与 alone 的用法区别：
lonely 是指人孤独，寂寞的意思，alone 则表示单独，独自一人。
例如：She lives alone, but she doesn't feel lonely. 她一个人住，但她不感到寂寞。

senses.zh: (时间) 长的；(距离) 远的

examples.en: We couldn't believe that it was her real hair because it was so long.
examples.zh: 我们简直不敢相信这是她自己的头发，因为它是那么长。

examples.en: She waited long for the bus to arrive.
examples.zh: 她等了很久才等来公交车。

examples.en: Let's have a look!
examples.zh: 我们去看看！

examples.en: Look at the blackboard, please.
examples.zh: 请看黑板。

examples.en: She looks unhappy today, and she has been very quiet since this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天看起来闷闷不乐，从早上起就一直很安静。

proverbs: Look before you jump. 三思而后行。

examples.en: Four people were hurt in the car accident, but luckily no lives were lost.
examples.zh: 在车祸中有 4 人受伤，幸好无人丧生。

examples.en: John lost his new calculator on his way to school yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天约翰在去学校的路上弄丢了他的新计算器。

senses.zh: 丢失的；迷路的；弄不懂的；困惑的

examples.en: When Andy was unhappy about his lost smartphone, his friend gave him a big hug.
examples.zh: 当安迪为丢失了智能手机而郁闷时，他的朋友给了他一个大大的拥抱。

examples.en: The intricate plot of the movie left many viewers feeling lost.
examples.zh: 这部电影错综复杂的情节让许多观众感到困惑。

examples.en: Lots of students went to the school hall to enjoy the wonderful paintings by Mr. Hu.
examples.zh: 很多学生前往学校礼堂来欣赏胡先生的精彩画作。

phrases: a lot of/lots of 许多

examples.en: The music is too loud. Could you turn it down, please?
examples.zh: 音乐声太大了。你可以开得轻一点吗？

examples.en: She spoke loud enough for everyone to hear.
examples.zh: 她大声讲话以便所有人都能听见。

proverbs: Action speaks louder than words. 事实胜于雄辩。

examples.en: The baby cried loudly when he emptied his bottle.
examples.zh: 婴儿一喝完瓶里的东西就大哭起来。

examples.en: The door of parents' love for children will never be closed.
examples.zh: 父母对孩子永远敞开爱的大门。

examples.en: I love you, everyone.
examples.zh: 我爱你们每个人。

examples.en: She looks lovely in the pink dress!
examples.zh: 她穿粉红色连衣裙看起来很可爱！

examples.en: The children are looking happily at these lovely dogs.
examples.zh: 孩子们高兴地看着这些可爱的狗狗们。

examples.en: When prices are low, he buys in.
examples.zh: 价格便宜时他买进。

examples.en: This bird is flying quite low.
examples.zh: 这只鸟飞得相当低。

examples.en: I had the luck to get a ticket.
examples.zh: 我侥幸弄到了一张票。

derivations.zh: 幸运的；有好运的；运气好的

examples.en: Luckily, the small ship came back safely after a big storm.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，一场大风暴后，小船安全回来了。

senses.zh: 幸运的；有好运的；运气好的

examples.en: With the help of the police, Tim was lucky enough to get back his lost bike.
examples.zh: 在警察的帮助下，蒂姆幸运地找回了丢失的自行车。

examples.en: Most Chinese people think that eight is a lucky number.
examples.zh: 大多数中国人认为8是一个幸运数字。

examples.en: I need a cart for my luggage.
examples.zh: 我需要一辆行李车来装行李。

examples.en: Nobody at the lunch table believed the truth of his story.
examples.zh: 在午餐桌上，没人相信他的故事是真的。

examples.en: The silk clothes can't be washed in the washing machine.
examples.zh: 丝绸衣服不可以用洗衣机洗。

examples.en: The noise will drive me mad.
examples.zh: 这噪音会使我发疯的。

examples.en: Look! There is a magazine on the teacher's desk. Is it yours?
examples.zh: 瞧！老师的办公桌上有一本杂志。是你的吗？

examples.en: The magician is going to perform magic at the party.
examples.zh: 这位魔术师将在晚会上表演魔术。

examples.en: As the sun set over the ocean, she captured the magic moment with her camera.
examples.zh: 当太阳在海上落下，她用相机捕捉到了这个神奇的时刻。

examples.en: A postman's job is to deliver mail.
examples.zh: 邮递员的工作就是送邮件。

examples.en: They asked her to mail him a letter.
examples.zh: 他们要她给他寄封信。

examples.en: The main idea of the paragraph usually appears in the first sentence of the paragraph.
examples.zh: 段落的主要意思通常出现在该段的第一句上。

notes:
名师点拨：main是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：main与the most important意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：The main report at the meeting is our headmaster's speech.
= The most important report at the meeting is our headmaster's speech.
会上最重要的报告是我们校长的讲话。

examples.en: The old man's money mainly comes from family business.
examples.zh: 这位老人的财产主要来自家族企业。

examples.en: The two major dancers are level with each other.
examples.zh: 两个主要舞蹈演员水平相当。

examples.en: Mathematics is my major.
examples.zh: 我的专业是数学。

examples.en: Most passengers were talking happily with each other when the bus made a sudden stop.
examples.zh: 当大部分乘客正高兴地交谈时，汽车突然停了下来。

examples.en: Could you please make a plan for our class trip?
examples.zh: 你能为我们的班级旅行做一个计划吗？

examples.en: It has little effect on the study if you make the students write all the time.
examples.zh: 如果你让学生一直写，这对学习几乎是没有效果的。

phrases: be made of 由……制成(看得见原材料)
be made from 由……制成(看不见原材料)
be made up of 由……组成
make sure 尽力做到；务请；确保；查明；确信
notes:
名师点拨：make是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握使役动词make的习惯用法。
1) make sth. done 使某物被做
例如：make my hair cut 让我的头发被剪掉(剪头发)
2) make sb./sth. + adj. 使某人/某物处于某种状态
例如：They tried to make her happy, but in vain. 他们设法使她高兴，但那是徒劳的。
3) make sb. do sth. = sb. be made to do sth. 使某人做某事
例如：The heavy snowstorm made the mountain climbers stop halfway.
= The mountain climbers were made to stop halfway by the heavy snowstorm.
暴风雪使登山者半途而废。

examples.en: The school master is a male teacher.
examples.zh: 校长是位男老师。

examples.en: He was the only male in the dance class.
examples.zh: 他是舞蹈班里唯一的男性。

examples.en: Look at the photo! The fifth man from the right is my class teacher.
examples.zh: 看照片！从右边起第五个男人是我的班主任。

proverbs: No man is born wise or learned. 人非生而知之者。

senses.zh: 管理；经营；处理；设法对付，完成(困难的事)；明智地使用

examples.en: I manage a team of six engineers.
examples.zh: 我管理一个由 6 位工程师组成的小组。

examples.en: With only a few minutes left, they managed to turn the game around.
examples.zh: 只剩几分钟了，他们成功扭转了比赛局势。

notes:
名师点拨：manage 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：manage to do 与 succeed in doing 意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：We have managed to drag the fallen tree clear of the road.
= We have succeeded in dragging the fallen tree clear of the road.
我们已经成功地把那棵倒下的树拖离道路。

examples.zh: 如果你不喜欢这产品，请随时向经理投诉。

examples.en: People need to work things out in their own manner and in their own time.
examples.zh: 人们需要以自己的方式和时间来处理问题。

examples.en: I won't believe the five-year-old boy can read so many words until I have tested him myself.
examples.zh: 直到我亲自对他进行了测试, 我才相信这个 5 岁的孩子会读这么多的单词。

examples.en: I asked my friends for suggestions, and many were very helpful.
examples.zh: 我向朋友们征求建议, 很多建议都相当有帮助。

examples.zh: 每年的 3 月 12 日要种植大量的树木。

examples.zh: 如果你每天都复习一下, 你可以获得好成绩。

examples.en: Please mark where you have some questions.

examples.zh: 最近的集市在哪儿?

examples.en: — Our class failed in the school's football match last week. — What a pity!
examples.zh: ——上周学校的足球比赛我们班输了。——多可惜!

examples.en: No one can match him in singing.
examples.zh: 论唱歌谁也比不过他。

examples.en: Jack measured the length of the table to calculate how much material would be needed.
examples.zh: 杰克测量了这张桌子的长度, 以便计算所需材料的用量。

examples.en: Tim spoke so quietly that he was asked to repeat himself in the maths class.
examples.zh: 蒂姆说话太轻了，数学课上他被要求再说一遍。

senses.zh: 要紧事；麻烦事；事情；问题；物质

examples.en: It's a personal matter.
examples.zh: 这是件私事。

examples.en: No matter what they tell us, what we believe is true.
examples.zh: 无论他们告诉我们什么，我们坚信的是真理。

examples.en: Depend on your passion and it will guide you towards what truly matters in life.
examples.zh: 坚守你的热爱，它会指引你找到人生中真正重要的东西。

examples.en: We will leave Beijing on the twenty-fifth of May.
examples.zh: 我们将在5月25日离开北京。

examples.en: You may lose your way if you walk alone in the mountains at night.
examples.zh: 如果晚上你独自一人在山里走，你可能会迷路。

examples.en: — May I park my car here for a while? — No, you mustn't. Do you see the sign “NO PARKING”?
examples.zh: ——我可以把车停在这里一会儿吗？——不，你不能。你看到“禁止停车”的标志吗？

notes:
名师点拨：may 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握以下用法区别：
1) may be v. 可能是
must be v. 一定是
can't be v. 不可能是（否定猜测用 can't be；肯定猜测用 may be 和 must be；可能性大用 must be，可能性小用 may be。）
maybe (= perhaps) adv. 可能
2) may 引导的一般疑问句的否定回答要用 mustn't，表示“不允许”“不准”“不行”等意思。
例如：— May I take this dictionary out of the library? — No, you mustn't.
——我可以把这本字典拿出图书馆吗？——不，不行。

examples.en: It's clouding up. Maybe it'll rain this afternoon.
examples.zh: 天阴起来了，今天下午也许有雨。

examples.en: Linda often helps her parents with the housework after meals.
examples.zh: 琳达饭后经常帮助父母做家务。

examples.en: What do you mean?
examples.zh: 你什么意思？

examples.en: The little girls had locked themselves in upstairs because Mack had been mean to them.
examples.zh: 小姑娘们把自己锁在楼上，因为麦克对她们很刻薄。

examples.en: These words are empty of meaning.
examples.zh: 这些话毫无意义。

examples.zh: 医生说：“朱先生，您最好不要吃太多的肉。您已经超重了。”

examples.en: He has been at the forefront of medical progress for years.
examples.zh: 多年来，他一直处于医学发展的最前沿。

examples.en: How often should you take the medicine?
examples.zh: 这药你应该多长时间服一次？

proverbs: A good medicine tastes bitter. 良药苦口。

examples.en: A medium coffee please.
examples.zh: 请给我一杯中杯咖啡。

examples.en: Art serves as a powerful medium for expressing complex emotions and ideas.
examples.zh: 艺术是表达复杂情感和思想的强有力媒介。

senses.zh: 遇见，见到；会见；迎接；满足

examples.en: Guess who I met in Nanjing Road?
examples.zh: 你猜我在南京路遇见了谁？

examples.en: To meet the needs of people from different countries, that book was published in different languages.
examples.zh: 为了满足来自不同国家读者的需求，这本书用不同语种出版。

examples.en: The athletic meet attracted participants from all over the country.
examples.zh: 这次运动会吸引了全国各地的参赛者。

examples.en: The 8th School Sports Meeting was put off because of the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 因下大雨，第8届校运动会推迟了。

examples.en: The meeting between the two leaders was highly anticipated by the media.
examples.zh: 两位领导人的会见备受媒体关注。

examples.en: One member of the surgical team administers the checklist.
examples.zh: 外科小组的一名成员负责管理清单。

examples.en: All the beautiful memories came into my mind when I saw these pictures.

notes:
名师点拨：none 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握 none 的习惯用法，及比较与 neither 和 no one 的用法区别。
none 指三者及以上的人或物，表示“没有一个”的意思。另外，none 后常接 of 短语，of 后可接可数名词或代词；作主语时，谓语动词用单、复数形式皆可；of 后也可接不可数名词，这时谓语动词必须用单数形式。
neither 指两者中“没有一个”。
no one = nobody，只指人，表示“没有人”，不能指物，后面不能接 of 构成的短语。no one 作主语时，谓语动词只能用单数形式。
例如：Sorry, but none of us speaks/speak English. 抱歉！我们中没有一个人会讲英语。
None of the money on the desk is mine. 桌上的那些钱都不是我的。
There are many apples in the basket, but none of them are fresh. 篮子里有很多苹果，但没有一个是新鲜的。
There are two apples on the plate, but neither of them is fresh. 盘子里有两个苹果，但没有一个是新鲜的。
No one/Nobody likes a person with bad manners. 不讲礼貌的人没有人喜欢。
注意：
none 用来回答 How many … 或 How much … 引起的问句以及含“any (one) of + 名词”构成的一般疑问句。
no one/nobody 用来回答 Who … 引起的问句及含 anyone/anybody 的一般疑问句。
nothing 用来回答 What … 引起的问句及含 anything 的一般疑问句。
例如：① — How much water is there in the bottle? — None. ——瓶子里有多少水？——一点儿也没了。
② — Did any one of the passengers get injured in the accident? — No, none was injured. ——有乘客在这场意外中受伤吗？——不，没人受伤。
③ — Who will go to the party? — No one/Nobody. ——谁会去派对？——没人去。
④ — Did anyone want to attend the meeting? — No, no one/nobody wanted to. ——有谁想参加那场会议吗？——不，没人想去。
⑤ — What’s in your hand? — Nothing. ——你手里有什么？——什么也没有。
⑥ — Do you have anything else to say for yourself? — No, nothing else. ——你还有什么要为自己说的吗？——没有了。

notes:
名师点拨：nothing 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法，及比较与 none 的用法区别：
nothing = not anything，意为“没有任何东西；什么也没有”，强调内容，只能指物，泛指。
例如：He felt hungry, but he could find nothing to eat in the kitchen. 他饿了，但在厨房里他没有找到吃的东西。（泛指所有吃的东西，不是特指某一种）
nothing 的习惯用法有以下3点：
1) 泛指物；2) 谓语用单数；3) 一般用来回答含 anything 的一般疑问句及 what 引起的特殊问句。
例如：① — What is in the box? — Nothing. ——那盒子里有什么？——什么也没有。
② — Is there anything in the sky? — Nothing. ——天空中有什么？——什么也没有。
③ — Can you see anything without glasses? — Nothing. ——你不戴眼镜能看见什么吗？——啥也看不见。
none = not any, not one，意为“一点也没有；一个也没有”，即数量概念。既可指人，也可指物，代指上文提到的事物，含特指概念。
例如：He wants me to lend him some money, but I have none at hand. 他想要我借些钱给他，但我现在手头上一个子儿也没有。（特指前面提到的钱）
They asked for nine books, but there is/are none in the library at present. 他们需要9本书，但目前图书馆一本都没有。（特指前面提到的书）
none 的习惯用法有以下4点：
1) 可与 of连用；2) 谓语动词用单或复数均可；3) 具体指什么人或物；4) 一般用来回答 How many + n., How much + n.，及含 any + n. 的疑问句。
例如：① None of us have/has seen him. 我们都没有见过他。
② — How many students are there in the room? — None. ——房间里有多少学生？——一个也没有。
③ — How much money do you have on you? — None. ——你带了多少钱？——一分没带。
④ — Is there any water in the thermos? — None. ——暖水瓶里有水吗？——没有。

examples.en: We'd better put up a notice here.

examples.en: Did you notice him leave the house?
examples.zh: 你注意到他离开那个房子了吗？

examples.en: She spent a peaceful afternoon by the river, reading a novel.
examples.zh: 她在河边看小说，度过了一个宁静的下午。

examples.en: Thanksgiving Day falls on the fourth Thursday in November in the U.S.A.

examples.zh: 现在让我们来谈谈什么是主要思想，及如何找出主要思想。

examples.zh: 既然所有乘客都到了，我们为什么还不出发呢？

examples.zh: 如今，视频博客比传统的日记更实用，尤其是受到年轻人的欢迎。

examples.en: Is Li Ping's mother a nurse or a doctor?
examples.zh: 李平的母亲是护士还是医生？

examples.en: Drivers should obey traffic rules to ensure the safety of themselves and others.
examples.zh: 司机应该遵守交通规则，以确保自己和他人的安全。

examples.en: It would be equally important for Sister Badgery to observe.

examples.en: He wanted to look for an occupation suited to his abilities.

examples.en: The world really has one big ocean.
examples.zh: 世界上其实只有一个海洋。

examples.en: I woke up at four o'clock this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我4点钟就醒了。

examples.zh: 他们有两个自己的孩子。

examples.zh: 我们说了声“再见”，他便转身离去，没再说一句话。

examples.zh: 他很快吃完了两碗鸡汤面。

examples.zh: 国家博物馆每周一为学生提供免费门票。

examples.zh: 这是官方的政策路线。

examples.en: Kitty is such an honest student that she is often praised by her teachers.
examples.zh: 姬蒂是这样一位诚实的学生，她经常受到老师的表扬。

examples.zh: 在互联网上与我们的朋友聊天多么有趣啊！

examples.zh: 汤姆穿上他的鞋子。

examples.en: I've been so forgetful lately. Once I even walked into an exam hall without a pen.
examples.zh: 我最近变得特别健忘，有一次甚至没带笔就进了考场。

examples.en: He was once unlucky in his work.
examples.zh: 他一度工作不顺利。

examples.en: Once we lived in London.
examples.zh: 我们曾经在伦敦住过。

examples.en: Once is enough.
examples.zh: 一次就够了。

examples.en: Once you get into a bad habit, you'll find it hard to get out of it.
examples.zh: 一旦染上坏习惯，想改掉就难了。

phrases: once more = once again 再次
proverbs: Once bitten, twice shy. 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井绳。

examples.en: He is one who never troubles about his personal interests.
examples.zh: 他是一个从不计较个人利益的人。

examples.en: Besides, you need to make up a story. Can you write your own one?
examples.zh: 此外，你需要编一个故事。你可以写写你自己的故事吗？

phrases: one after another 一个接一个，连续地
notes:
名师点拨：one 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法：one of 后面接最高级，名词复数。
例如：JD.com is one of the largest shopping websites in China. 京东网是中国最大的购物网站之一。

examples.en: It's true that our life has become much easier with the growth of online payment services.
examples.zh: 随着在线支付服务的发展，我们的生活确实变得方便多了。

examples.en: Mike's parents were worried that he spent too much time chatting online.
examples.zh: 迈克的父母担心他花太多时间在网上聊天。

examples.en: There is only a little milk.
examples.zh: 只有一点牛奶了。

examples.en: Our only resort is to inform the police.
examples.zh: 我们唯一的办法是向警方报案。

notes:
名师点拨：only 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：only 与 can't ... better ... than that 意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：I can only give you that advice.= I can't give you better advice than that.
我只能给你那条建议。

examples.en: His spoon dropped onto the ground.
examples.zh: 他的汤勺掉到了地上。

senses.zh: 开着的，开口的；敞开的；营业中的

examples.en: “Please open your mouth wide, so that I can examine your teeth easily,” said the dentist.
examples.zh: 牙医生说：“请张大嘴，便于我检查你的牙齿”。

examples.en: Keep the window open while you are in.
examples.zh: 在房里时请把窗打开。

examples.en: The reading room in our neighbourhood is open from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. on weekdays.
examples.zh: 我们小区的阅读室平日开放时间是从上午 9 时至下午 9 时。

examples.en: Doctor Lin left in a hurry to operate on a wounded young man just now.
examples.zh: 林医生刚才匆匆赶去为一个受伤的年轻男子动手术。

examples.en: The art class students can operate the digital drawing tools after practice.
examples.zh: 美术课的学生经过练习后，能够操作这些数字绘图工具。

examples.en: Computers are widely used to operate railways and fly planes in our life.
examples.zh: 在我们的生活中，计算机被广泛用于铁路运营和飞机飞行操控。

examples.en: The doctor performed an operation on her brain last week.
examples.zh: 上周医生为她做了脑部手术。

examples.en: In my opinion, Tim doesn't write English as clearly as his sister.
examples.zh: 在我看来，蒂姆的英文没有他妹妹写得清楚。

phrases: in one's opinion 根据某人的看法

senses.zh: 在……对面的；相对的；对立的

examples.en: I should have written the notes in the opposite order.
examples.zh: 我本应按相反的顺序记笔记的。

examples.en: Jennie had sat opposite her at breakfast.
examples.zh: 珍妮吃早餐时坐在她对面。

examples.en: Take the exam carefully, or you won't get full marks.
examples.zh: 考试时要仔细，否则你就得不到满分。

notes:
名师点拨：or 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法：
1) 祈使句，or... = If you don't..., you'll/Unless you..., you'll...
例如：Hurry up, or you'll miss the bus.
= If you don't hurry up, you'll miss the bus.
= Unless you hurry up, you'll miss the bus.
快点，否则你会赶不上公共汽车的。
Take the underground, or you will be late for the lecture.
= You won't be late for the lecture if you take the underground.
= You will be late for the lecture unless you take the underground.
乘地铁去，否则你听讲座就会迟到了。
2) 否定句中替换 and。
例如：He can't read or write. 他不会读也不会写。

examples.en: Orange juice contains things which help keep you healthy.
examples.zh: 橘子汁里含有益于健康的东西。

examples.en: I prefer that orange blouse.
examples.zh: 我更喜欢那件橙色的女衬衫。

examples.en: The commander gave his order to the soldier.
examples.zh: 指挥官向士兵下达命令。

examples.en: The cups were arranged in order of size.
examples.zh: 杯子按大小排列。

examples.en: I have ordered an egg for you.
examples.zh: 我已经帮你点了个蛋。

examples.en: I just want an ordinary car.
examples.zh: 我只想要一辆普通的车。

examples.en: The United Nations Organization consists of over 190 nations.
examples.zh: 联合国组织由 190 多个国家组成。

examples.en: We organize the “Low-Carbon Life” activity every month to protect the environment.
examples.zh: 为了保护环境，我们每个月都会组织“低碳生活”主题活动。

examples.en: Once the repair is finished, I’m sure no other playground is better than ours.
examples.zh: 修缮完成后，我敢肯定没有哪个操场比我们的更好了。

examples.en: Of the five memory exercises, two are really hard, and the other three are much easier.
examples.zh: 在这五项记忆练习中，有两项真的很难，另外三项则容易得多。

examples.en: New Zealand has two islands. One is North Island and the other is South Island.
examples.zh: 新西兰有两个岛。一个是北岛，另一个是南岛。

notes:
名师点拨：other 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法，及比较与 another 的用法区别：
1) the other 指两者中的另一个，常与 one 连用，构成 one … and the other 结构；another 则指三个以上的另一个。
例如：There are two new students in our class. One is from Japan and the other is from Australia. 我们班有两个新同学。一个来自日本，另一个来自澳大利亚。
I don’t like this shirt. Could you show me another one? 我不喜欢这件衬衫。能给我看看另一件吗？
2) the others = the other + 复数名词，是特指一定范围内的剩下的那一些人或事物；而 others = other + 复数名词，是泛指，没有一定的范围。
例如：There are ten students in our group. Four are girls, and the others are boys. 我们组有 10 个学生。4 个女孩，其他是男孩。
Some people like ball games, but others don’t. 有些人喜欢球类运动，而另一些人不喜欢。

examples.en: He ought to keep his promise.
examples.zh: 他应该遵守诺言。

examples.en: Let’s go out for a walk.
examples.zh: 我们出去散散步吧。

examples.en: The streetlights were out after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，路灯都熄灭了。

phrases: out of 从……里出来；缺乏

examples.en: I like outdoor sports.
examples.zh: 我喜欢室外运动。

senses.zh: 远足；郊游；(集体)外出游玩(或学习等)

examples.en: We were just thinking of an outing, but the odds were against us and it began to rain.
examples.zh: 我们正想去郊游，不料天公不作美，下起雨来了。

examples.en: For example, you might want to speak about your interests and hobbies outside school.
examples.zh: 比如说，你可能想说说你在校外的兴趣和爱好。

examples.en: It's raining outside. I'd rather watch TV at home than go to the cinema.
examples.zh: 外面在下雨。我宁愿在家看电视也不愿去看电影。

examples.en: She took the pie out of the oven.
examples.zh: 她将馅饼从烤箱中拿出来。

examples.en: We live over a small bookstore.
examples.zh: 我们住在一家小书店的楼上。

examples.en: The war was over about three months ago.
examples.zh: 大约3个月前战争结束了。

phrases: over and over 再三；一次次

examples.zh: 我们都知道学习的成功主要取决于自己的努力。

examples.zh: 在人工智能的帮助下，人们无需花费大量时间自行搜索信息。

examples.en: He owns three cars.
examples.zh: 他有3辆汽车。

examples.en: Who is the owner of that motorcycle?
examples.zh: 谁是那辆摩托车的主人？

examples.en: He visited the Pacific Islands yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天访问了太平洋岛屿。

examples.en: The tourist carried a pack on his back.
examples.zh: 观光旅行者背了个包。

examples.en: When I was seventeen, I packed my bags and left home.
examples.zh: 17 岁时，我背起行囊离开了家。

examples.en: Do the exercises on page ten.
examples.zh: 做第 10 页上的练习。

examples.en: He has a pain in his stomach.
examples.zh: 他胃痛。

examples.en: The loss of her beloved pet pained her deeply.
examples.zh: 失去心爱宠物使她深深感到痛苦。

examples.en: — Have you moved into the new house? — Not yet, the rooms are being painted.
examples.zh: ——你搬进新房了吗？——没有，房间还在粉刷呢。

examples.en: He bought me a box of paints.
examples.zh: 他给我买了一盒颜料。

examples.en: There is a beautiful painting on the wall in each room of my house.
examples.zh: 我住所里每个房间的墙上都有一幅美丽的画。

examples.en: This pair of shoes fits me well.
examples.zh: 这双鞋我穿很合脚。

examples.zh: 在古代，北京、西安和南京建有许多宫殿。

examples.zh: 她吓得脸色发白。

examples.en: The panda attracted many children.
examples.zh: 那只熊猫吸引了不少孩子。

examples.en: He wrote a number on a piece of paper.
examples.zh: 他在一张纸上写了一个数字。

examples.en: I read the news in the papers.
examples.zh: 我在报纸上看到了这则消息。

examples.en: Peter will cook for his parents when the International Day of Families comes.
examples.zh: “国际家庭日”到来时，彼得将为他的父母做饭。

examples.zh: 巴黎是法国首都。

examples.en: Mr. Smith thought the Century Park was the second largest park in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 史密斯先生认为，世纪公园是上海第二大公园。

examples.en: He found a place to park the car.
examples.zh: 他找到了一个停车位。

examples.en: What an important part computers have played in our daily life!
examples.zh: 计算机在我们的日常生活中扮演着多么重要的角色啊！

examples.en: They were partners in crime.
examples.zh: 他俩是同谋。

examples.en: Lucy introduced herself before the welcome party.
examples.zh: 露西在欢迎派对开始前做了自我介绍。

examples.en: He passed the ball to Edwards.
examples.zh: 他把球传给了爱德华。

examples.en: The students were celebrating the Art Festival when I passed by their school.
examples.zh: 当我经过他们学校时，学生们正在举行艺术节庆祝活动。

examples.en: She applied for a visitor pass to access the government building.
examples.zh: 她申请了一张访客通行证以进入政府大楼。

phrases: pass on 传递；转交；(用后) 递给，传给

examples.zh: 人们对这一段文字有不同的解释。

examples.en: This bus can carry fifty passengers.
examples.zh: 这辆公交车可载 50 名乘客。

examples.en: A person who travels abroad must carry a passport.
examples.zh: 出国旅行要携带护照。

examples.zh: 我 10 点半到的。

examples.zh: 现在乘公共汽车出行比过去更舒适。

examples.zh: 病人越早接受治疗，康复的可能性就越大。

examples.en: She was really unhappy to see her favourite vase break into pieces right in front of her.

examples.zh: 三分之二的人同意这个新计划。

examples.zh: 虽然姚明已经让全世界知道他有打篮球的天赋，他依然非常谦虚。

examples.en: Mike practised playing the piano for five hours a day in order to get a prize in the contest.
examples.zh: 为了能在比赛中获奖，迈克每天练习5个小时钢琴。

examples.zh: 你喜欢那个戏剧吗？

phrases: play a trick on 捉弄
act in a play 参演戏剧

examples.en: People crowded round the player with congratulations.
examples.zh: 人们簇拥着那个运动员向他祝贺。

examples.zh: 我们对自己的新居很满意。

phrases: with pleasure 愉快地；乐意地

examples.zh: 然后想想你自己——你的优点和缺点。

examples.zh: 我们用树枝做钓竿。

examples.en: “Would you please stop smoking?” the little girl said to the man politely.

examples.zh: 政治学是他大学的课程之一。

examples.zh: 如果人们不采取任何行动，环境将受到严重污染。

examples.zh: 上海所有的学生都应该为保护环境与污染作斗争。

examples.zh: 现在她很受朋友欢迎，也获得了更多的自信。

examples.en: More nursing homes will be built for the aging population in the next few years.
examples.zh: 在未来几年将建造更多的养老院，以应对人口老龄化。

examples.zh: 为家人和客人包饺子你需要多少猪肉？

examples.zh: 如果你能弄到那本书，请邮寄给我。

examples.zh: 昨天他们在超市买了一些新鲜的土豆。

examples.zh: 今年他们建造了 3 座核电站。

examples.zh: 她的声音如此响亮，以至于传到了音乐厅的每个角落。

examples.zh: 在我们的辩论社里，我们每周都练习写作并发表简短的演讲。

examples.zh: 他的好品行值得表扬。

examples.zh: 比起游泳，我更喜欢跑步。

phrases: prefer ... to ... (比起……来) 更喜欢……

examples.zh: 总统将在国庆节的上午发表讲话。

examples.zh: 她闭上眼睛装睡。

examples.zh: 他考试考得相当不错。

examples.zh: 怎么预防疾病？

examples.zh: 大雨阻止了我们原计划的徒步旅行。

examples.zh: 现在人们都抱怨食品价格比以前高了。

examples.zh: 她在上小学。

examples.zh: 该项目的主要目标是减少环境污染。

examples.zh: 用斜体印刷这个字。

examples.zh: 那边的那幢建筑是一座监狱。

examples.en: Some young people are now rich enough to buy private cars.
examples.zh: 现在有一些年轻人有能力买私家车。

examples.zh: 得知自己的科学项目获得了一等奖，安迪感到十分惊讶。

examples.zh: 很可能他把一切都告诉她了。

examples.zh: 约翰很可能把这一切都告诉了他父亲。

examples.zh: 我相信你会成功解决这个问题，除非你放弃。

examples.zh: 这台计算机处理数据有多快？

examples.zh: 学习是一个尝试、失败、再尝试，最后成功的过程。

examples.zh: 这个计划是经过长时间仔细思考的产物。

examples.zh: 我喜欢由上海教育电视台制作的《学生眼中的学校》这个节目。

examples.zh: 私人教练将为每位客户量身定制训练计划。

examples.zh: 如果努力学习，你就会取得很大进步。

examples.zh: 琳达在做中国传统食物这个项目时，远远比我仔细。

examples.zh: 他不仅作出了许诺，而且履行了诺言。

examples.zh: 警方承诺会抓获绑匪并救出这位演员。

examples.zh: 他能正确地念这个字。

examples.zh: 健康食品对我们大脑的正常运转非常重要。

examples.zh: 我们有必要知道在地震中如何保护自己。

examples.zh: 她带了把伞来遮雨。

examples.zh: 赢得比赛后, 队员们感到无比自豪。

examples.zh: 为了保护环境, 超市不再为顾客提供免费塑料袋。

examples.zh: 这个组织向贫困儿童提供教育资源。

examples.zh: 玛丽的父亲很少在公共场所抽烟，是吗？

examples.en: When he heard a cry for help, he ran out as quickly as he could.
examples.zh: 一听到呼救声，他就尽快跑了出来。

examples.en: Online team-buying services are developing quickly in China, aren't they?
examples.zh: 在中国，网上团购服务正在迅速发展，不是吗？

examples.en: I'm going to move somewhere quiet. It's too noisy in our neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 我打算搬到一个安静的地方。我们的小区太吵了。

examples.en: The patient lay on his bed quietly when the doctor came to examine him.
examples.zh: 当医生来给这位病人检查时，他静静地躺在床上。

examples.en: This arrangement is quite satisfactory, so far as I am concerned.
examples.zh: 就我来说，这样的安排相当好。

examples.en: We'll have a quiz at the end of class.
examples.zh: 下课前我们将进行一次测试。

examples.en: Are you going to race your horse at Newmarket next week?
examples.zh: 你准备让你的马参加下周在纽马克特的赛马会吗？

examples.en: Peter and Bill each say they came first in the race.
examples.zh: 彼得和比尔都说自己跑了第一。

examples.en: Father bought her a stereo radio.
examples.zh: 父亲给她买了台立体声收音机。

examples.en: The railway is still under construction.
examples.zh: 这条铁路仍在建设之中。

examples.en: In fact, there isn't so much rain in the city as they think.
examples.zh: 事实上，这座城市不像他们想的那样有这么多的雨水。

examples.en: We will go to the Happy Valley tomorrow unless it rains.
examples.zh: 如果明天不下雨，我们会去欢乐谷。

examples.en: Most tropical areas have rainy and dry seasons.
examples.zh: 大多数热带地区有雨季和旱季。

senses.zh: 举起，使升高，提升，增加；饲养，抚养；筹钱，筹集；提起

examples.en: The government plans to raise the living standard of citizens.
examples.zh: 政府计划提高市民的生活水平。

examples.en: It is not easy to raise three children on a small income.
examples.zh: 靠微薄的收入抚养三个孩子并不容易。

examples.en: The charity event successfully raised enough money to help the homeless.
examples.zh: 这场慈善活动成功筹集到了足够的资金来帮助无家可归的人。

examples.en: The government's decision on building a factory in the city centre has raised many questions among the local people.
examples.zh: 政府决定在城市中心建造一家工厂，这在当地人中已经引发了许多质疑。

notes:
名师点拨：raise 是常考单词，所以学生一定要比较 raise 与 rise 的用法区别：
raise 是及物动词；rise 是不及物动词。
例如：raise your hand 举起你的手
He raised his hat to me yesterday. 昨天他向我举帽致意。
The river rose two feet. 河水上涨 2 英尺。
The sun rises in the east. 太阳从东方升起。
He rose to answer the question. 他站起来回答问题。

examples.en: People in western countries rarely talk loudly in public, do they?
examples.zh: 在西方国家，人们很少在公共场所大声说话，是吗？

examples.en: They have been friends for years and have rarely argued.
examples.zh: 他们成为朋友已经好几年了，很少发生争执。

senses.zh: 相当，颇；宁可；反而；有点儿，稍微

examples.en: I'm feeling rather sleepy.
examples.zh: 我感到十分困倦。

examples.en: She was not angry, but rather disappointed by his actions.
examples.zh: 她没有生气，而是对他的举动很失望。

examples.en: I rather suspect that he is not telling the truth.
examples.zh: 我有点儿怀疑他没说实话。

examples.en: My uncle will send me postcards and stamps after he reaches France.
examples.zh: 我的叔叔到达法国后，会给我寄一些明信片邮票。

examples.en: He reached a high level of proficiency in playing the piano.
examples.zh: 他在演奏钢琴方面达到了高水平的熟练程度。

examples.en: It's easy to memorise the words if we know how to read them correctly.
examples.zh: 如果我们知道如何正确地读出这些单词，就很容易记住它们了。

examples.en: Tommy asked me if I was interested in reading science fiction.
examples.zh: 汤米问我是否对读科幻小说感兴趣。

examples.en: Jenny was reading the text of Lesson Three at 8:00 last night.
examples.zh: 昨天晚上 8 点珍妮正在读第 3 课的课文。

proverbs: Reading makes a full man. 读书长见识。

senses.zh: 准备好的；准备完毕的；乐于

examples.en: He is ready for the trip.
examples.zh: 他已准备好去旅行。

phrases: be/get ready for 为……作准备

examples.en: The real value of the book lies in its wonderful characterisation.
examples.zh: 这本书真正的价值在于精彩的人物塑造。

derivations.zh: 认识到；实现 (= be aware of)

examples.en: If you want to realize your dream, study hard from now on.
examples.zh: 如果你想实现自己的梦想，从现在开始就要努力学习。

examples.en: It's really impossible for a child of five to take care of himself.
examples.zh: 要 5 岁儿童自己照顾自己，这真的是不可能的。

examples.en: That is the reason why we must go now.
examples.zh: 那就是我们现在必须走的理由。

examples.en: The house was rebuilt after the fire.
examples.zh: 这房子是火灾后重建的。

examples.en: By the end of last month, Mrs. Lin had received many interesting comic strips created by the students.
examples.zh: 到上月底，林老师收到了许多由学生创作的有趣的漫画。

proverbs: It is better to give than to receive. 给予比索取更伟大。
notes:
名师点拨：receive 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：receive one's letter 与 hear from sb. 意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：I received my aunt's letter the other day.
= I heard from my aunt the other day.
几天前我收到我阿姨的来信。

examples.en: There have been many changes in our school in recent years.
examples.zh: 近几年，我们学校发生了许多变化。

examples.en: Recently, we have all worked harder to improve ourselves in many ways.
examples.zh: 最近，我们所有人都更加努力，在各个方面提升自己。

examples.en: She had changed so much that I could hardly recognize her.
examples.zh: 她的变化这么大，我简直认不出来了。

examples.en: Several world records were broken by Bolt at the Olympics.
examples.zh: 博尔特在奥运会上打破了多项世界纪录。

examples.en: She has recorded some popular songs.
examples.zh: 她录了一些通俗歌曲。

examples.en: We should recycle garbage, not burn it.
examples.zh: 我们应该回收利用垃圾，而不是焚烧。

examples.en: He was wearing a white shirt and a red tie.
examples.zh: 他穿着一件白衬衫，系了一条红领带。

examples.en: I prefer red to blue.
examples.zh: 比起蓝色，我更喜欢红色。

examples.en: We have reduced the number of classes from eight to six.
examples.zh: 我们已将班级数量由 8 个减少到 6 个。

examples.en: The author does not give references.
examples.zh: 作者没有注明参考(所引资料的)出处。

examples.en: I don't know why he refused the job offer.
examples.zh: 我不明白他为什么拒绝那份工作。

examples.en: The proud lady refuses to accept any advice.
examples.zh: 这位高傲的女士拒绝接受任何建议。

examples.en: Regular exercise is an effective way to stay healthy and reduce stress.
examples.zh: 规律运动是保持健康、缓解压力的有效方法。

examples.en: She found it impossible to extricate herself from the relationship.
examples.zh: 她发现自己不可能从这种关系中解脱出来。

examples.en: Today we visited our relative.
examples.zh: 今天我们探望了我们的亲戚。

examples.en: Sam needs to relax, so he is looking forward to a holiday.
examples.zh: 萨姆需要放松，所以他期待着假期。

examples.en: It helps us release anxious thoughts.
examples.zh: 它能帮助我们释放焦虑情绪。

examples.en: The movie will be on release from Christmas.
examples.zh: 影片将从圣诞节开始上映。

examples.en: You can always rely on Jim, he won't fail you.
examples.zh: 你可以永远依靠吉姆，他不会让你失望的。

examples.en: The famous singer died, but her sweet voice will be remembered for ever.
examples.zh: 这位著名歌手去世了，但她甜美的声音将永远被铭记。

notes:
名师点拨：remember 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法，及比较 remember doing 与 remember to do 的用法区别：
1) remember doing 表示记得做过某事(已做)。
2) remember to do 表示记住去做某件事(还没做)。
例如：I remembered turning off the lights when I left the room. 我记得我离开房间时把灯关了。
Please remember to close the door when you go to bed. 你去睡觉时，请记住把门关上。

examples.en: He reminded me that I ought to do it at once.
examples.zh: 他提醒我应该现在就去做这件事。

examples.en: The house is in need of repair.
examples.zh: 那幢房子需要整修。

examples.en: The students can not only operate the machines with safety but also repair them.
examples.zh: 学生们不仅能安全地操作这些机器，而且还能修理这些机器。

examples.en: Though I repeated the phone number many times, the foreigner still couldn't write it down.
examples.zh: 虽然我把电话号码重复了好多次，这个外国人还是不能把它写下来。

examples.zh: 她给我们作了关于项目进展的报告。

examples.zh: 已对这个剧本的历史背景进行了细致全面的研究。

examples.zh: 最新研究表明，定期锻炼可以改善心理健康。

examples.en: This country is rich in natural resources.
examples.zh: 该国自然资源丰富。

examples.en: I respect him for his diligence.
examples.zh: 我敬佩他的勤奋。

examples.en: The Double Ninth Festival reminds us to respect the elderly.
examples.zh: 重阳节提醒我们要尊重老人。

examples.en: She has received a response from that college to her application.
examples.zh: 她已经收到那所大学对她申请的答复。

examples.en: We need to take responsibility for looking after our own health.
examples.zh: 我们必须对自己的健康负责。

senses.zh: 负责的；有责任的；可信任的

examples.en: Being responsible means taking ownership of your mistakes and learning from them.
examples.zh: 有责任感意味着要对自己的错误负责，并从中吸取教训。

phrases: be responsible for 对……负责任

senses.zh: 休息；休息时间；剩余部分；其余的人(物)

examples.en: The doctor advised him to take a rest for a few days.
examples.zh: 医生建议他休息几天。

examples.en: The rest of us were allowed to go home.
examples.zh: 我们中的其他人被允许回家。

examples.en: You need to rest from your labour. You look very tired.
examples.zh: 你看上去很疲劳，需要放下工作休息一下。

examples.en: I shall leave the restaurant unless the waiter comes soon.
examples.zh: 除非服务员马上来，否则我就离开饭店。
examples.rewrite: I shall leave the restaurant if the waiter doesn't come soon.

examples.en: Remember, the harder you work, the more good results you will get.
examples.zh: 记住，你越努力工作，你越会得到好的结果。

examples.en: The retired workers receive money from the government till they die.
examples.zh: 退休工人从政府那里领取养老金直到去世为止。

examples.en: He returned the books to the library yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天把书还给了图书馆。

examples.en: After some time, small plants begin to grow. Animals return soon after the plants return. This again makes an eco-system.
examples.zh: 过了一段时间之后，幼苗开始生长。万物复苏，动物也回来了。这又形成了一个生态系统。

examples.en: The return of warm weather signals the arrival of spring.
examples.zh: 温暖天气的回归预示着春天的到来。

notes:
名师点拨：return 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：return 与 come back 意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：The girl didn't fall asleep until her mother returned last night.
= The girl didn't fall asleep until her mother came back last night.
昨晚这个女孩一直没有睡着，直到她妈妈回来。

examples.en: The same water was reused after chemical treatment.
examples.zh: 原来的水经过化学处理之后被再度利用。

derivations.zh: 可重复使用的；可再次使用的

examples.zh: 学院出版了一份戏剧评论刊物。

examples.en: Have you reviewed what we covered in class yesterday?
examples.zh: 昨天我们课堂上讲的东西你们复习了吗？

examples.zh: 因为成功组织了领导职位竞选活动，他得到了这份工作。

examples.en: Make the extra effort to impress the buyer and you will be rewarded with a quicker sale.
examples.zh: 多用心去打动顾客, 货物就会更快售出。

examples.zh: 南方人比较喜欢吃米饭, 北方人爱吃面食。

examples.en: A lot of people think that happiness is about being rich, but I disagree.
examples.zh: 很多人认为幸福就是富有, 但我不同意。

examples.en: It's not easy to rid oneself of a habit.
examples.zh: 要改掉一个人的习惯是不容易的。

examples.zh: 现在我的父亲每天骑自行车去上班而不是开车去。

examples.zh: 只要是正当的事, 我都尽力去做。

examples.zh: 太晚了, 我们最好现在打车回家。

examples.en: It's on your right.
examples.zh: 它在你右边。

examples.zh: 我们快点。电铃响了。

examples.zh: 她的笑声在房间里回荡。

examples.zh: 雨后河水涨了起来。

examples.zh: 这些工厂正在尽力不再污染河流。

examples.en: We should drive carefully on the road.
examples.zh: 在道路上我们应该小心驾驶。

proverbs: Confidence in yourself is the first step on the road to success. 自信是走向成功的第一步。

examples.en: You've made a fire fit to roast an ox.
examples.zh: 你生的火很旺，足以烤一头牛了。

examples.zh: 她工作起来如同一个机器人。

examples.zh: 兔子跑得快。

examples.en: He runs a company.
examples.zh: 他经营一家公司。

examples.en: After a six-mile run, Jackie returns home for a substantial breakfast.
examples.zh: 跑了 6 英里之后，杰姬回家吃一顿丰盛的早餐。

phrases: run out of 用完，耗尽

examples.en: The students rushed into the classroom as soon as the bell rang.
examples.zh: 铃声一响，学生就奔跑进教室。

examples.en: He left the house in a rush.
examples.zh: 他匆匆忙忙离开了家。

phrases: rush down 冲下来，冲过去

examples.en: We are very sad and angry to hear that our football team suffered a defeat again.
examples.zh: 听到我们的足球队又输球了，我们非常难过，非常生气。

derivations.zh: 悲哀地; 忧愁地; 令人遗憾地; 不幸地

senses.zh: 悲哀地; 忧愁地; 令人遗憾地; 不幸地

examples.en: Sadly, after eight years of marriage they had grown apart.
examples.zh: 不幸的是, 结婚 8 年后, 他们的感情日渐淡漠了。

examples.en: Friends are the people you feel safe because you know they care about you.
examples.zh: 朋友就是那些能让你有安全感的人, 因为你知道他们关心你。

examples.en: Only her husband knows the number to open the safe.
examples.zh: 只有她丈夫知道打开保险柜的密码。

derivations.zh: 救, 挽救; 节省; 节约

examples.en: The plane landed safely at last after flying in the storm for about one hour.
examples.zh: 这架飞机在风暴中大约飞行了一个小时以后, 最终安全着陆。

examples.en: All pilots are responsible for their passengers' safety.
examples.zh: 所有飞行员都应对乘客的安全负责。

examples.en: He had a steak and a green salad.
examples.zh: 他要了一块牛排和一份生菜色拉。

examples.en: He was engaged at a salary of $1,000 a month.
examples.zh: 他以月薪 1000 美元受聘。

senses.zh: 卖, 出售; 特价销售

examples.en: Our school organized a charity sale for the homeless in that area.
examples.zh: 我们学校在该地区为无家可归者组织了一场慈善义卖。

examples.en: Salt occurs naturally in sea water.
examples.zh: 盐天然存在于海水中。

examples.en: The dish is too salty.
examples.zh: 这道菜太咸了。

examples.en: James, Catherine and I have been friends since we were at the same primary school.
examples.zh: 自从我和詹姆斯还有凯瑟琳在同一所小学读书起，我们就一直是朋友。

examples.en: Girls were given the same chance as boys to apply for the job by the manager.
examples.zh: 经理给了女孩和男孩一样的机会去申请那份工作。

examples.en: — Good luck and have a nice holiday. — The same to you.
examples.zh: ——祝你好运，假期愉快！——你也一样。

phrases: at the same time 同时

examples.en: To make a ham sandwich, you put a slice of ham between two slices of bread.
examples.zh: 把一片火腿夹在两片面包之间就做成了火腿三明治。

examples.en: When she had finished her meal, she gave a satisfied smile.
examples.zh: 吃完饭后，她露出了满意的笑容。

derivations.zh: 令人满意的；令人满足的

phrases: be satisfied with 对……感到满意

senses.zh: 令人满意的；令人满足的

examples.en: It's very satisfying to see so many of you here.
examples.zh: 在这里见到大家，我感到非常满意。

examples.en: He went abroad last Saturday.
examples.zh: 他上星期六出国了。

examples.en: The sauce tastes too sweet.
examples.zh: 这酱汁味道太甜。

phrases: soy sauce (= soya sauce) 酱油

examples.en: Although the doctors did everything they could to save the sick boy, they failed at last.
examples.zh: 虽然医生们尽力挽救这个生病的孩子，但最终还是失败了。

phrases: save one's life 挽救某人的生命
proverbs: A stitch in time saves nine. 小洞不补，大洞吃苦。
_flags: OCR 音标误作 /sɜːv/，按词头 save 改为 /seɪv/

examples.en: “There's still a long way to go before you succeed,” the teacher said to the class.
examples.zh: 老师对全班学生说：“在你们成功之前还有很长的路要走。”

examples.en: Last but not least, at the end of the interview, don't forget to thank the interviewer and say goodbye.
examples.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，在面试结束时，别忘了感谢面试官并说再见。

examples.en: “There's no smoke without fire”, as the saying goes.
examples.zh: 常言道：“无风不起浪。”

senses.zh: 时间表；节目表；工作计划；日程安排

examples.en: Because of her busy schedule, it is impossible for her to spend much time travelling.
examples.zh: 由于她的日程安排很紧，她不可能花很多时间旅行。

examples.en: A presidential election was scheduled for last December.
examples.zh: 总统大选原定去年12月举行。

examples.en: — John was seriously injured in the school bus accident. — I'm sorry to hear that.
examples.zh: ——约翰在校车事故中受了重伤。——听到这个消息我很难过。

examples.en: Though he is only eight years old, he knows more about science than his father.
examples.zh: 虽然只有8岁，但他比他父亲更了解科学。

examples.en: Mr. Ren, a Chinese scientist, began to study global climate change more than a decade ago.
examples.zh: 中国科学家任先生在10多年前就开始研究全球气候变化。

examples.en: Nick didn't do very well in the final exam, but his scores are better than last year's.
examples.zh: 虽然尼克期末考试考得不是很好，但他的分数比去年要好。

examples.en: He scored the winning goal in the fourth round of the football matches.
examples.zh: 他在足球比赛的第4轮中打进了制胜一球。

_flags: 教材标注 OCR 作 G6.EU4，学期标记无法辨认，按原样保留

examples.en: You can see him on the TV screen quite often.
examples.zh: 你可以经常在电视屏幕上见到他。

_flags: 教材标注 OCR 作 G7.EU5，学期标记无法辨认，按原样保留

examples.en: We generally go to the sea for our holidays.
examples.zh: 我们通常去海边度假。

examples.en: There's an excellent seafood restaurant near here.
examples.zh: 离这儿不远有一家非常不错的海鲜餐馆。

examples.en: We searched here and there, but could not find her.
examples.zh: 我们到处找她，但还是找不到。

examples.en: — Why do millions of online users visit the home page of the government? — To read the news and search for the information they need.
examples.zh: ——为什么有数百万的在线用户访问政府的主页？——为了看新闻和搜索他们需要的信息。

examples.en: The lost book came to light after a long search.
examples.zh: 经过长时间的寻找，那本遗失的书得以重见天日。

examples.en: Let's go to the seaside at the weekend!
examples.zh: 周末我们去海滨吧！

examples.en: The seasons change, independent of anyone's wishes.
examples.zh: 四季变化不受任何人约束。

examples.en: The teacher made me move my seat to the front of the classroom.
examples.zh: 老师把我的座位换到了教室的前面。

examples.en: Our team gets a second.
examples.zh: 我们队得了第二名。

examples.en: The average flow of the river is 200 cubic metres per second.
examples.zh: 这条河平均流量为每秒 200 立方米。

examples.en: I finished in the second place in the 800-metre race, just behind Jack.
examples.zh: 我在 800 米赛跑中获得第 2 名，仅次于杰克。

examples.en: And second, we shouldn't substitute our personal feeling for policies.
examples.zh: 其次，我们不应该拿个人感情代替政策。

examples.en: In secondary school, children get more advanced knowledge.
examples.zh: 在中学，孩子获得更深一些的知识。

examples.en: She made no secret of her greed.
examples.zh: 她毫不掩饰自己的贪婪。

examples.en: He asked that the matter should be kept secret.
examples.zh: 他要求对这件事保密。

examples.en: She is secretary to the master.
examples.zh: 她是校长的秘书。

examples.en: The chapter falls into three sections.
examples.zh: 这一章共分 3 节。

examples.en: The events were faithfully recorded in a section of the local museum's files.
examples.zh: 这些事件被如实记录在当地博物馆的一份档案卷宗里。

senses.zh: 看见，看到；领会，理解；拜访，会见；理会

examples.en: The light is on. I see them watching a slide show.
examples.zh: 灯亮着。我看见他们正在看幻灯。

proverbs: Seeing is believing. 眼见为实。

examples.en: The farmers are scattering seed.
examples.zh: 农夫们在播种。

examples.en: The baby seems to be asleep.
examples.zh: 那婴儿好像是睡着了。

examples.en: I don't like western food. I seldom eat it unless I go to MacDonald with my daughter.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢吃西餐。我很少吃，除非与我的女儿去麦当劳。

examples.en: Kitty seldom read detective stories before going to school, did she?
examples.zh: 上学前姬蒂很少读侦探故事，是吗？

examples.en: Which place in the world would you select as your perfect home?
examples.zh: 你会选择世界上哪个地方作为你最理想的安家之地呢？

examples.en: The book written by that writer didn't sell well last year.
examples.zh: 那位作家写的这本书，去年销售情况不好。

examples.en: China first sent scientists to Antarctica in 1980.
examples.zh: 中国在1980年首次派出科学家到南极。

senses.zh: 年长的；高年级的；高级的

examples.en: Honours were automatically awarded to senior officials just because they were senior.
examples.zh: 荣誉顺理成章地授予资深官员，就因为他们资格老。

examples.en: I haven't got a very good sense of direction, so I easily get lost.
examples.zh: 我的方向感很差，因此我容易迷路。

examples.en: The dog sensed danger and started barking loudly.
examples.zh: 狗意识到危险，开始狂叫。

examples.en: Please make a whole sentence when you answer the question.
examples.zh: 回答问题时请说完整的句子。

examples.en: Our school will begin on September 1.
examples.zh: 我们学校将在9月1日开学。

examples.en: If you have a serious disease, such as heart disease, you'd better not travel there.
examples.zh: 如果你有严重的疾病，如心脏疾病，你最好不要去那里。

examples.en: The 70-year-old man was seriously ill and died a few months later.
examples.zh: 那个70岁的男子患了重病，几个月后就去世了。

examples.en: Our teacher asked us to take the exam seriously and avoid careless mistakes.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们认真对待考试，避免出现粗心错误。

examples.en: The waiter did his best to serve the customers politely and promptly.
examples.zh: 那位服务员尽量礼貌及时地招待顾客。

examples.en: Peter has served the company for 25 years, first as office boy and finally as sales manager.
examples.zh: 彼得在这家公司服务了 25 年，开始是办公室工作人员，最后成为销售经理。

examples.en: The customers are pleased with the service of the restaurant.
examples.zh: 顾客对这家餐厅的服务很满意。

senses.zh: 释放；安置，摆放；树立(榜样)；创造(纪录)
摄影场；一套；电视机；收音机

examples.en: He set an example of wholehearted service to the people.
examples.zh: 他树立了全心全意为人民服务的榜样。

examples.en: The director was impressed with the details of the set.
examples.zh: 导演对场景的细节印象深刻。

examples.en: The meeting will take place in the set conference room.
examples.zh: 会议将在指定的会议室举行。

phrases: set off 出发；动身；启程
set out 动身，出发；着手做
set up 建立；建造；创立

examples.en: Both sides are looking for ways to settle their differences.
examples.zh: 双方都在寻求消除分歧的方法。

examples.en: Dr. Hu has collected several proofs to show the conclusion is correct.
examples.zh: 胡博士收集了若干证据，以证明这个结论是正确的。

examples.en: Shaking hands is a traditional way to greet each other in many places.
examples.zh: 在许多地方握手是一种传统的问候方式。

senses.zh: (同 I 和 we 连用，表示将来)将要；会；(用来征求意见)……好吗？

examples.en: Shall I get the key to the bike?
examples.zh: 我去拿自行车钥匙好吗？

senses.zh: 令人遗憾的事；令人惋惜的事；羞愧

examples.en: What a shame you couldn't attend the graduation ceremony!
examples.zh: 你不能参加毕业典礼，太可惜了！

examples.en: She felt a deep sense of shame.
examples.zh: 她深感羞愧。

examples.en: I keep practising yoga after work because it helps me keep in good shape.
examples.zh: 我下班后坚持练习瑜伽，因为它有助于我保持良好的身材。

examples.en: The artist shaped the metal into a delicate piece of jewellery.
examples.zh: 艺术家将金属塑造成一件精致的珠宝。

examples.en: Ideas are always shared by my students in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂上，学生总是分享各自的想法。

examples.en: The old man used to raise many sheep to make a living in the west of China.
examples.zh: 老人过去常常靠养羊在中国的西部谋生。

examples.en: You may choose any of the toys on the shelf. But only one for each.
examples.zh: 你们可以选择架子上的任何玩具。但每人只能拿一个。

examples.en: — The sun shines brightly. Why not go out for a walk in the Zhongshan Park? — Good idea.
examples.zh: ——阳光这么好。到中山公园去散散步怎样？——好主意。

examples.en: Are you going to America by plane or by ship the day after tomorrow?
examples.zh: 后天你去美国是乘飞机还是坐船？

examples.en: Do you know the man wearing a white shirt?
examples.zh: 你认识那个穿白衬衫的人吗？

examples.en: You don't mind if I take my shoes off, do you?
examples.zh: 你不介意我把鞋子脱了，是吧？

examples.en: It's not available in the shops.
examples.zh: 商店里都没货。

examples.en: He always shopped at that shop.
examples.zh: 他总在那家商店购物。

examples.en: How could you do it in such a short period of time?
examples.zh: 你是怎么在如此短的时间里做到的？

examples.en: Sometimes I am not as brave as I should be.
examples.zh: 有时我表现得不够勇敢。

examples.en: We should not ask others to do what we can’t do ourselves.
examples.zh: 我们不应该要求别人做一些我们自己也做不到的事情。

examples.en: Don’t shout at me!
examples.zh: 不要对我大声叫喊！

examples.en: The decision was greeted with shouts of protest from the crowd.
examples.zh: 这项决定遭到了大众的大声抗议。

senses.zh: 给……看，出示；显示；告知；表明

examples.en: My parents showed me some old pictures that brought back sweet memories.
examples.zh: 我的父母给我看了一些能唤起我甜蜜记忆的老照片。

examples.en: Charlie can’t go with us because he is showing a professor around our company.
examples.zh: 查理不能和我们一起走，因为他正陪同一位教授参观我们公司。

examples.en: She didn’t go to see the dolphin show with us because she had seen it already.
examples.zh: 她不和我们一起去看看海豚表演，因为她已经看过了。

phrases: show sb. around 带某人参观

examples.en: She took two showers a day.
examples.zh: 她每天洗两次澡。

examples.en: Lucy shut her eyes.
examples.zh: 露西闭上了眼睛。

examples.en: The store was shut when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到的时候商店关门了。

examples.en: At first he was a little shy in class, but now he acts more naturally.
examples.zh: 起初他在班里有点害羞，不过现在表现自然多了。

senses.zh: 有病的，患病的；（想）呕吐的，恶心的

examples.en: On the twelfth day, the sick boy came to life.
examples.zh: 在第 12 天，患病的男孩活过来了。

examples.en: The students have put some flowers on either side of the corridor and hung some nice pictures on the wall.
examples.zh: 学生们在走廊的两边摆了一些花，在墙上挂了一些漂亮的图片。

examples.en: With a two-screen phone, you can watch movies on one side and check emails on the other.
examples.zh: 有了双屏手机，你可以在一边看电影，另一边查看电子邮件。

phrases: both sides of the road 路的两边
either side of the road 路的两边
all sides of the square 广场的四周
every/each side of the square 广场的每一边
on one's side 在某人一边

examples.en: My sight is failing.
examples.zh: 我的视力在下降。

examples.en: Did you do any sightseeing there?
examples.zh: 在那儿你游览观光了没？

examples.en: Many people choose to have a baby in the year of the dragon because dragon is a sign of power and status.
examples.zh: 很多人选择在龙年生孩子，因为龙是权力和地位的象征。

examples.en: He persuaded her to sign the document.
examples.zh: 他说服她在文件上签字。

examples.en: A red lamp is often a danger signal.
examples.zh: 红灯常常是危险的信号。

examples.en: The alarm system signaled an intruder in the building.
examples.zh: 警报系统示意大楼里有入侵者。

senses.zh: 静的；无声的；不说话的；沉默的

examples.en: He generally keeps silent at a meeting.
examples.zh: 他通常在会上保持沉默。

examples.en: The dress was made of ivory silk.
examples.zh: 这件连衣裙是用象牙色丝绸做成的。

senses.zh: 傻的，愚蠢的；不明事理的

examples.en: That's a silly question.
examples.zh: 那是个愚蠢的问题。

examples.en: The accident was similar to one that happened in 1931.
examples.zh: 这次事故和 1931 年发生的那起很像。

examples.en: The operation of this machine is simple.
examples.zh: 这台机器的操作很简单。

examples.en: Because of the bad service, the restaurant has received a lot of complaints since last December.
examples.zh: 因为糟糕的服务，自去年 12 月以来这家餐厅已收到许多投诉。

examples.en: Since Jennifer is the tallest girl in the class, you can find her easily in the classroom.
examples.zh: 由于珍妮弗是班里最高的女孩，在课堂上很容易找到她。

examples.en: Since you have made up your mind to lose weight, you'd better eat less in the evening.
examples.zh: 既然你已经下定决心要减肥，你最好晚上少吃点。

examples.en: How beautifully you sing!
examples.zh: 你唱得多美呀！

examples.en: My mother is a singer in a famous band.
examples.zh: 我妈妈是一个著名乐队的歌手。

examples.en: Never just memorise single English words. Learn by heart the whole sentences and the phrases so we may know how to use the words.
examples.zh: 不要只背单个英语单词，要记住整个句子和词组，这样我们就可以知道如何使用这些单词。

examples.en: Dear Sir, I am very glad and honoured to write to you.
examples.zh: 亲爱的先生，我能给你写信真是感到十分荣幸。

examples.en: She's as clever as her sister is.
examples.zh: 她和她的妹妹一样聪明。

examples.en: The grown-ups will sit at one table and the children at another.
examples.zh: 大人坐一桌，孩子坐另一桌。

examples.en: A troublesome situation has grown up.
examples.zh: 出现了使人感到棘手的局面。

examples.en: I'd like to change this dress for one in a larger size.
examples.zh: 我想把这件衣服换成大号的。

notes:
名师点拨：size 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：nearly the size of 与 nearly as small/big as (大小近似) 意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：The robot on the desk is nearly the size of a match box.
= The robot on the desk is nearly as small as a match box.
桌上那个机器人只有火柴盒那么大。

examples.en: I like winter, because I like to skate.
examples.zh: 我喜欢冬天，因为我喜欢滑冰。

examples.en: Finding the main idea in a paragraph is just one of these reading skills.
examples.zh: 在段落里找中心思想只是阅读技能之一。

examples.en: Is it true that drinking much water prevents the skin from drying out?
examples.zh: 多喝水能防止皮肤干燥，这是真的吗？

examples.en: It's a nice skirt.
examples.zh: 这条裙子很漂亮。

examples.en: A bright moving object appeared in the sky at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落时分，天空中出现了一个移动的发光物体。

examples.en: The boy was too excited to sleep well last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚那个男孩太兴奋了，根本睡不好。
examples.rewrite: The boy was so excited that he couldn't sleep well last night.

examples.en: Nature seems to be wakened from a dead sleep.
examples.zh: 大自然似乎从沉睡中被唤醒了。

examples.en: It is impossible for him to finish the job in two hours. He is so slow.
examples.zh: 他的动作是如此缓慢，不可能在2个小时内完成这项工作。

examples.en: The cars moved slowly because of the heavy snow.
examples.zh: 因为大雪，车辆缓慢地移动。
examples.rewrite: The cars moved slowly because it snowed heavily.

examples.en: My parents often tell me we should care for small creatures.
examples.zh: 我的父母经常告诉我，我们应该关心小动物。

senses.zh: 灵巧的；聪明的；智能的；机敏的

examples.en: He thinks he's smarter than Sarah.
examples.zh: 他认为他比萨拉聪明。

examples.en: Coffee is ready. How nice it smells! Would you like some?
examples.zh: 咖啡好了。闻起来真香啊！您来点儿吗？

examples.en: It has a nice smell.
examples.zh: 它的气味真好闻。

derivations.zh: 有难闻气味的；有臭味的

notes:
名师点拨：smell 是常考连系动词，同时学生一定要牢记在初中阶段所学过的连系动词，及掌握其后面要接形容词。
例如：smell good, taste delicious, sound beautiful, feel soft, seem strange, look angry (look angrily at sth.), fall ill, become useful, grow dark, get angry, turn red, go wrong, come true, keep warm, stay awake

examples.en: When he saw me, he smiled and waved.
examples.zh: 他一看见我，就微笑着朝我挥挥手。

examples.en: “There are some sandwiches if you're hungry,” she said with a smile.
examples.zh: 她笑着说道：“你要是饿的话，这有一些三明治。”

proverbs: Wear a smile often, and you will feel young always. 笑口常开，青春常在。

examples.en: The house is full of smoke.
examples.zh: 满屋子都是烟。

examples.en: Since you are badly ill, you'd better give up smoking.
examples.zh: 由于你病得厉害，你最好戒烟。

examples.en: I only have a snack at lunch time.
examples.zh: 午饭我只吃了点小吃。

examples.en: The mountains were crowned with snow.
examples.zh: 山上积满了雪。

examples.en: In winter the more heavily it snows, the happier the children will feel.
examples.zh: 在冬天雪下得越大，孩子们就会越快乐。

examples.en: I liked to walk in fields on snowy days and to see my footprints left behind.
examples.zh: 我喜欢在下雪天走在田野里，看看我留下的脚印。

examples.en: Some kinds of computers are so tiny that people may be unaware of them.
examples.zh: 有些种类的电脑是如此小，以至于人们可能都没有注意到。

examples.en: It was amazing for us to see so many beautiful places on the way.
examples.zh: 让我们惊叹的是一路上看到这么多美丽的地方。

examples.en: Martin and his friends didn't eat up all the food they ordered, so they took the rest away.
examples.zh: 马丁和他的朋友没有吃完他们所点的食物，所以他们把剩下的打包了。

phrases: so that (表示目的) 为了，以便

senses.zh: 社会上的；社会地位的；社交的；好社交的

examples.en: Team sports help to develop a child's social skills.
examples.zh: 集体体育运动有助于培养孩子的社交能力。

phrases: social study 社会研究；社会学习

examples.en: Do you think we ought to learn to be useful to the society?
examples.zh: 你是否认为我们应该学着成为对社会有用的人？

examples.en: I like this silk dress, and it feels so soft and comfortable.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这件丝绸连衣裙，它摸上去是这么的柔软舒适。

examples.en: “My father,” said Lucie, softly laying her hand on his.
examples.zh: “爸爸，”露西叫了一声，温柔地把手放在他的手上。

examples.en: A soldier must obey his superior officers.
examples.zh: 士兵必须服从上级军官。

examples.en: Finally, they found a solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 最后，他们找到了解决问题的办法。

examples.en: It is very difficult to solve the problem of air pollution.
examples.zh: 解决空气污染问题是非常困难的。

examples.en: Here is some information on the best cities for your studying abroad.
examples.zh: 这儿有最适合您出国留学的城市的一些信息。

examples.en: Would you like some apple juice?
examples.zh: 你要来点苹果汁吗？

examples.en: He asked for money and I gave him some.
examples.zh: 他向我要钱，我给了他一些。

examples.en: You needn't tell me about this. Someone sent me a message about it three days ago.
examples.zh: 你不必告诉我了。3 天前有人发消息给我说过这件事了。

examples.en: I can't connect my computer to the internet. There must be something wrong with it.
examples.zh: 我的电脑连不上网。一定是哪里出问题了。

notes:
名师点拨：something 是常考单词，所以学生一定要知道当形容词修饰 something, anything, nothing 等不定代词时要后置。
例如：You needn't attend the meeting this afternoon if you have something important to do. 如果你有重要的事情要做，你就不必出席今天下午的会议了。

examples.en: We have to admit sometimes the most expensive one is not always the best one.
examples.zh: 我们不得不承认，有时候最贵的并不总是最好的。

examples.en: Her son looked sad when he learned that he hadn't passed the final exam.
examples.zh: 当得知自己没通过期末考试，她的儿子看起来很悲伤。

examples.en: We have learned three English songs since last week.
examples.zh: 自从上个星期以来，我们已经学了 3 首英文歌曲。

examples.en: We'll have a three-day holiday soon. What about going to Chongming Island?
examples.zh: 不久我们将有 3 天假期。去崇明岛怎么样？

examples.en: We must finish cleaning the office as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 我们必须尽快打扫完办公室。

senses.zh: 对不起的；抱歉的；难过的

examples.en: I'm sorry for giving so much trouble.
examples.zh: 对不起，给你添了这么多麻烦。

examples.en: — Sorry for keeping you waiting for me so long. — That's OK.
examples.zh: ——对不起，让您久等了。——没关系。

examples.en: At the foot of the hill, you can hear nothing but the sound of the running water.
examples.zh: 在山脚下，除了流水声，你什么都听不到。

examples.en: What you said sounds reasonable. But it still needs to be discussed.
examples.zh: 你说的话听起来很合理。但它仍然需要加以讨论。

examples.en: The restaurant serves various soups.
examples.zh: 这家饭店供应各种各样的汤。

examples.en: I'm lost, which direction is south?
examples.zh: 我迷路了，哪个方向是南？

examples.en: We lived in a village on the south coast.
examples.zh: 我们住在南部海岸的一个小村庄里。

examples.en: The birds flew south for the winter.
examples.zh: 鸟类飞去南方过冬。

examples.en: Linda and her friends had a discussion about space planes.
examples.zh: 琳达和她的朋友们进行了有关太空飞机的讨论。

examples.en: He spaced the plants two feet apart to give them room to grow.
examples.zh: 他把植物间隔两英尺栽种，给它们生长空间。

examples.en: The spaceship went back to the earth successfully.
examples.zh: 宇宙飞船成功地重返地球。

examples.en: He doesn't often read books in the library in his spare time.
examples.zh: 在业余时间他不经常在图书馆看书。

examples.en: Can you tell me who will speak at the class meeting next Monday?
examples.zh: 你能否告诉我下星期一谁将在班会上发言？

examples.en: Tom speaks French most fluently in his class.
examples.zh: 汤姆在他班里是法语讲得最流利的。
examples.rewrite: Nobody else in Tom's class can speak French as fluently as he.

examples.en: His accent is quite special.
examples.zh: 他的口音非常特别。

examples.en: Damon received a special gift on his fifth birthday.
examples.zh: 达蒙在他5岁生日那天收到了一份特别的礼物。

examples.en: The scientist gave a lot of speeches on environmental protection.
examples.zh: 这位科学家做了很多关于环境保护的演讲。

examples.en: Our speed averaged out at 50 km an hour.
examples.zh: 我们的平均速度是每小时 50 公里。

examples.en: He sped his car through the street.
examples.zh: 他开车加速穿过街道。

examples.en: He doesn't spend much time on his homework.
examples.zh: 他花在作业上的时间不多。

notes:
名师点拨：spend 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握其固定搭配，及比较与 cost, pay, take 的用法区别：
1) sb. spend st. (in) doing sth./on sth. = it takes sb. st. to do sth.
例如：David spent two hours finishing/on his report last night.
= It took David two hours to finish his report last night.
昨晚戴维花了 2 个小时完成他的报告。
2) sb. spend money (in) doing sth./on sth. = sb. pay money for sth. = it costs sb. money to do sth.
例如：My uncle spent huge amounts of money decorating the living room.
= It cost my uncle huge amounts of money to decorate the living room.
我叔叔花了一大笔钱来装饰客厅。
I spent $120 on my new dress.
= I paid $120 for my new dress.
我花了 120 美元买新连衣裙。

examples.en: She feeds the baby with a spoon.
examples.zh: 她用汤匙给婴儿喂食。

examples.en: More than two hundred students took part in the school sports meeting yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨日，200 多名学生参加了学校运动会。

phrases: have sports 进行体育活动

senses.zh: 延伸；展开；传播；扩散；散布

examples.en: The bird spread its wings.
examples.zh: 鸟儿展开翅膀。

examples.en: I could smell the spring in the air.
examples.zh: 我在空气中闻到了春天的气息。

examples.en: The cat sprang onto the table to catch the toy mouse.
examples.zh: 猫咪跳上桌子去抓玩具老鼠。

examples.en: What a wonderful concert they are putting on in the city square!
examples.zh: 他们正在城市广场上演出一场多么美妙的音乐会啊！

examples.en: A board four feet square contains 16 square feet.
examples.zh: 4 英尺见方的木板面积为 16 平方英尺。

examples.en: She is on friendly terms with most of the school staff.
examples.zh: 她和学校大多数员工友好相处。

examples.en: He doesn’t need much money for his collection of stamps.
examples.zh: 他集邮不需要很多的钱。

examples.en: We stood because there were no seats.
examples.zh: 没有座位，我们只好站着。

examples.en: The sun is a star.
examples.zh: 太阳是一颗恒星。

examples.en: The shy boy wondered, “How should I start my speech?”
examples.zh: 那个害羞的男孩想知道如何开始他的演讲。
examples.rewrite: The shy boy wondered how to start his speech.

examples.en: The runners lined up at the start.
examples.zh: 赛跑选手在起跑线排成一行。

phrases: start off 出发；开始；从……开始
proverbs: A year’s plan starts with spring. 一年之计在于春。

senses.zh: 状态；情形；国家；(美国的) 州

examples.en: His apartment was in a terrible state of disorder.
examples.zh: 他的公寓凌乱不堪。

examples.en: We must pay taxes to the State.
examples.zh: 我们必须向国家纳税。

examples.en: How far is the train station from your home?
examples.zh: 你家离火车站有多远？

senses.zh: 停留，逗留，待；保持，继续是

examples.en: An experienced Indian guide is provided during your stay.
examples.zh: 在你逗留期间给你配备了一位经验丰富的印第安向导。

examples.en: Did Mary tell you how long she would stay with us?
examples.zh: 玛丽有没有告诉你她要和我们住在一起多久？

examples.en: Old people had better exercise every day to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 老年人最好每天锻炼以保持身体健康。

examples.en: I ate four steaks yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我吃了4块牛排。

examples.en: The suspect admitted stealing the valuable vase after the detective showed him the proof.
examples.zh: 当侦探给这个犯罪嫌疑人看了证据后，他承认偷了贵重的花瓶。

examples.en: Steam can be seen rising from the wet clothes near the fire.
examples.zh: 我们可以看见水蒸气从靠近火的湿衣服中升起。

examples.en: He decided to steam the vegetables for a healthier meal.
examples.zh: 为了吃得更健康，他决定把蔬菜蒸一下。

examples.en: We are too tired and hungry, so our steps are getting slower and slower.
examples.zh: 我们又饿又累，所以我们的脚步越来越慢。

examples.en: He steps the pavements.
examples.zh: 他在人行道上行走。

examples.en: What's wrong with this stamp? It won't stick.
examples.zh: 这邮票怎么回事？粘不住了。

examples.en: He picked up sticks to make a fire.
examples.zh: 他拾些小树枝来生火。

examples.en: My grandpa is in his seventies but still very strong and healthy.
examples.zh: 我的爷爷七十多岁了，但依然身强体健。

examples.en: Keep still while I fasten your shoe.
examples.zh: 站着别动，我给你系鞋带。

examples.en: On Christmas Eve I hung up my stocking along with my sisters’.
examples.zh: 圣诞夜，我把我的长筒袜跟姐妹们的挂在了一起。

examples.en: Henry got a stomachache and asked to be excused.
examples.zh: 亨利肚子疼，请求离开一下。

examples.en: Ancient men made tools of stone.
examples.zh: 古人制作了石头工具。

proverbs: A rolling stone gathers no moss. 滚石不生苔，转业不聚财。

examples.en: Stop complaining about the traffic. Just think about what we can do to improve it.
examples.zh: 别抱怨交通。好好想想，我们能为此做些什么来改善。

examples.en: It’s six in the evening. Why not stop to have supper?
examples.zh: 晚上 6 点了，为什么还不停下来吃晚饭？

examples.en: There’s a bus stop near the school.
examples.zh: 学校附近有个公共汽车站。

notes:
名师点拨：stop 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握 stop to do 与 stop doing 的用法区别：
1) stop to do sth. 停下手中的动作，去做另外一件事。
例如：He stopped to talk with me. 他停下来跟我谈话。
2) stop doing sth. 停下手中正在做的事情。
例如：I want to ask my father to stop smoking. 我想叫我的父亲戒烟。
3) stop … (from) doing sth. 阻止做某事。
例如：No one can stop me from learning English. 没有人能阻止我学习英语。

examples.en: She opened a hat store in Paris.
examples.zh: 她在巴黎开了一家帽子店。

examples.en: Tinned milk can be stored for a long time.
examples.zh: 罐装牛奶可储藏很长时间。

examples.en: One day we met with a big storm.
examples.zh: 有天我们遇上了一场暴风雨。

examples.en: Mr. Black told us several funny stories at the party last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚在聚会上布莱克先生给我们讲了一些有趣的故事。

senses.zh: 一直地；直；直接地；坦率地

examples.en: Keep the boat in a straight line.
examples.zh: 让船保持直线航行。

examples.en: Jack didn't notice the motorcycle and walked straight across.
examples.zh: 杰克没注意到摩托车，径直走了过去。

examples.en: She was a strange sort of person; I couldn't make her out.
examples.zh: 她这个人有些古怪，我搞不懂她。

examples.en: Strawberry is in season this month.
examples.zh: 这个月草莓正当令。

examples.en: I hate the dogs that create a lot of mess in the streets.
examples.zh: 我讨厌狗把街道搞得乱七八糟。

examples.en: Stress may act as a trigger for these illnesses.
examples.zh: 压力可能会成为引发这些疾病的原因。

examples.en: They also stress the need for improved employment opportunities, better transport and health care.
examples.zh: 他们同时强调需要增加就业机会，改善交通和医疗保健服务。

examples.en: As a student, you have to be strict with yourself.
examples.zh: 作为一名学生，你必须严格要求自己。

senses.zh: 敲；打击；侵袭；(钟) 鸣；罢工

examples.en: The boxer struck his opponent with a powerful blow.
examples.zh: 拳手一记重拳打在了对手身上。

examples.en: The employees went on a strike to show their dissatisfaction with the company's policies.
examples.zh: 雇员们举行了罢工以表示对公司政策的不满。

senses.zh: 强(壮)的；坚固的；强烈的；坚强的

examples.en: Mr. Baker is still very strong in his nineties, and he often goes out for a walk.
examples.zh: 贝克先生 90 多岁了依然很硬朗，还经常出去散步。

inflections: stick 的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: I was stuck at home with flu.
examples.zh: 感冒把我困在了家中。

examples.en: Students can learn more effectively by discovering the answers for themselves.
examples.zh: 学生通过自主探寻答案，能更高效地学习。

examples.en: The students had an enjoyable time when they went for an outing.
examples.zh: 当学生们去郊游时，他们度过了一段愉快的时光。

examples.en: We can study in the classroom.
examples.zh: 我们可以在教室里学习。

examples.en: Biology is the study of how living things work.
examples.zh: 生物学是研究生物功能的学科。

examples.en: They were stupid not to follow your advice.
examples.zh: 他们不听你的劝告真傻。

examples.en: Each piece of furniture in their home suited the style of the house.
examples.zh: 他家里的每件家具都与房子的风格相配。

senses.zh: 题目；主题；学科；主语；主体

examples.en: The students took the PISA test in three subjects: reading, maths and science.
examples.zh: 学生参加了 PISA 3 个科目的测试：阅读、数学和科学。

examples.en: You won't succeed unless you put in the effort and stay focused.
examples.zh: 除非你付出努力并保持专注，否则就不会成功。

examples.en: I think my friends will succeed in winning the basketball match.
examples.zh: 我认为我的朋友会在篮球赛中获胜。

derivations.zh: 达到目的的；有成效的；获得成功的

phrases: succeed in doing sth. = manage to do sth. 成功地做成某事

examples.en: The young actor's debut was a great success.
examples.zh: 那位年轻演员的处女秀取得了巨大成功。

examples.en: His attempt to become a civil servant came very close to success.
examples.zh: 他差一点儿就当上公务员了。

proverbs: Failure is the mother of success. 失败乃成功之母。

senses.zh: 达到目的的；有成效的；获得成功的

examples.en: I don't know how I can be a successful English learner.
examples.zh: 我不知道怎样才能成为一名成功的英语学习者。
examples.rewrite: I don't know how to be a successful English learner.

examples.en: Miss Li's new teaching method was successful in attracting students' attention.
examples.zh: 李老师的新教学方法成功吸引了学生们的注意力。

examples.en: He was proud of having such a good friend.
examples.zh: 他为有这样的好朋友而自豪。

examples.en: Such are the most powerful voices of our times!
examples.zh: 这些就是我们时代最有力的声音！

examples.en: Suddenly, all the lights went out and people had to wait in the darkness.
examples.zh: 突然，所有的灯都熄灭了，人们不得不在黑暗中等待。

examples.en: I often suffer from unaccountable headaches.
examples.zh: 我常莫名其妙地头疼。

examples.en: Students observed the solution of sugar in tea.
examples.zh: 学生们观察了糖在茶中溶解的情况。

examples.en: I suggested teaching the foreign students how to use chopsticks.
examples.zh: 我建议教外国学生如何使用筷子。

examples.en: It's raining heavily. I'd suggest you call a taxi home now.
examples.zh: 雨下得很大。我建议你此刻还是叫一辆出租车回家吧。

phrases: suggest sb. do sth. 建议某人做某事

examples.en: Shall I give you a written suggestion?
examples.zh: 需要我给您一份书面建议吗？

examples.en: David didn't know where he was going to spend his holiday this summer.
examples.zh: 今年夏天戴维不知道要去哪里度假。

examples.en: I want to sit in the sun.
examples.zh: 我想在太阳下面坐一坐。

examples.en: There were many visitors in the Science Museum last Sunday.
examples.zh: 上星期日科学博物馆有许多游客。

examples.en: Because of the warm and sunny weather, oranges grow very well here.
examples.zh: 因为气候温暖、阳光充足，这儿的橘子长得很好。

examples.en: We had a super time at the party last night.
examples.zh: 我们在昨晚的派对上玩得超级开心。

examples.en: How far is it from the school to the nearest supermarket?
examples.zh: 从学校到最近的超市有多远？

examples.en: Neither Betty nor Peter has potatoes for supper.
examples.zh: 无论是贝蒂还是彼得晚餐都没有吃土豆。
examples.rewrite: Betty doesn't have potatoes for supper. Neither does Peter.

examples.en: He did a part-time job so that he could support his family.
examples.zh: 为了养家，他做了一份兼职工作。

examples.en: I support International Milan while my son supports AC Milan.
examples.zh: 我支持国际米兰队，而我儿子却支持 AC 米兰队。

examples.en: They gave me so much support.
examples.zh: 他们给了我很大的支持。

examples.en: I suppose prices will go down.
examples.zh: 我想物价会下降。

examples.en: Suppose rooms are fully booked on that day — what then?
examples.zh: 假定那天房间都订满了——那怎么办？

phrases: be supposed to do 应该/被要求做……

senses.zh: 确信的，肯定的，有把握的

examples.en: Don't worry about the exam. You should be sure of yourselves.
examples.zh: 不要为考试担心。你们应该相信自己。

examples.en: Now boys and girls, be sure to come here on time tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 好了，孩子们，明天早上务必准时到这里。

examples.en: About three-fourths of the earth's surface is covered by water.
examples.zh: 大约四分之三的地球表面被水覆盖。

使惊奇，使诧异，使感到意外

examples.en: I have a surprise for you.
examples.zh: 我要告诉你一件意想不到的事。

examples.en: The fans were so surprised to know his death.
examples.zh: 粉丝们惊讶地得知他去世的消息。

derivations.zh: 感到惊奇的，惊讶的，感觉意外的

phrases: be surprised at 对……感到惊奇
to one's surprise 使某人惊奇的是

notes:
名师点拨：to 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其基本用法，及比较与 on, in, at 的用法区别：
to 指的是一个范围和另一个范围之间隔了段距离，表示“在某范围之外”，强调两者是远离关系。
on 指的是一个范围紧挨着另一个范围，表示“两地接壤”，强调两者为相邻关系。
in 指的是在某范围之内，没有精确的地址。
at 指在某一具体的地点，通常用于有精确的地址。
例如：Japan is to the east of China. 日本位于中国的东边。
DPR is on the northeast of China. 朝鲜在中国的东北面。
Beijing is in the north of China. 北京在中国的北部。
The interview is arranged at an office on Middle Huaihai Road in Shanghai. 采访被安排在位于上海淮海中路的一个办公室里。

senses.zh: 也; 还; 又; 太, 过分; 很, 非常

examples.en: It's not safe for teenagers to give out too much information about themselves on the internet.

notes:
名师点拨：too 是常考单词, 所以学生一定要掌握其基本用法, 及比较与 either, also, as well 的用法区别。这四个词都是副词, 都含有“也”的意思, 可是它们的具体用法却有比较明显的区别。
too 表示“也”时, 一般用在肯定句中, 放在句末, 前面通常用逗号。
例如: Jim likes red. I like red, too. 吉姆喜欢红色, 我也喜欢。
either 表示“也”时, 一般只用于否定句中, 放在句末, 前面通常用逗号。
例如: It won't do them any good, but it won't do them any harm, either. 这对他们没什么好处, 但也没什么害处。
also 经常放在句中, 位于行为动词之前; 位于系动词、助动词或情态动词之后。
例如: They also agree with me. 他们也同意我的意见。
Mrs. Green can also sing the song in Chinese. 格林夫人也能用汉语唱这首歌。
as well 的用法和 too 一样, 通常放在句末, 但它前面通常不用逗号。
例如: He speaks English, and he knows French as well. 他说英语, 也懂法语。

notes:
名师点拨：unless是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握其用法：
1) unless与if...not...意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：I won't be allowed to play computer games unless I finish my homework.
= If I don't finish my homework, I won't be allowed to play computer games.
除非我完成作业，否则不许玩电脑游戏。
You will be late for school unless you leave now.
= You will be late for school if you don't leave now.
如果你现在不走，上学就要迟到了。
2) unless与祈使句+or意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：Unless you work harder, you'll not succeed in your new job.
= Work harder, or you'll not succeed in your new job.
再努力点，否则你的新工作就不会成功。

notes:
名师点拨：until 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：not...until 与...when/after 意思相同，在句中可以互换。
例如：The boys didn't stop playing basketball until it was dark.
= The boys stopped playing basketball when it was dark.
直到天黑，男孩们才停止打篮球。
Kitty won't believe it until she has seen it with her own eyes.
= Kitty will believe it after she has seen it with her own eyes.
直到亲眼所见，姬蒂才会相信。
